- One-time GGUF load (thread-safe)

- Applies sane defaults (token limits, sanitization)

def _get_llama_class() -> Any:
    global _llama_class, _llama_import_attempted, _llama_import_error

    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001

    return _llama_class

    raw = os.getenv(name)
    if raw is None or raw == "":

            return fast_default
        return default
    try:
        return int(raw)
    except ValueError:

    if provider == "groq":
        effective_provider = "groq"
        fallback_available = bool(remote_ready)
        available = bool(remote_ready)
        status = "ready" if remote_ready else "error"
    elif provider == "auto":
        effective_provider = "local" if local_available else ("groq" if remote_ready else "local")
        fallback_available = bool(local_available or remote_ready)
        available = bool(local_available or remote_ready)
        if local_ready or remote_ready:
            status = "ready"
        elif local_available or remote_model or remote_api_key:
            status = "configured"
        else:
            status = "error"
    else:
        effective_provider = "local" if local_available else ("groq" if remote_ready else "local")
        fallback_available = bool(local_available or remote_ready)
        available = bool(local_available or remote_ready)
        if local_ready or remote_ready:
            status = "ready"
        elif local_available or remote_model or remote_api_key:
            status = "configured"

def _get_llama() -> Any:
    global _llama

    if _llama is not None:
        return _llama

    llama_class = _get_llama_class()
    if llama_class is None:
        detail = _llama_import_error or "llama-cpp-python is not installed."
        raise RuntimeError(detail)

    with _llama_lock:
        if _llama is not None:
            return _llama

        if not os.path.exists(MODEL_PATH):
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"GGUF model not found at {MODEL_PATH}")

        logger.info("[llm_offload] Loading GGUF model from %s", MODEL_PATH)
        logger.info(
            "[llm_offload] ctx=%s threads=%s gpu_layers=%s batch=%s",
            AEGIS_LLAMA_CTX,
            AEGIS_LLAMA_THREADS,
            AEGIS_N_GPU_LAYERS,
            AEGIS_LLAMA_BATCH,
        )

        _llama = llama_class(
            model_path=MODEL_PATH,
            n_ctx=AEGIS_LLAMA_CTX,
            n_threads=AEGIS_LLAMA_THREADS,
            n_gpu_layers=AEGIS_N_GPU_LAYERS,
            n_batch=AEGIS_LLAMA_BATCH,
            verbose=False,
        )

        logger.info("[llm_offload] Model loaded successfully.")
        return _llama

def _format_wizardcoder(messages: List[Dict[str, str]]) -> str:
    """
    IMPORTANT FIX:
    Your old version added "User:" / "Assistant:" prefixes.
    That makes WizardCoder continue as a script and echo the chat.

    So here we:
    - Merge system into SYS
    - Append other messages as plain text (no role labels)
    - Add a small rule: "reply as assistant only"
    """
    system_parts: List[str] = []
    convo_parts: List[str] = []

    for m in messages:
        role = m.get("role", "user")
        content = (m.get("content") or "").strip()
        if not content:
            continue

        if role == "system":
            system_parts.append(content)
        else:
            convo_parts.append(content)

    system_text = "\n".join(system_parts).strip() or "You are a helpful AI assistant."
    convo_text = "\n\n".join(convo_parts).strip()

    system_text = (
        system_text
        + "\n\n"
        + "Rules: Reply as the assistant only. Do not include 'User:' or 'Assistant:' labels."
    )

    return (
        "[INST] <<SYS>>\n"
        f"{system_text}\n"
        "<</SYS>>\n\n"
        f"{convo_text}\n"
        "[/INST]\n"
    )

def _call_groq_chat(
    messages: List[Dict[str, str]],
    max_tokens: int,
    temperature: float = 0.3,
    top_p: float = 0.95,
    stop: Optional[List[str]] = None,
) -> str:
    api_key = _remote_api_key()
    model = _remote_model_name()
    if not api_key:
        return "Groq backend is not configured (AEGIS_GROQ_API_KEY or GROQ_API_KEY is missing)."
    if not model:
        return "Groq backend is not configured (AEGIS_GROQ_MODEL is missing)."

    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "model": model,
        "messages": messages,
        "temperature": temperature,
        "top_p": top_p,
        "max_tokens": max_tokens,
        "stream": False,
    }
    if stop:
        payload["stop"] = stop

    url = f"{_remote_base_url()}/chat/completions"
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "Accept": "application/json",
        "User-Agent": _remote_user_agent(),
    }

    try:
        resp = requests.post(
            url,
            json=payload,
            headers=headers,
            timeout=_remote_timeout_seconds(),
        )
        raw = resp.text
        resp.raise_for_status()
    except requests.HTTPError as exc:
        response = getattr(exc, "response", None)
        body = ""
        code = getattr(response, "status_code", None) or getattr(resp, "status_code", "?")
        if response is not None:
            body = getattr(response, "text", "") or ""
        elif "resp" in locals():
            body = getattr(resp, "text", "") or ""
        return f"Groq HTTP error {code}: {body or exc}"
    except requests.RequestException as exc:
        logger.exception("Groq request failed: %s", exc)
        return f"Groq request failed: {exc}"

    try:
        data = json.loads(raw)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        logger.exception("Groq returned non-JSON response: %s", exc)
        return f"Groq returned non-JSON response: {raw[:240]}"

    choices = data.get("choices") or []
    if not isinstance(choices, list) or not choices:
        return "Groq response missing choices."

    first = choices[0] if isinstance(choices[0], dict) else {}
    message = first.get("message") or {}
    if isinstance(message, dict):
        text = str(message.get("content") or "").strip()
    else:
        text = ""
    if not text:
        return "Groq response was empty."
    return _postprocess(text)

def _call_llama_chat(
    messages: List[Dict[str, str]],
    max_tokens: int,
    temperature: float = 0.3,
    top_p: float = 0.95,
    stop: Optional[List[str]] = None,
) -> str:
    llm = _get_llama()
    prompt = _format_wizardcoder(messages)

    # IMPORTANT FIX:
    # Your old stop list included "[INST]" and "<<SYS>>" which can cause weird early stopping.
    # Keep stops minimal.
    stop_tokens = stop or ["</s>", "<|endoftext|>", "[/INST]"]

    # llama.cpp invocations must stay single-flight per process.
    with _llama_infer_lock:
        result = llm(  # type: ignore[call-arg]
            prompt,
            max_tokens=max_tokens,
            temperature=temperature,
            top_p=top_p,
            repeat_penalty=1.1,
            stop=stop_tokens,
        )
    return _postprocess(_extract_text(result))

def generate_response(
    messages: List[Dict[str, str]],
    max_new_tokens: Optional[int] = None,
    temperature: float = 0.2,
    top_p: float = 0.95,
    preferred_provider: Optional[str] = None,
    **_: Any,
) -> str:
    """
    Generic LLM entrypoint used by the rest of the app.

    - Sanitizes messages.
    - Caps tokens using MAX_NEW_TOKENS.
    - Routes between local llama.cpp and Groq when configured.
    - On failure, returns a safe placeholder instead of crashing.
    """
    profile_provider = _configured_provider()
    profile_remote_ready = bool(_remote_api_key() and _remote_model_name())
    route_provider = _normalize_provider_choice(preferred_provider) or profile_provider

    if max_new_tokens is None or max_new_tokens <= 0:
        max_tokens = int(MAX_NEW_TOKENS)
    else:
        max_tokens = int(min(max_new_tokens, MAX_NEW_TOKENS))

    temperature = float(temperature if temperature is not None else 0.2)
    top_p = float(top_p if top_p is not None else 0.95)

    messages = sanitize_messages(messages)

    if route_provider == "groq":
        attempt_order = ["groq"]
    elif route_provider == "local":
        attempt_order = ["local", "groq"] if profile_remote_ready else ["local"]
    else:
        attempt_order = ["local", "groq"] if profile_remote_ready else ["local"]

    last_error = ""
    for backend in attempt_order:
        try:
            if backend == "groq":
                text = _generate_groq_response(messages, max_tokens, temperature, top_p)
                if _looks_like_remote_failure(text):
                    last_error = text
                    continue
                return text

            text = _generate_local_response(messages, max_tokens, temperature, top_p)
            if _looks_like_local_failure(text):
                last_error = text
                continue
            return text
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            logger.exception("LLM backend %s failed: %s", backend, exc)
            last_error = str(exc)

    if last_error:
        return last_error
    return (
        "LLM backend is not fully configured. "
        "The server is running, but no model is available."
    )

def _get_llama() -> Any:
    global _llama

    if _llama is not None:
        return _llama

    llama_class = _get_llama_class()
    if llama_class is None:
        detail = _llama_import_error or "llama-cpp-python is not installed."
        raise RuntimeError(detail)

    with _llama_lock:
        if _llama is not None:
            return _llama

        if not os.path.exists(MODEL_PATH):
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"GGUF model not found at {MODEL_PATH}")

        logger.info("[llm_offload] Loading GGUF model from %s", MODEL_PATH)
        logger.info(
            "[llm_offload] ctx=%s threads=%s gpu_layers=%s batch=%s",
            AEGIS_LLAMA_CTX,
            AEGIS_LLAMA_THREADS,
            AEGIS_N_GPU_LAYERS,
            AEGIS_LLAMA_BATCH,
        )

        _llama = llama_class(
            model_path=MODEL_PATH,
            n_ctx=AEGIS_LLAMA_CTX,
            n_threads=AEGIS_LLAMA_THREADS,
            n_gpu_layers=AEGIS_N_GPU_LAYERS,
            n_batch=AEGIS_LLAMA_BATCH,

def _check_rate_limit(key: str) -> None:
    """
    Simple in-process sliding window rate limit per key.
    Raises HTTPException when exceeded.
    """
    if RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE <= 0:
        return
    now = time.time()
    window_start = now - 60
    bucket = _rate_bucket.setdefault(key, [])
    bucket[:] = [t for t in bucket if t >= window_start]
    if len(bucket) >= RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=429, detail="Rate limit exceeded")
    bucket.append(now)

"""
AEGIS main FastAPI application entrypoint.

Why this module exists:
- Compose middleware, static mounts, and canonical router wiring.
- Run startup boot (DB/security/LLM/web warmups) and expose health.

Run:
  uvicorn main:app --reload --log-level debug
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
import uuid
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from collections import defaultdict, deque
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Deque, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Request
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.responses import FileResponse, HTMLResponse, JSONResponse
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from app.services import runtime_metrics

logger = logging.getLogger("aegis.main")
if not logger.handlers:
    logging.basicConfig(
        level=os.getenv("AEGIS_LOG_LEVEL", "INFO"),
        format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s",
    )

DEMO_MODE = (os.getenv("AEGIS_DEMO_MODE", "0") or "0").strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}
LLM_WARMUP_ON_START = os.getenv("AEGIS_LLM_WARMUP", "1").lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"} and not DEMO_MODE
CLAMAV_STATUS_ON_START = os.getenv("AEGIS_CLAMAV_STATUS_ON_START", "1").lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}
DISABLE_DB = os.getenv("AEGIS_DISABLE_DB", "0").lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}

# Trust reverse-proxy headers for client IP
TRUST_PROXY = os.getenv("AEGIS_TRUST_PROXY", "0").lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}


def _env_bool(name: str, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    """Read a boolean env var using AEGIS conventions (1/true/yes/on)."""
    raw = os.getenv(name)
    if raw is None:
        return default
    return raw.strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}


def _git_sha_cached() -> str:
    """Best-effort git SHA for health/debug visibility."""
    try:
        return subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD"], timeout=1).decode().strip()
    except Exception:
        return "unknown"


GIT_SHA = _git_sha_cached()

app = FastAPI(title="AEGIS Chat", version="0.1.0")

# CORS
_cors_origins_raw = os.getenv("AEGIS_CORS_ORIGINS", "*")
_cors_origins = [o.strip() for o in _cors_origins_raw.split(",") if o.strip()] or ["*"]
_cors_has_wildcard = "*" in _cors_origins
_cors_creds_raw = (os.getenv("AEGIS_CORS_ALLOW_CREDENTIALS", "auto") or "auto").strip().lower()
if _cors_creds_raw == "auto":
    _cors_allow_credentials = not _cors_has_wildcard
elif _cors_creds_raw in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}:
    _cors_allow_credentials = True
elif _cors_creds_raw in {"0", "false", "no", "off"}:
    _cors_allow_credentials = False
else:
    logger.warning(
        "Invalid AEGIS_CORS_ALLOW_CREDENTIALS=%r. Using auto mode.",
        _cors_creds_raw,
    )
    _cors_allow_credentials = not _cors_has_wildcard

if _cors_allow_credentials and _cors_has_wildcard:
    logger.warning(
        "CORS wildcard with credentials is unsafe/invalid. Forcing allow_credentials=False. "
        "Set AEGIS_CORS_ORIGINS to explicit origins for credentialed CORS."
    )
    _cors_allow_credentials = False

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=_cors_origins,
    allow_credentials=_cors_allow_credentials,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],

from __future__ import annotations

"""
Lightweight JSON-backed conversation memory (fallback when DB is unavailable).

- Keeps conversations in a dict[str, Conversation].
- Persists to disk atomically (CONV_FILE).
- Trims old messages and merges them into a summary.
"""

import glob
import json
import logging
import os
import shutil
import threading
import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, TypedDict

from dotenv import load_dotenv
from app.services.session_state import default_session_state, normalize_session_state, update_session_state
from app.utils.runtime_helpers import now_ms as _now_ms

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# ============================================================
# LOCAL CONFIG (decoupled from llm_client_offload)
# ============================================================

load_dotenv()

DATA_DIR: str = os.getenv("AEGIS_DATA_DIR", "data")
CONV_FILE: str = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "conversations.json")
MAX_MEMORY_BACKUPS: int = int(os.getenv("AEGIS_MEMORY_MAX_BACKUPS", "5"))
PERSIST_MEMORY: bool = (os.getenv("AEGIS_MEMORY_PERSIST", "1") or "1").lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}

# How many turns we keep before trimming (user+assistant pairs -> *2 messages)
MAX_HISTORY_TURNS: int = int(os.getenv("AEGIS_MAX_HISTORY_TURNS", "20"))

# Max chars allowed in the summary field
MAX_SUMMARY_CHARS: int = int(os.getenv("AEGIS_MAX_SUMMARY_CHARS", "1400"))
# Max chars per stored message to prevent runaway JSON growth
MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS: int = int(os.getenv("AEGIS_MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS", "4000"))


class Message(TypedDict):
    role: str
    content: str


class Conversation(TypedDict):
    summary: str
    messages: List[Message]
    state: Dict[str, Any]
    archived: bool
    created_at_ms: int
    updated_at_ms: int


_lock = threading.RLock()
conversations: Dict[str, Conversation] = {}


def _normalize_message(role: str, content: str) -> Message:
    content_str = "" if content is None else str(content)
    if len(content_str) > MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS:
        content_str = content_str[:MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS] + " … [truncated]"
    return {"role": str(role) if role is not None else "user", "content": content_str}


def _ensure_data_dir() -> None:
    try:
        os.makedirs(DATA_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        logger.warning("Failed to ensure DATA_DIR %s: %s", DATA_DIR, exc)


def _backup_memory_file(path: str) -> None:
    if MAX_MEMORY_BACKUPS <= 0 or not os.path.exists(path):
        return
    ts = datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S")
    backup_path = f"{path}.{ts}.bak"
    try:
        shutil.copy2(path, backup_path)
        _prune_old_backups(path)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        logger.warning("Failed to backup memory file %s: %s", path, exc)


def _prune_old_backups(path: str) -> None:
    pattern = f"{path}.*.bak"
    backups = sorted(glob.glob(pattern), reverse=True)
    for old in backups[MAX_MEMORY_BACKUPS:]:
        try:
            os.remove(old)
        except Exception:
            logger.debug("Failed to remove old backup %s", old, exc_info=True)


def _safe_json_load(path: str) -> Dict[str, Conversation]:
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        logger.debug("Memory file not found at %s; starting with empty store.", path)
        return {}
    try:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            raw = json.load(f)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        logger.warning("Failed to load memory file %s: %s; using empty store.", path, exc)
        return {}
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        logger.warning("Memory file %s did not contain a dict root; using empty store.", path)
        return {}

    result: Dict[str, Conversation] = {}
    for conv_id, conv in raw.items():
        if not isinstance(conv_id, str) or not isinstance(conv, dict):
            continue
        summary = conv.get("summary", "") if isinstance(conv.get("summary"), str) else ""
        msgs_raw = conv.get("messages") or []

def _safe_json_write(path: str, data: Dict[str, Conversation]) -> bool:
    if not PERSIST_MEMORY:
        return True
    _ensure_data_dir()
    tmp_file = f"{path}.tmp"
    try:

            json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
            f.flush()
            os.fsync(f.fileno())
        _backup_memory_file(path)
        os.replace(tmp_file, path)
        return True
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        logger.exception("Failed to persist memory file %s: %s", path, exc)

from __future__ import annotations

import io
import logging
from typing import Literal, Optional

from PIL import Image, ImageOps, ImageStat, UnidentifiedImageError
import pytesseract

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

SupportedLang = Literal["es", "en"]
SupportedMode = Literal["text", "code", "scene", "ocr"]


def _get_ocr_lang(lang: SupportedLang) -> str:
    """
    Decide qué modelos de idioma usar en Tesseract.

    Mantiene el comportamiento original (spa+eng siempre) para no
    romper nada, pero si mañana quieres refinarlo por idioma, lo haces aquí.
    """
    return "spa+eng"


def _normalize_mode(mode: str | None) -> SupportedMode:
    value = str(mode or "text").strip().lower()
    if value == "ocr":
        return "text"
    if value in {"text", "code", "scene"}:
        return value  # type: ignore[return-value]
    return "text"


def _preprocess_image(img: Image.Image, mode: SupportedMode = "text") -> Image.Image:
    """
    Preprocesado ligero para mejorar OCR:
    - Escala mínima (900px de ancho).
    - Escala de grises + autocontrast.
    - Umbral binario simple (más fuerte para modo code).
    """
    try:
        if img.mode != "RGB":
            img = img.convert("RGB")
        # upscale if very small
        w, h = img.size
        if w < 900:
            scale = 900 / float(w)
            img = img.resize((int(w * scale), int(h * scale)), Image.LANCZOS)

        gray = img.convert("L")
        gray = ImageOps.autocontrast(gray)

        # basic threshold
        m = _normalize_mode(mode)
        thresh = 150 if m in {"text", "scene"} else 170
        bw = gray.point(lambda x: 255 if x > thresh else 0, mode="1")
        return bw
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        logger.warning("vision_client: fallo en preprocesado OCR: %s", exc)
        return img


def _describe_image_frame(img: Image.Image, lang: SupportedLang) -> str:
    try:
        w, h = img.size
        orientation = (
            "horizontal" if w > h else
            "vertical" if h > w else
            "square"
        )
        gray = img.convert("L")
        stats = ImageStat.Stat(gray)
        mean = float(stats.mean[0] if stats.mean else 0.0)
        stddev = float(stats.stddev[0] if stats.stddev else 0.0)

        if mean < 80:
            brightness = "dark"
        elif mean > 180:
            brightness = "bright"
        else:
            brightness = "balanced"

        if stddev < 28:
            contrast = "low"
        elif stddev > 62:
            contrast = "high"
        else:
            contrast = "medium"

        sample = img.convert("RGB").resize((128, 128), Image.LANCZOS)
        palette_img = sample.quantize(colors=5).convert("RGB")
        colors = sorted(palette_img.getcolors(128 * 128) or [], reverse=True)
        palette = ", ".join(
            f"#{rgb[0]:02x}{rgb[1]:02x}{rgb[2]:02x}"
            for _, rgb in colors[:3]
        ) or "n/a"

        if lang == "es":
            return (
                "Análisis visual local (sin servicios externos):\n"
                f"- Resolución: {w}x{h} ({orientation}).\n"
                f"- Iluminación estimada: {brightness}.\n"
                f"- Contraste estimado: {contrast}.\n"
                f"- Colores dominantes: {palette}."
            )

        return (
            "Local visual analysis (no external services):\n"
            f"- Resolution: {w}x{h} ({orientation}).\n"
            f"- Estimated lighting: {brightness}.\n"
            f"- Estimated contrast: {contrast}.\n"
            f"- Dominant colors: {palette}."
        )
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        logger.warning("vision_client: frame description failed: %s", exc)
        if lang == "es":
            return "Análisis visual local disponible, pero no pude extraer métricas de imagen."
        return "Local visual analysis is available, but I could not extract image metrics."

from __future__ import annotations

"""
Post-start strict verification orchestrator.

Why this module exists:
- Execute full runtime validation (pytest + E2E + contracts) against a live host.
- Provide deterministic pass/fail output for release and operator checks.
"""

import argparse
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlparse

import requests

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from app.scripts.start_with_preflight import _default_browser_smoke_cmd
from app.services.validation_state import finish_flow, mark_step, start_flow
from app.utils.runtime_helpers import (
    env_int as _env_int,
    product_track_default as _product_track_default,
    runtime_profile_default as _runtime_profile_default,
)


E2E_SCRIPT = ROOT / "app" / "scripts" / "e2e_flow_check.py"
AGENT_EVAL_SCRIPT = ROOT / "app" / "scripts" / "agent_eval_check.py"
HARD_CONTRACT_SCRIPT = ROOT / "app" / "scripts" / "hard_contract_check.py"
NO_LOOP_STRESS_SCRIPT = ROOT / "app" / "scripts" / "no_loop_stress_check.py"
VERIFY_FULL_STEPS = [
    "host-prereq",
    "pytest-full",
    "e2e-strict",
    "readyz",
    "agent-evals",
    "ui-contract",
    "hard-contract",
    "no-loop-stress",
    "browser-smoke",
]


def _run(cmd: list[str], *, env: dict[str, str], label: str, timeout: int) -> int:
    # Kept local intentionally: verify_full has a compact CLI contract and
    # should not depend on orchestration helpers from other scripts.
    print(f"\n[run] {label}: {' '.join(cmd)}")
    try:
        return subprocess.run(cmd, env=env, check=False, timeout=timeout).returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        print(f"[fail] {label}: timed out after {timeout}s")
        return 124


def _host_prereq(base_url: str, timeout: int) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    target = str(base_url or "").strip()
    if not target:
        return False, "missing-base-url"
    parsed = urlparse(target)
    if parsed.scheme not in {"http", "https"}:
        return False, f"invalid-base-url-scheme:{parsed.scheme or 'none'}"
    if not parsed.netloc:
        return False, "invalid-base-url-host"

    healthz = f"{target.rstrip('/')}/healthz"
    try:
        r = requests.get(healthz, timeout=max(3, timeout))
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return False, f"healthz-request-failed:{exc}"
    if r.status_code != 200:
        return False, f"healthz-status:{r.status_code}"
    return True, "ok"


def _check_readyz(
    base_url: str,
    api_key: str,
    timeout: int,
    *,
    strict: bool = False,
    product_track: str = "core",
) -> tuple[bool, str, dict | None]:
    # NOTE: kept local (instead of shared with start_with_preflight.py) because
    # verify-full returns compact CLI-oriented status tokens.
    target = str(base_url or "").strip()
    if not target:
        return False, "missing-base-url", None
    url = f"{target.rstrip('/')}/system/readyz"
    headers = {"X-API-Key": api_key} if api_key else {}
    try:
        r = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=max(3, timeout))
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return False, f"readyz-request-failed:{exc}", None
    if r.status_code != 200:
        return False, f"readyz-status:{r.status_code}", None
    try:
        data = r.json()
    except Exception:
        return False, "readyz-non-json", None
    if not bool(data.get("ready")):
        return False, f"readyz-not-ready:{data}", data if isinstance(data, dict) else None
    if strict:
        status = str(data.get("status") or "").strip().lower()
        if product_track == "full":
            if status and status != "ready":
                return False, f"strict-readyz-requires-status-ready:{status}", data if isinstance(data, dict) else None
        else:
            if status and status not in {"ready", "degraded", "fallback-only"}:
                return False, f"strict-core-readyz-requires-ready-or-degraded:{status}", data if isinstance(data, dict) else None
    return True, "ok", data if isinstance(data, dict) else None

def main() -> int:
    """
    What it does:
    - Runs post-start strict verification pipeline for full runtime confidence.

    Why it exists:
    - Provide deterministic go/no-go validation after environment boot.

    Called from ->
    - `verify_full.sh`, `go_strict.sh`, CI/manual strict checks

    Calls ->
    - full pytest, strict E2E, readyz, agent evals, UI contract,
      hard-contract and no-loop stress gates, browser smoke

    Failure/guard behavior:
    - Enforces strict profile requirements (no skip flags for required gates).
    """
    args = parse_args()
    env = os.environ.copy()
    runtime_profile = "strict" if str(args.runtime_profile).strip().lower() == "strict" else "standard"
    product_track = "full" if str(getattr(args, "product_track", _product_track_default())).strip().lower() == "full" else "core"
    strict_from_profile = runtime_profile == "strict"
    strict_browser_smoke = bool(args.strict_browser_smoke or (strict_from_profile and product_track == "full"))
    skip_no_loop_stress = bool(getattr(args, "skip_no_loop_stress", False))
    no_loop_timeout = int(getattr(args, "no_loop_timeout", 120) or 120)
    no_loop_runs = int(getattr(args, "no_loop_runs", 8) or 8)
    no_loop_request_timeout = int(getattr(args, "no_loop_request_timeout", 45) or 45)
    no_loop_max_seconds_per_run = float(getattr(args, "no_loop_max_seconds_per_run", 35.0) or 35.0)
    max_no_loop_failures = int(getattr(args, "max_no_loop_failures", 0) or 0)
    no_loop_auth_edge_every = int(getattr(args, "no_loop_auth_edge_every", 0) or 0)
    no_loop_auth_edge_invalid_key = str(getattr(args, "no_loop_auth_edge_invalid_key", "invalid-no-loop-key") or "").strip()
    max_no_loop_auth_edge_unexpected_failures = int(
        getattr(args, "max_no_loop_auth_edge_unexpected_failures", 0) or 0
    )
    env["AEGIS_RUNTIME_PROFILE"] = runtime_profile
    env["AEGIS_PRODUCT_TRACK"] = product_track
    start_flow("verify_full", VERIFY_FULL_STEPS)
    print(f"[profile] runtime={runtime_profile} track={product_track} strict_browser_smoke={int(strict_browser_smoke)}")

    if strict_from_profile:
        if not str(args.base_url or "").strip():
            mark_step("verify_full", "host-prereq", "failed", "missing-base-url-strict")
            finish_flow("verify_full", "failed", "host-prereq")
            print("[fail] Strict verify_full requires --base-url.")
            return 2
        if bool(args.skip_pytest):
            mark_step("verify_full", "pytest-full", "failed", "skip-pytest-in-strict")
            finish_flow("verify_full", "failed", "pytest-full")
            print("[fail] Strict verify_full does not allow --skip-pytest.")
            return 2
        if bool(args.skip_e2e):
            mark_step("verify_full", "e2e-strict", "failed", "skip-e2e-in-strict")
            finish_flow("verify_full", "failed", "e2e-strict")
            print("[fail] Strict verify_full does not allow --skip-e2e.")
            return 2
        if bool(args.skip_ui_contract):
            mark_step("verify_full", "ui-contract", "failed", "skip-ui-contract-in-strict")
            finish_flow("verify_full", "failed", "ui-contract")
            print("[fail] Strict verify_full does not allow --skip-ui-contract.")
            return 2
        if bool(args.skip_hard_contract):
            mark_step("verify_full", "hard-contract", "failed", "skip-hard-contract-in-strict")
            finish_flow("verify_full", "failed", "hard-contract")
            print("[fail] Strict verify_full does not allow --skip-hard-contract.")
            return 2
        if skip_no_loop_stress:
            mark_step("verify_full", "no-loop-stress", "failed", "skip-no-loop-stress-in-strict")
            finish_flow("verify_full", "failed", "no-loop-stress")
            print("[fail] Strict verify_full does not allow --skip-no-loop-stress.")
            return 2

    if args.base_url:
        ok, detail = _host_prereq(args.base_url, args.health_timeout)
        if not ok:
            mark_step("verify_full", "host-prereq", "failed", detail)
            finish_flow("verify_full", "failed", "host-prereq")
            print(f"[fail] host-prereq failed: {detail}")
            return 2
        mark_step("verify_full", "host-prereq", "passed", "ok")
    else:
        mark_step("verify_full", "host-prereq", "skipped", "missing-base-url")

    if not args.skip_pytest:
        rc = _run([sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q"], env=env, label="pytest-full", timeout=max(60, args.pytest_timeout))
        if rc != 0:
            mark_step("verify_full", "pytest-full", "failed", f"exit={rc}")
            finish_flow("verify_full", "failed", "pytest-full")
            print("[fail] Full pytest verification failed.")
            return rc
        mark_step("verify_full", "pytest-full", "passed", "ok")
    else:
        mark_step("verify_full", "pytest-full", "skipped", "skip-pytest")

    if not args.skip_e2e and args.base_url:
        if strict_from_profile and product_track == "full":
            # Full track keeps optional host deps (image/backend) as strict blockers.
            e2e_cmd = [
                sys.executable,

    finish_flow("verify_full", "passed", "verify-full-passed")

def _run(cmd: list[str], *, env: dict[str, str], label: str, timeout: int) -> int:
    # Kept local intentionally: verify_full has a compact CLI contract and
    # should not depend on orchestration helpers from other scripts.
    print(f"\n[run] {label}: {' '.join(cmd)}")
    try:
        return subprocess.run(cmd, env=env, check=False, timeout=timeout).returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        print(f"[fail] {label}: timed out after {timeout}s")
        return 124


def _host_prereq(base_url: str, timeout: int) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    target = str(base_url or "").strip()
    if not target:
        return False, "missing-base-url"
    parsed = urlparse(target)
    if parsed.scheme not in {"http", "https"}:
        return False, f"invalid-base-url-scheme:{parsed.scheme or 'none'}"
    if not parsed.netloc:
        return False, "invalid-base-url-host"

    healthz = f"{target.rstrip('/')}/healthz"
    try:
        r = requests.get(healthz, timeout=max(3, timeout))
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return False, f"healthz-request-failed:{exc}"
    if r.status_code != 200:
        return False, f"healthz-status:{r.status_code}"
    return True, "ok"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

"""
Runtime doctor for commercial readiness (Core vs Full tracks).

What it does:
- Runs lightweight install/runtime diagnostics against local env and optional live API.
- Evaluates pass/fail differently for Core and Full product tracks.

Why it exists:
- Give operators a deterministic post-install sanity check before demos/releases.
- Separate optional-host dependency failures (image/browser) from core assistant readiness.

Called from ->
- Manual operator checks (`python -m app.scripts.doctor`)
- Post-install checklist and release runbooks

Calls ->
- Env inspection + static script presence checks
- Optional HTTP checks (`/healthz`, `/system/readyz`)
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
from urllib.parse import urlparse

import requests

from app.utils.network_helpers import probe_tcp_url
from app.utils.runtime_helpers import product_track_default as _product_track_default

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CheckItem:
    name: str
    ok: bool
    detail: str
    track: str


def _first_csv_token(value: str | None) -> str:
    raw = str(value or "").strip()
    if not raw:
        return ""
    return raw.split(",", 1)[0].strip()


def _check_script_exists(path: str, track: str = "core") -> CheckItem:
    p = ROOT / path
    return CheckItem(
        name=f"script:{path}",
        ok=p.exists() and p.is_file(),
        detail="ok" if p.exists() else "missing",
        track=track,
    )


def _probe_tcp_endpoint(url: str, timeout: float = 2.0) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
    return probe_tcp_url(url, timeout=max(0.5, float(timeout)))


def _browser_version(binary: str, timeout: int = 3) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
    try:
        res = subprocess.run(
            [binary, "--version"],
            check=False,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=max(1, int(timeout)),
        )
        output = (res.stdout or res.stderr or "").strip()
        if res.returncode == 0:
            return True, output[:180] or "ok"
        return False, f"exit={res.returncode} {output[:180]}".strip()
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return False, str(exc)


def _http_json(
    base_url: str,
    path: str,
    api_key: str,
    timeout: int,
    *,
    attempts: int = 1,
    backoff_seconds: float = 0.35,
) -> Tuple[bool, str, Optional[Dict[str, Any]], int]:
    url = f"{base_url.rstrip('/')}{path}"
    headers = {"X-API-Key": api_key} if api_key else {}
    tries = max(1, int(attempts))
    last_error = ""
    for idx in range(tries):
        try:
            resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=timeout)
            status = int(resp.status_code)
            if status >= 400:
                return False, f"http_{status}", None, status
            payload = resp.json() if "application/json" in (resp.headers.get("content-type", "").lower()) else {}
            if not isinstance(payload, dict):
                payload = {}
            return True, "ok", payload, status
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            last_error = str(exc)
            if idx + 1 < tries:
                time.sleep(max(0.05, float(backoff_seconds)))
    return False, last_error or "request-failed", None, 0

def _env_checks(track: str) -> List[CheckItem]:
    out: List[CheckItem] = []
    auth_mode = (os.getenv("AEGIS_AUTH_MODE", "on") or "on").strip().lower()
    out.append(CheckItem("env:AEGIS_AUTH_MODE", auth_mode == "on", f"value={auth_mode}", "core"))

    api_key = _first_csv_token(os.getenv("AEGIS_API_KEY"))
    files_key = _first_csv_token(os.getenv("FILES_API_KEY"))
    out.append(CheckItem("env:AEGIS_API_KEY", bool(api_key), "present" if api_key else "missing", "core"))
    out.append(CheckItem("env:FILES_API_KEY", bool(files_key), "present" if files_key else "missing", "core"))

    runtime_profile = (os.getenv("AEGIS_RUNTIME_PROFILE", "standard") or "standard").strip().lower()
    out.append(CheckItem("env:AEGIS_RUNTIME_PROFILE", runtime_profile in {"standard", "strict"}, f"value={runtime_profile}", "core"))

    if track == "full":
        img_endpoint = (os.getenv("AEGIS_IMAGE_ENDPOINT", "") or "").strip()
        out.append(CheckItem("env:AEGIS_IMAGE_ENDPOINT", bool(img_endpoint), "present" if img_endpoint else "missing", "full"))
        if img_endpoint:
            image_ok, image_detail = _probe_tcp_endpoint(img_endpoint)
            out.append(CheckItem("env:AEGIS_IMAGE_ENDPOINT:reachable", image_ok, image_detail, "full"))

        browser = (os.getenv("AEGIS_BROWSER_BINARY", "") or "").strip()
        out.append(CheckItem("env:AEGIS_BROWSER_BINARY", bool(browser), "present" if browser else "missing", "full"))
        if browser:
            browser_path = Path(browser)
            browser_exec = browser_path.exists() and browser_path.is_file() and os.access(str(browser_path), os.X_OK)
            out.append(
                CheckItem(
                    "env:AEGIS_BROWSER_BINARY:executable",
                    browser_exec,
                    f"path={browser}",
                    "full",
                )
            )
            if browser_exec:
                version_ok, version_detail = _browser_version(browser)
                out.append(CheckItem("env:AEGIS_BROWSER_BINARY:version", version_ok, version_detail, "full"))
    return out

def _evaluate(items: List[CheckItem], track: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    relevant = [c for c in items if c.track in {"core", track}]
    failed = [c for c in relevant if not c.ok]
    return {
        "ok": not failed,
        "track": track,
        "total": len(relevant),
        "passed": len(relevant) - len(failed),
        "failed": len(failed),
        "checks": [asdict(c) for c in relevant],
    }

def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="AEGIS install/runtime doctor (Core vs Full).")
    p.add_argument(
        "--track",
        choices=["core", "full"],
        default=_product_track_default(),
        help="Product track to validate (defaults from AEGIS_PRODUCT_TRACK).",
    )
    p.add_argument("--base-url", default="", help="Optional live API base URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8000")
    p.add_argument("--api-key", default=os.getenv("AEGIS_API_KEY", ""), help="API key for live checks (defaults from env).")
    p.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=20, help="HTTP timeout seconds for live checks.")
    p.add_argument("--attempts", type=int, default=2, help="HTTP attempts per live check.")
    p.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Output JSON only.")
    return p.parse_args()

def _print_text(payload: Dict[str, Any], base_url: str) -> None:
    print(f"track={payload.get('track')} ok={payload.get('ok')}")
    print(f"checks: {payload.get('passed')}/{payload.get('total')} passed")
    if base_url:
        print(f"live_base_url={base_url}")
    print("")
    for chk in payload.get("checks", []):
        status = "ok" if chk.get("ok") else "fail"
        print(f"[{status}] {chk.get('name')} ({chk.get('track')}): {chk.get('detail')}")

    print("")
    if payload.get("ok"):
        print("[ok] doctor passed")
    else:
        print("[fail] doctor found blockers")
        print("next:")
        print("- fix failed checks")
        print("- re-run: python -m app.scripts.doctor --track core --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000")
        print("- for full: python -m app.scripts.doctor --track full --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000")

def main() -> int:
    args = parse_args()
    track = str(args.track or "core").strip().lower()
    base_url = str(args.base_url or "").strip()
    api_key = _first_csv_token(args.api_key) or _first_csv_token(os.getenv("AEGIS_API_KEY"))

    checks: List[CheckItem] = []
    checks.extend(_env_checks(track))
    checks.extend(_script_checks(track))

    if base_url:
        ok_healthz, detail_healthz, _healthz, _ = _http_json(
            base_url,
            "/healthz",
            api_key,
            timeout=max(2, args.timeout),
            attempts=max(1, int(args.attempts)),
        )
        checks.append(CheckItem("http:/healthz", ok_healthz, detail_healthz, "core"))
        ok_readyz, detail_readyz, readyz_payload, _ = _http_json(
            base_url,
            "/system/readyz",
            api_key,
            timeout=max(2, args.timeout),
            attempts=max(1, int(args.attempts)),
        )
        checks.append(CheckItem("http:/system/readyz", ok_readyz, detail_readyz, "core"))
        if ok_readyz and isinstance(readyz_payload, dict):
            checks.extend(_readyz_checks(readyz_payload, track))

    payload = _evaluate(checks, track)
    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    else:
        _print_text(payload, base_url)
    return 0 if bool(payload.get("ok")) else 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

    out: List[CheckItem] = []

    out.append(CheckItem("env:FILES_API_KEY", bool(files_key), "present" if files_key else "missing", "core"))

    runtime_profile = (os.getenv("AEGIS_RUNTIME_PROFILE", "standard") or "standard").strip().lower()
    out.append(CheckItem("env:AEGIS_RUNTIME_PROFILE", runtime_profile in {"standard", "strict"}, f"value={runtime_profile}", "core"))

        out.append(CheckItem("env:AEGIS_BROWSER_BINARY", bool(browser), "present" if browser else "missing", "full"))
        if browser:

def main(argv: List[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    symbols = [part.strip().upper() for part in str(args.symbols or "").split(",") if part.strip()]
    if not symbols:
        raise SystemExit("No symbols provided")

    all_rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    for symbol in symbols:
        log.info("Fetching %s candles for %s (%s)...", args.candles, symbol, args.interval)
        klines = _fetch_symbol_klines(
            symbol=symbol,
            interval=args.interval,
            candles=max(1, args.candles),
            timeout=max(1.0, float(args.timeout)),
            pause_seconds=max(0.0, float(args.pause_seconds)),
        )
        rows = _rows_from_klines(symbol, klines)
        log.info("Collected %s rows for %s", len(rows), symbol)
        all_rows.extend(rows)

    df = pd.DataFrame(all_rows)
    if df.empty:
        raise SystemExit("No OHLCV rows fetched")
    df = df.sort_values(["timestamp", "binance_symbol"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    args.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    df.to_csv(args.out, index=False)

    summary = {
        "ok": True,
        "rows": int(len(df)),
        "symbols": symbols,
        "interval": args.interval,
        "candles_per_symbol": int(args.candles),
        "out": str(args.out),
    }
    print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
EXAMPLE_ENV = ROOT / ".env.strict.full.local.example"
DEFAULT_ENV_OUT = ROOT / ".env.strict.full.local"
_CONTRACT_MODES = {"full", "strict", "none"}


def _parse_env_pairs(text: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    pairs: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    for raw_line in str(text or "").splitlines():
        line = raw_line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
            continue
        key, value = raw_line.split("=", 1)
        key = key.strip()
        value = value.strip()
        if key:
            pairs.append((key, value))
    return pairs


def _load_example_pairs() -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    if EXAMPLE_ENV.exists():
        return _parse_env_pairs(EXAMPLE_ENV.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return [
        ("AEGIS_RUNTIME_PROFILE", "strict"),
        ("AEGIS_PRODUCT_TRACK", "full"),
        ("AEGIS_AUTH_MODE", "on"),
        ("AEGIS_API_KEY", '"aegis-demo-key-2026-strong"'),
        ("FILES_API_KEY", '"aegis-demo-key-2026-strong"'),
        ("ADMIN_API_KEY", '"set-a-different-strong-key"'),
        ("DATABASE_URL", '"postgresql+psycopg2://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/aegis"'),
        ("AEGIS_IMAGE_ENDPOINT", '"http://127.0.0.1:8188/prompt"'),
        ("AEGIS_IMAGE_CKPT", '"DreamShaper_8_pruned.safetensors"'),
        ("AEGIS_IMAGE_TIMEOUT", "90"),
        ("AEGIS_BROWSER_BINARY", '"/usr/bin/google-chrome-stable"'),
        ("AEGIS_CORS_ORIGINS", '"http://127.0.0.1:8000"'),
        ("FILES_AV_FAIL_OPEN", "0"),
        ("AEGIS_HSTS_SECONDS", "31536000"),
        ("TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM", "false"),
    ]


def _with_contract_mode(pairs: list[tuple[str, str]], contract_mode: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    normalized = contract_mode.strip().lower()
    if normalized not in _CONTRACT_MODES:
        normalized = "full"
    out: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    seen = False
    for key, value in pairs:
        if key == "AEGIS_START_CONTRACT_MODE":
            out.append((key, normalized))
            seen = True
            continue
        out.append((key, value))
    if not seen:
        out.append(("AEGIS_START_CONTRACT_MODE", normalized))
    return out


def render_env(contract_mode: str = "full") -> str:
    pairs = _with_contract_mode(_load_example_pairs(), contract_mode)
    return "\n".join(f"{key}={value}" for key, value in pairs) + "\n"


def render_shell(contract_mode: str = "full") -> str:
    pairs = _with_contract_mode(_load_example_pairs(), contract_mode)
    return "\n".join(f"export {key}={value}" for key, value in pairs) + "\n"


def write_env_file(path: Path, *, contract_mode: str = "full", overwrite: bool = False) -> Path:
    target = path.resolve()
    if target.exists() and not overwrite:
        raise FileExistsError(f"{target} already exists")
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text(render_env(contract_mode), encoding="utf-8")
    return target


def copy_to_clipboard(text: str) -> bool:
    commands = (
        ["wl-copy"],
        ["xclip", "-selection", "clipboard"],
        ["xsel", "--clipboard", "--input"],
        ["pbcopy"],
    )
    for cmd in commands:
        if shutil.which(cmd[0]):
            try:
                subprocess.run(cmd, input=text, text=True, check=True)
                return True
            except Exception:
                continue
    return False


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Generate the local strict/full export block documented in README.MD."
    )
    parser.add_argument("--format", choices=["shell", "env"], default="shell")
    parser.add_argument("--contract-mode", choices=["full", "strict", "none"], default="full")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--write-env-file",
        nargs="?",
        const=str(DEFAULT_ENV_OUT),
        default="",
        help="Write .env-style output to the given file. Defaults to .env.strict.full.local when no path is provided.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--overwrite", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--copy", action="store_true", help="Copy the rendered output to the system clipboard when possible.")
    return parser.parse_args()

def _collect_symbol_boundaries(text: str) -> List[Tuple[Optional[str], int, int]]:
    matches: List[Tuple[Optional[str], int, int]] = []
    seen: set[Tuple[Optional[str], int]] = set()
    for pattern in CODE_SYMBOL_PATTERNS:
        for match in pattern.finditer(text):
            symbol = match.group(1).strip() if match.groups() else None
            line_start = text.count("\n", 0, match.start()) + 1
            key = (symbol, line_start)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            matches.append((symbol, line_start, match.start()))
    matches.sort(key=lambda item: item[1])
    return matches[:MAX_SYMBOLS_PER_FILE]

def _build_code_docs(project_id: str, rel_path: str, text: str, language: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    file_sha = _file_text_sha(text)
    lines = text.splitlines()
    total_lines = len(lines)
    docs: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

    if total_lines <= 0:
        return docs

    module_end = min(total_lines, max(CODE_WINDOW_LINES, 120))
    module_text = "\n".join(lines[:module_end]).strip()
    if module_text:
        docs.append(
            _build_document_doc(
                project_id=project_id,
                rel_path=rel_path,
                text=module_text,
                file_sha=file_sha,
                language=language,
                chunk_type="module",
                line_start=1,
                line_end=module_end,
                prechunked=True,
            )
        )

    boundaries = _collect_symbol_boundaries(text)
    for idx, (symbol, line_start, _) in enumerate(boundaries):
        next_line = boundaries[idx + 1][1] - 1 if idx + 1 < len(boundaries) else total_lines
        line_end = min(total_lines, max(line_start, next_line))
        symbol_text = "\n".join(lines[line_start - 1 : line_end]).strip()
        if not symbol_text:
            continue
        docs.append(
            _build_document_doc(
                project_id=project_id,
                rel_path=rel_path,
                text=symbol_text,
                file_sha=file_sha,
                language=language,
                chunk_type="symbol",
                symbol=symbol,
                line_start=line_start,
                line_end=line_end,
                prechunked=True,
            )
        )

    step = max(1, CODE_WINDOW_LINES - CODE_WINDOW_OVERLAP)
    start_line = 1
    while start_line <= total_lines:
        end_line = min(total_lines, start_line + CODE_WINDOW_LINES - 1)
        window_text = "\n".join(lines[start_line - 1 : end_line]).strip()
        if window_text:
            docs.append(
                _build_document_doc(
                    project_id=project_id,
                    rel_path=rel_path,
                    text=window_text,
                    file_sha=file_sha,
                    language=language,
                    chunk_type="window",
                    line_start=start_line,
                    line_end=end_line,
                    prechunked=True,
                )
            )
        if end_line >= total_lines:
            break
        start_line += step

    return docs

def ingest(
    root: Path,
    max_files: int,
    max_file_bytes: int,
    max_total_bytes: int,
    *,
    project_id: str | None = None,
    manifest_out: Path | None = None,
) -> int:
    """Walk files, chunk text, embed, and write to the FAISS index."""
    project_key = (project_id or root.name).strip() or root.name
    previous_state = load_project_ingest_state(root)
    previous_hashes = previous_state.get("file_hashes") if isinstance(previous_state.get("file_hashes"), dict) else {}
    previous_hashes = {str(k): str(v) for k, v in previous_hashes.items()}

    docs: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    manifest_lines: List[str] = []
    current_hashes: Dict[str, str] = {}
    total_bytes = 0
    scanned_files = 0
    ingested_files = 0
    total_added = 0
    total_removed = 0
    skipped_ext = 0
    skipped_large = 0
    skipped_empty = 0
    skipped_quota = 0
    manifest_truncated = False
    changed_paths: set[str] = set()

    for path in _iter_files(root):
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        scanned_files += 1

        try:
            size = path.stat().st_size
        except OSError:
            continue

        rel = str(path.relative_to(root))
        if len(manifest_lines) < DEFAULT_MANIFEST_MAX_FILES:
            manifest_lines.append(f"{rel}\t{size}")
        else:
            manifest_truncated = True

        if ingested_files >= max_files:
            skipped_quota += 1
            continue

        ext = path.suffix.lower()
        if DEFAULT_EXTS and ext not in DEFAULT_EXTS:
            skipped_ext += 1
            continue

        if max_file_bytes and size > max_file_bytes:
            skipped_large += 1
            continue
        if max_total_bytes and total_bytes + size > max_total_bytes:
            skipped_quota += 1
            break

        text = _read_text(path)
        if not text.strip():
            skipped_empty += 1
            continue

        text_sha = _file_text_sha(text)
        current_hashes[rel] = text_sha
        total_bytes += size
        ingested_files += 1

        if previous_hashes.get(rel) == text_sha:
            continue

        changed_paths.add(rel)
        docs.extend(_build_file_docs(project_key, rel, path, text))

    deleted_paths = set(previous_hashes) - set(current_hashes)

    summary_lines = [
        f"ROOT_PATH: {root}",
        f"PROJECT_ID: {project_key}",
        f"SCANNED_FILES: {scanned_files}",
        f"INGESTED_TEXT_FILES: {ingested_files}",
        f"CHANGED_FILES: {len(changed_paths)}",
        f"DELETED_FILES: {len(deleted_paths)}",
        f"SKIPPED_EXT: {skipped_ext}",
        f"SKIPPED_FILE_SIZE: {skipped_large}",
        f"SKIPPED_EMPTY: {skipped_empty}",
        f"SKIPPED_QUOTA_OR_LIMIT: {skipped_quota}",
        "",
        "FILE_INVENTORY (REL_PATH<TAB>SIZE_BYTES):",
        *manifest_lines,
    ]
    if manifest_truncated:
        summary_lines.append(f"... (manifest truncated at {DEFAULT_MANIFEST_MAX_FILES} files)")

    docs.append(
        _build_document_doc(
            project_id=project_key,
            rel_path="__manifest__/files.tsv",
            text="\n".join(summary_lines),
            file_sha=_file_text_sha("\n".join(summary_lines)),
            language="manifest",
            chunk_type="manifest",
            prechunked=False,
        )
    )

    rel_paths_to_refresh = set(changed_paths) | set(deleted_paths) | {"__manifest__/files.tsv"}
    if rel_paths_to_refresh:
        total_removed = remove_project_documents(project_key, rel_paths=rel_paths_to_refresh)

    print(
        f"[ingest] collected text_files={ingested_files} changed={len(changed_paths)} "
        f"deleted={len(deleted_paths)} bytes={total_bytes}",
        flush=True,
    )
    print("[ingest] embedding + indexing...", flush=True)
    total_added = add_documents(docs)

    total_chunks = count_project_chunks(project_key)

    if not current_hashes and total_chunks == 0:
        print("No files ingested (nothing matched filters or root is empty).")

    if manifest_out is not None:
        save_project_manifest(
            root,
            project_id=project_key,
            chunk_count=total_chunks,
            chunked_files=ingested_files,
            skipped={
                "ext": skipped_ext,
                "size": skipped_large,
                "empty": skipped_empty,
                "quota_or_limit": skipped_quota,
            },
            target=manifest_out,
        )

    save_project_ingest_state(
        root,
        project_id=project_key,
        file_hashes=current_hashes,
        chunk_count=total_chunks,
        metadata={
            "scanned_files": scanned_files,
            "ingested_files": ingested_files,
            "changed_files": len(changed_paths),
            "deleted_files": len(deleted_paths),
            "removed_chunks": total_removed,
        },
    )

    print(
        f"[ingest] summary scanned={scanned_files} text_files={ingested_files} "
        f"skipped_ext={skipped_ext} skipped_size={skipped_large} "
        f"skipped_empty={skipped_empty} skipped_quota={skipped_quota} "
        f"removed_chunks={total_removed}",
        flush=True,
    )
    print(f"[ingest] done files={ingested_files} chunks_added={total_added} chunks_total={total_chunks}", flush=True)
    return total_chunks

def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Ingest a repo and build FAISS embeddings.")
    parser.add_argument("--root", required=True, help="Root directory to ingest")
    parser.add_argument("--max-files", type=int, default=DEFAULT_MAX_FILES)
    parser.add_argument("--max-file-bytes", type=int, default=DEFAULT_MAX_FILE_BYTES)
    parser.add_argument("--max-total-bytes", type=int, default=DEFAULT_MAX_TOTAL_BYTES)
    parser.add_argument("--project-id", default="", help="Optional stable project id for manifest metadata")
    parser.add_argument("--manifest-out", default="", help="Optional manifest output path")

    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = Path(args.root).resolve()
    if not root.exists() or not root.is_dir():
        print("Invalid root:", root)
        return 1

    try:
        ingest(
            root,
            args.max_files,
            args.max_file_bytes,
            args.max_total_bytes,
            project_id=(args.project_id or "").strip() or None,
            manifest_out=Path(args.manifest_out).resolve() if str(args.manifest_out or "").strip() else None,
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        print("Ingest failed:", exc)
        return 2
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

def _file_text_sha(text: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha1((text or "").encode("utf-8", errors="ignore")).hexdigest()


def _build_document_doc(
    *,
    project_id: str,
    rel_path: str,
    text: str,
    file_sha: str,
    language: str,
    chunk_type: str = "document",
    symbol: Optional[str] = None,
    line_start: Optional[int] = None,
    line_end: Optional[int] = None,
    prechunked: bool = False,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "project_id": project_id,
        "rel_path": rel_path,
        "source": f"{project_id}/{rel_path}",
        "text": text,
        "file_sha": file_sha,
        "language": language,
        "chunk_type": chunk_type,
        "prechunked": prechunked,
    }
    if symbol:
        payload["symbol"] = symbol
    if line_start is not None:
        payload["line_start"] = int(line_start)
    if line_end is not None:
        payload["line_end"] = int(line_end)
    return payload


def _collect_symbol_boundaries(text: str) -> List[Tuple[Optional[str], int, int]]:
    matches: List[Tuple[Optional[str], int, int]] = []
    seen: set[Tuple[Optional[str], int]] = set()
    for pattern in CODE_SYMBOL_PATTERNS:
        for match in pattern.finditer(text):
            symbol = match.group(1).strip() if match.groups() else None
            line_start = text.count("\n", 0, match.start()) + 1
            key = (symbol, line_start)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            matches.append((symbol, line_start, match.start()))
    matches.sort(key=lambda item: item[1])
    return matches[:MAX_SYMBOLS_PER_FILE]

    boundaries = _collect_symbol_boundaries(text)
    for idx, (symbol, line_start, _) in enumerate(boundaries):
        next_line = boundaries[idx + 1][1] - 1 if idx + 1 < len(boundaries) else total_lines
        line_end = min(total_lines, max(line_start, next_line))
        symbol_text = "\n".join(lines[line_start - 1 : line_end]).strip()
        if not symbol_text:
            continue
        docs.append(
            _build_document_doc(
                project_id=project_id,
                rel_path=rel_path,
                text=symbol_text,
                file_sha=file_sha,
                language=language,
                chunk_type="symbol",
                symbol=symbol,
                line_start=line_start,
                line_end=line_end,
                prechunked=True,
            )
        )

    step = max(1, CODE_WINDOW_LINES - CODE_WINDOW_OVERLAP)
    start_line = 1
    while start_line <= total_lines:
        end_line = min(total_lines, start_line + CODE_WINDOW_LINES - 1)
        window_text = "\n".join(lines[start_line - 1 : end_line]).strip()
        if window_text:
            docs.append(
                _build_document_doc(
                    project_id=project_id,
                    rel_path=rel_path,
                    text=window_text,
                    file_sha=file_sha,
                    language=language,
                    chunk_type="window",
                    line_start=start_line,
                    line_end=end_line,
                    prechunked=True,
                )
            )
        if end_line >= total_lines:
            break
        start_line += step

    return docs

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Ingest a repo and build FAISS embeddings.")
    parser.add_argument("--root", required=True, help="Root directory to ingest")
    parser.add_argument("--max-files", type=int, default=DEFAULT_MAX_FILES)
    parser.add_argument("--max-file-bytes", type=int, default=DEFAULT_MAX_FILE_BYTES)
    parser.add_argument("--max-total-bytes", type=int, default=DEFAULT_MAX_TOTAL_BYTES)
    parser.add_argument("--project-id", default="", help="Optional stable project id for manifest metadata")
    parser.add_argument("--manifest-out", default="", help="Optional manifest output path")

        return 1

            manifest_out=Path(args.manifest_out).resolve() if str(args.manifest_out or "").strip() else None,

            "detail": {"message": msg, "source_plan": source_plan},
        }
        cases.append(case)

    # 2) Explicit project scope should remain local-first.
    for idx, msg in enumerate(project_scoped_questions):
        state = _base_project_state()
        source_plan = chat_api._decide_source_plan(
            msg,
            mode_value="chat",
            force_web=False,
            is_crypto_mode=False,
            has_active_project=True,
            session_state=state,
        )
        plan = chat_api._build_turn_plan(
            message=msg,
            mode_value="chat",
            source_plan=source_plan,
            has_active_project=True,
            force_web=False,
            session_state=state,
        )
        case = {
            "name": f"project_scope_local_{idx}",
            "ok": source_plan == "local_only" and str(plan.get("next_tool") or "").startswith("project_"),
            "detail": {"message": msg, "source_plan": source_plan, "next_tool": plan.get("next_tool")},
        }
        cases.append(case)

    # 3) Explicit web mode and force-web must always be web_only.
    for idx, msg in enumerate(world_questions):
        web_mode_plan = chat_api._decide_source_plan(
            msg,
            mode_value="web",
            force_web=False,
            is_crypto_mode=False,
            has_active_project=True,
            session_state=_base_project_state(),
        )
        force_web_plan = chat_api._decide_source_plan(
            msg,
            mode_value="chat",
            force_web=True,
            is_crypto_mode=False,
            has_active_project=True,
            session_state=_base_project_state(),
        )
        cases.append(
            {
                "name": f"explicit_web_mode_{idx}",
                "ok": web_mode_plan == "web_only" and force_web_plan == "web_only",
                "detail": {"message": msg, "web_mode": web_mode_plan, "force_web": force_web_plan},
            }
        )

    # 4) Multi-turn adversarial flows:
    # project question -> world question -> project followup
    # Expect focus clear on topic switch and deterministic project tool recovery.
    # Keep deterministic suite size >= 500 for strict release gates.
    for idx in range(420):
        project_msg = project_scoped_questions[idx % len(project_scoped_questions)]
        world_msg = world_questions[idx % len(world_questions)]
        followup_msg = project_followups[idx % len(project_followups)]

        state0 = default_session_state()
        state0["active_project_id"] = "demo-project"
        state1 = update_session_state(
            state0,
            project_msg,
            "",
            mode="chat",
            active_project_id="demo-project",
        )
        # Ensure explicit focus exists before topic switch.
        state1["current_file_focus"] = "app/auth.py"
        state1["current_symbol_focus"] = "login_user"
        state1["current_artifact_focus"] = "app/auth.py"

        state2 = update_session_state(
            state1,
            world_msg,
            "",
            mode="chat",
            active_project_id="demo-project",
        )
        focus_cleared = not (
            str(state2.get("current_file_focus") or "").strip()
            or str(state2.get("current_symbol_focus") or "").strip()
            or str(state2.get("current_artifact_focus") or "").strip()
        )

        state3 = update_session_state(
            state2,
            followup_msg,
            "",
            mode="chat",
            active_project_id="demo-project",
        )
        plan3 = chat_api._build_turn_plan(
            message=followup_msg,
            mode_value="chat",
            source_plan="local_only",
            has_active_project=True,
            force_web=False,
            session_state=state3,
        )
        recovered_project_tool = str(plan3.get("next_tool") or "").startswith("project_")

        cases.append(
            {
                "name": f"topic_switch_decay_{idx}",
                "ok": focus_cleared and recovered_project_tool,
                "detail": {
                    "project_msg": project_msg,
                    "world_msg": world_msg,
                    "followup_msg": followup_msg,
                    "focus_cleared": focus_cleared,
                    "next_tool": plan3.get("next_tool"),
                },
            }
        )

    # 5) Web unavailable/cooldown edge: if web failed recently + explicit web ask, keep web path available.
    for idx, msg in enumerate(generic_code_questions):
        source_plan = chat_api._decide_source_plan(
            f"latest docs for: {msg}",
            mode_value="chat",
            force_web=False,
            is_crypto_mode=False,
            has_active_project=True,
            session_state={
                **_base_project_state(),
                "recent_tool_failures": ["web_search:timeout"],
            },
        )
        cases.append(
            {
                "name": f"web_retry_path_{idx}",
                "ok": source_plan in {"web_only", "local+web"},
                "detail": {"message": msg, "source_plan": source_plan},
            }
        )

    total = len(cases)
    passed = sum(1 for case in cases if bool(case.get("ok")))
    ok = (passed == total) and total >= int(min_cases)

    failed_examples: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    for case in cases:
        if not bool(case.get("ok")):
            _sample_failure(case, failed_examples)

    return {
        "ok": ok,
        "passed": passed,
        "total": total,
        "min_cases": int(min_cases),
        "failed_examples": failed_examples,
    }

        )
    )

    auth_mode = (os.getenv("AEGIS_AUTH_MODE", "on") or "on").strip().lower()
    results.append(CheckResult(name="auth_mode", ok=(auth_mode == "on"), detail=f"value={auth_mode}"))

    api_key = _first_csv_token(os.getenv("AEGIS_API_KEY"))
    files_key = _first_csv_token(os.getenv("FILES_API_KEY")) or api_key
    admin_key = _first_csv_token(os.getenv("ADMIN_API_KEY"))

    for name, value in (("AEGIS_API_KEY", api_key), ("FILES_API_KEY", files_key), ("ADMIN_API_KEY", admin_key)):
        ok, detail = _is_strong_key(value)
        results.append(CheckResult(name=name, ok=ok, detail=detail))

    cors = (os.getenv("AEGIS_CORS_ORIGINS", "*") or "*").strip()
    cors_has_wildcard = cors == "*" or "*" in [p.strip() for p in cors.split(",")]
    results.append(CheckResult(name="cors_origins", ok=not cors_has_wildcard, detail=f"value={cors}"))

    hsts_raw = (os.getenv("AEGIS_HSTS_SECONDS", "0") or "0").strip()
    try:
        hsts = int(hsts_raw or "0")
    except Exception:
        hsts = 0
    results.append(CheckResult(name="hsts_seconds", ok=hsts > 0, detail=f"value={hsts}"))

    av_fail_open = (os.getenv("FILES_AV_FAIL_OPEN", "1") or "1").strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}
    results.append(CheckResult(name="av_fail_open", ok=not av_fail_open, detail=f"value={int(av_fail_open)}"))

    if require_browser:
        browser = find_brave_binary()
        results.append(CheckResult(name="browser_binary", ok=bool(browser), detail=(browser or "not-found")))
    else:
        results.append(CheckResult(name="browser_binary", ok=True, detail="not-required"))

    image_endpoint = (os.getenv("AEGIS_IMAGE_ENDPOINT", "") or "").strip()
    if require_image_endpoint:
        if not image_endpoint:
            results.append(CheckResult(name="image_endpoint", ok=False, detail="missing"))
        else:
            parsed = urlparse(image_endpoint)
            host = str(parsed.hostname or "").strip()
            port = int(parsed.port or (443 if parsed.scheme == "https" else 80))
            if not host:
                results.append(CheckResult(name="image_endpoint", ok=False, detail=f"invalid:{image_endpoint}"))
            else:
                ok, detail = _check_tcp_reachable(host, port)
                results.append(CheckResult(name="image_endpoint", ok=ok, detail=(detail if ok else f"unreachable:{detail}")))
    else:
        results.append(CheckResult(name="image_endpoint", ok=True, detail="not-required"))

    failed = [r.as_dict() for r in results if not r.ok]
    payload = {
        "ok": not failed,
        "total": len(results),
        "passed": len(results) - len(failed),
        "failed": len(failed),
        "checks": [r.as_dict() for r in results],
    }
    return payload

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from typing import Iterable

import requests
from app.utils.runtime_helpers import print_json as _print


REQUIRED_IDS = [
    "msg",
    "sendBtn",
    "chat",
    "chatBtn",
    "imgBtn",
    "modeIndicator",
    "activeProjectBadge",
    # Compact image mode wiring (chat-integrated image flow)
    "attachBtn",
    "imageQuickBar",
    "imageModeGuide",
    "imgInput",
]

REQUIRED_ASSETS = [
    "/ui/app.js",
    "/ui/styles.css",
]

_CONTENT_TYPE_HINTS: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {
    "/ui/app.js": ("javascript",),
    "/ui/styles.css": ("text/css", "css"),
}


def _missing_ids(html: str, required: Iterable[str]) -> list[str]:
    text = html or ""
    missing: list[str] = []
    for rid in required:
        # Keep it simple and fast (no heavy HTML parser in gate).
        if f'id="{rid}"' not in text and f"id='{rid}'" not in text:
            missing.append(rid)
    return missing


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="UI contract check (no browser required).")
    p.add_argument("--base-url", default="http://127.0.0.1:8000")
    p.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=8)
    return p.parse_args()


def main() -> int:
    args = parse_args()
    base = (args.base_url or "").rstrip("/") or "http://127.0.0.1:8000"

    try:
        r = requests.get(f"{base}/", timeout=max(3, int(args.timeout)))
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        _print({"ok": False, "reason": f"ui_index_request_failed:{exc}"})
        return 1

    if r.status_code != 200:
        _print({"ok": False, "reason": f"ui_index_status:{r.status_code}"})
        return 1

    html = r.text or ""
    missing = _missing_ids(html, REQUIRED_IDS)
    if missing:
        _print({"ok": False, "reason": "ui_missing_dom_ids", "missing_ids": missing})
        return 1

    asset_status: dict[str, int] = {}
    asset_ctypes: dict[str, str] = {}
    for path in REQUIRED_ASSETS:
        try:
            rr = requests.get(f"{base}{path}", timeout=max(3, int(args.timeout)))
            asset_status[path] = int(rr.status_code)
            asset_ctypes[path] = str(rr.headers.get("content-type") or "")
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            asset_status[path] = 0
            asset_ctypes[path] = ""

    bad_assets = [p for p, s in asset_status.items() if s != 200]
    if bad_assets:
        _print(
            {
                "ok": False,
                "reason": "ui_assets_missing",
                "asset_status": asset_status,
                "asset_content_type": asset_ctypes,
            }
        )
        return 1

    # Help catch cases where browsers refuse to execute due to nosniff + wrong MIME type.
    bad_ct = []
    for path, hints in _CONTENT_TYPE_HINTS.items():
        ct = asset_ctypes.get(path, "").lower()
        if not ct:
            continue
        if not any(h in ct for h in hints):
            bad_ct.append({"path": path, "content_type": asset_ctypes.get(path, "")})
    if bad_ct:
        _print({"ok": False, "reason": "ui_assets_bad_content_type", "bad": bad_ct, "asset_content_type": asset_ctypes})
        return 1

    _print({"ok": True, "missing_ids": [], "asset_status": asset_status})
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from app.scripts import e2e_flow_check as e2e


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Run a one-symbol crypto preview/testnet rehearsal and archive evidence.")
    parser.add_argument("--base-url", default="http://127.0.0.1:8000")
    parser.add_argument("--api-key", default="")
    parser.add_argument("--files-api-key", default="")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=30.0)
    parser.add_argument("--skip-auth", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--symbol", default="BTCUSDT")
    parser.add_argument("--side", default="BUY", choices=["BUY", "SELL"])
    parser.add_argument("--quantity", type=float, default=0.001)
    parser.add_argument("--horizon-minutes", type=int, default=15)
    parser.add_argument("--regime", default="")
    parser.add_argument("--execution-mode", default="testnet", choices=["simulated", "testnet"])
    parser.add_argument("--stop-loss-pct", type=float, default=1.0)
    parser.add_argument("--take-profit-pct", type=float, default=2.0)
    parser.add_argument("--max-exposure-quote", type=float, default=100.0)
    parser.add_argument("--max-order-size-pct", type=float, default=15.0)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--submit-if-allowed",
        action="store_true",
        help="Send /crypto/trade only when preview is allowed and effective mode matches the requested mode.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--out-dir",
        default="artifacts/release_evidence/crypto_testnet_rehearsal",
        help="Directory where the timestamped rehearsal evidence folder will be written.",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.quantity <= 0:
        parser.error("--quantity must be > 0")
    if args.horizon_minutes <= 0:
        parser.error("--horizon-minutes must be > 0")
    return args


def _normalize_symbol(value: str) -> str:
    return str(value or "BTCUSDT").strip().upper() or "BTCUSDT"


def _optional_positive(value: Optional[float]) -> Optional[float]:
    if value is None:
        return None
    number = float(value)
    return number if number > 0 else None


def _request_json(
    ctx: e2e.ClientCtx,
    method: str,
    path: str,
    *,
    json_body: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None,
    params: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> tuple[int, Any]:
    response = ctx.request(method, path, json_body=json_body, params=params)
    return response.status_code, e2e._json_or_text(response)


def _build_order_payload(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {
        "symbol": _normalize_symbol(args.symbol),
        "side": str(args.side or "BUY").strip().upper() or "BUY",
        "quantity": float(args.quantity),
        "test": True,
        "execution_mode": str(args.execution_mode or "testnet").strip().lower() or "testnet",
    }
    optional_fields = {
        "stop_loss_pct": _optional_positive(args.stop_loss_pct),
        "take_profit_pct": _optional_positive(args.take_profit_pct),
        "max_exposure_quote": _optional_positive(args.max_exposure_quote),
        "max_order_size_pct": _optional_positive(args.max_order_size_pct),
    }
    for key, value in optional_fields.items():
        if value is not None:
            payload[key] = value
    return payload


def _build_params(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    params: dict[str, Any] = {"horizon_minutes": int(args.horizon_minutes)}
    regime = str(args.regime or "").strip().lower()
    if regime:
        params["regime"] = regime
    return params


def _extract_calibration_summary(risk_gate: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    gate = risk_gate if isinstance(risk_gate, dict) else {}
    controls = gate.get("calibration_controls") if isinstance(gate.get("calibration_controls"), dict) else {}
    operator_guidance = gate.get("operator_guidance") if isinstance(gate.get("operator_guidance"), dict) else {}
    return {
        "allowed": bool(gate.get("allowed")) if isinstance(gate.get("allowed"), bool) else None,
        "reason": str(gate.get("reason") or "").strip() or None,
        "operator_status": str(operator_guidance.get("status") or "").strip() or None,
        "operator_action": str(operator_guidance.get("action") or "").strip() or None,
        "max_order_notional": controls.get("max_order_notional"),
        "max_quantity": controls.get("max_quantity"),
        "recommended_reduction_pct": controls.get("recommended_reduction_pct"),
        "sizing_basis": str(controls.get("sizing_basis") or "").strip() or None,
        "blocked_checks": list(gate.get("blocked_checks") or []) if isinstance(gate.get("blocked_checks"), list) else [],
    }
