def run(cmd: list[str]) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
        return subprocess.run(
            cmd,
            text=True,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            env=env,
            timeout=120,
            check=False,
        )

    # if no branch provided, try default-branch detection
    if not branch:
        branch = _detect_default_branch(repo_url)

    # Attempt 1: clone specifying branch (if we have one)
    if branch:
        cmd1 = ["git", "clone", "--depth", str(depth), "--single-branch", "--branch", branch, repo_url, str(dest)]
        r1 = run(cmd1)
        if r1.returncode == 0:
            size_mb = _dir_size_mb(dest)
            if size_mb > payload.max_mb:
                shutil.rmtree(dest, ignore_errors=True)
                raise HTTPException(status_code=413, detail=f"Repo too large ({size_mb} MB). Increase max_mb or use smaller depth.")
            try:
                av_status = _av_scan_path(dest)
                remember_last_upload(dest, source="clone")
                project = register_project(project_id, dest, source="clone", status="uploaded", metadata={"repo_url": repo_url})
                auto_ingest = await _queue_auto_ingest(project_id)
                project = get_project(project_id) or project
                manifest = load_project_manifest(project.get("manifest_path") or project.get("root_path") or "")
                ready_project = _annotate_project_readiness(project, manifest)
            except HTTPException:
                _cleanup_path(dest)
                raise
            except Exception:
                _cleanup_path(dest)
                raise
            return {
                "status": "ok",
                "project_id": project_id,
                "path": str(dest),
                "branch_used": branch,
                "av_status": av_status,
                "project": ready_project,
                "ready_state": ready_project.get("ready_state"),
                "auto_ingest": auto_ingest,
            }

    # Attempt 2: clone without specifying branch (lets git choose default)
    if dest.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(dest, ignore_errors=True)
    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    cmd2 = ["git", "clone", "--depth", str(depth), repo_url, str(dest)]
    r2 = run(cmd2)
    if r2.returncode != 0:
        _cleanup_path(dest)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"git clone failed:\n{(r2.stdout or '')[:3000]}")

    used = _detect_default_branch(repo_url) or branch or "unknown"
    size_mb = _dir_size_mb(dest)
    if size_mb > payload.max_mb:
        _cleanup_path(dest)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=413, detail=f"Repo too large ({size_mb} MB). Increase max_mb or use smaller depth.")

    try:
        av_status = _av_scan_path(dest)
        remember_last_upload(dest, source="clone")
        project = register_project(project_id, dest, source="clone", status="uploaded", metadata={"repo_url": repo_url})
        auto_ingest = await _queue_auto_ingest(project_id)
        project = get_project(project_id) or project
        manifest = load_project_manifest(project.get("manifest_path") or project.get("root_path") or "")
        ready_project = _annotate_project_readiness(project, manifest)
    except HTTPException:
        _cleanup_path(dest)
        raise
    except Exception:
        _cleanup_path(dest)
        raise

    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "project_id": project_id,
        "path": str(dest),
        "branch_used": used,
        "av_status": av_status,
        "project": ready_project,
        "ready_state": ready_project.get("ready_state"),
        "auto_ingest": auto_ingest,
    }

async def register_root(payload: RegisterRootRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    What it does:
    - Registers an existing local directory as a canonical project root.

    Why it exists:
    - Allow workspace-native projects to use the same `/files/*` tooling without upload/clone.

    Called from ->
    - Files panel local-root registration action
    - manual ops/runtime setup flows

    Calls ->
    - workspace/upload root guards
    - canonical project registry + upload-memory tracker

    Failure/guard behavior:
    - Denies paths outside allowed workspace roots.
    """
    raw = Path(payload.path)
    target = raw if raw.is_absolute() else (PROJECT_ROOT / raw)
    target = target.resolve()

    try:
        if _is_under_upload_root(target):
            target = ensure_under_upload_root(target)
        else:
            target = _ensure_under_project_root(target)
    except HTTPException:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Path outside allowed workspace roots")

    if not target.exists() or not target.is_dir():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Directory not found")

    project_id = str((payload.project_id or "").strip() or target.name)
    project = register_project(project_id, target, source="workspace", status="uploaded")
    remember_last_upload(target, source="register-root")
    auto_ingest = await _queue_auto_ingest(str(project.get("project_id") or project_id))
    project = get_project(str(project.get("project_id") or project_id)) or project
    manifest = load_project_manifest(project.get("manifest_path") or project.get("root_path") or "")
    ready_project = _annotate_project_readiness(project, manifest)
    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "project_id": str(project.get("project_id") or project_id),
        "path": str(target),
        "project": ready_project,
        "ready_state": ready_project.get("ready_state"),
        "auto_ingest": auto_ingest,
        "hint": (
            "Auto-ingest queued."
            if str((auto_ingest or {}).get("status") or "").strip().lower() == "queued"
            else "Now call /files/ingest with this project_id or path if you want indexed retrieval."
        ),
    }

async def ingest_path(body: IngestRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    What it does:
    - Runs ingest pipeline for a registered/local project path and stores manifest.

    Why it exists:
    - Converts uploaded/cloned source trees into searchable project context.

    Called from ->
    - Files ingest UI actions
    - startup/e2e contract checks

    Calls ->
    - app/scripts/ingest_repo.py subprocess
    - project manifest loader + project registry updates
    - optional job manager for background mode

    Failure/guard behavior:
    - Returns `504` on ingest timeout and `500` on ingest execution errors.
    """
    project = get_project(str(body.project_id or "").strip()) if body.project_id else None
    p: Path
    if project:
        p = _resolve_registered_project_root(project)
    else:
        raw_path = str(body.path or "").strip()
        if not raw_path:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="path or project_id is required")
        raw = Path(raw_path)
        target = raw if raw.is_absolute() else (PROJECT_ROOT / raw)
        target = target.resolve()
        try:
            p = ensure_under_upload_root(target) if _is_under_upload_root(target) else _ensure_under_project_root(target)
        except HTTPException as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Path outside allowed workspace roots") from exc
        if not p.exists() or not p.is_dir():
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Path does not exist")
        project = get_project_by_path(p) or ensure_project_for_path(
            p,
            source="upload-zip" if _is_under_upload_root(p) else "workspace",
        )

    if not p.exists() or not p.is_dir():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Path does not exist")
    project_id = str(project.get("project_id") or p.name)
    update_project(project_id, status="ingesting")

def _run_ingest(log_file: Path, *, job_id: str | None = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        # Ingest can be heavy (chunk + embed + index); keep timeout configurable.
        if not INGEST_SCRIPT.exists():
            update_project(project_id, status="error")
            raise RuntimeError(f"ingest script not found: {INGEST_SCRIPT}")
        manifest_path = p / ".aegis_manifest.json"
        cmd = [
            sys.executable or "python",
            str(INGEST_SCRIPT),
            "--root",
            str(p),
            "--project-id",
            project_id,
            "--manifest-out",
            str(manifest_path),
        ]
        INGEST_LOG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        env = os.environ.copy()
        # Ensure ingest logs flush promptly for UI progress.
        env["PYTHONUNBUFFERED"] = "1"
        start = time.monotonic()
        if job_id:
            start_stage(job_id, "spawn_ingest_subprocess", detail="running app/scripts/ingest_repo.py")
        with log_file.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as lf:
            lf.write(f"[$] {' '.join(cmd)}\n")
            lf.flush()
            try:
                proc = subprocess.Popen(
                    cmd,
                    text=True,
                    stdout=lf,
                    stderr=lf,
                    env=env,
                    start_new_session=True,
                )
                while True:
                    rc = proc.poll()
                    if rc is not None:
                        break
                    if INGEST_TIMEOUT and time.monotonic() - start > INGEST_TIMEOUT:
                        proc.kill()
                        proc.wait(timeout=5)
                        raise RuntimeError("ingest timed out")
                    time.sleep(0.5)
            except RuntimeError:
                raise
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                raise RuntimeError(f"ingest failed: {exc}") from exc

        if job_id:
            finish_stage(
                job_id,
                "spawn_ingest_subprocess",
                status="success" if proc.returncode == 0 else "error",
                detail=f"exit={proc.returncode}",
            )

        if proc.returncode != 0:
            update_project(project_id, status="error")
            raise RuntimeError("ingest failed (see log)")

        if job_id:
            start_stage(job_id, "load_manifest")
        manifest = load_project_manifest(manifest_path)
        if job_id:
            finish_stage(job_id, "load_manifest", status="success", detail="ok" if manifest else "missing")
        chunk_count = 0
        if isinstance(manifest, dict):
            stats = manifest.get("stats") if isinstance(manifest.get("stats"), dict) else {}
            chunk_count = int(stats.get("chunk_count") or 0)
        if job_id:
            start_stage(job_id, "update_project_registry")
        update_project(
            project_id,
            status="ingested",
            manifest_path=str(manifest_path),
            last_ingest_at=int(time.time()),
            chunk_count=chunk_count,
        )
        if job_id:
            finish_stage(job_id, "update_project_registry", status="success", detail=f"chunks={chunk_count}")

        return {
            "status": "ok",
            "project_id": project_id,
            "ingested_path": str(p),
            "manifest_path": str(manifest_path),
            "log_path": str(log_file),
        }

    if body.background:
        job_id = uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]
        log_file = INGEST_LOG_DIR / f"ingest_{job_id}.log"
        job = start_job(
            lambda: _run_ingest(log_file, job_id=job_id),
            kind="ingest",
            job_id=job_id,
            meta={"log_path": str(log_file), "path": str(p), "project_id": project_id},
        )
        return {"status": "queued", "job_id": job.id, "project_id": project_id}

    try:
        log_file = INGEST_LOG_DIR / f"ingest_sync_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}.log"
        return _run_ingest(log_file)
    except RuntimeError as exc:
        msg = str(exc)
        if "timed out" in msg:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=504, detail=msg) from exc
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=msg) from exc

async def diff_project_content(req: SaveContentRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    What it does:
    - Builds a unified diff preview for a proposed file edit/create.

    Why it exists:
    - Lets the UI preview exact code changes before writing to disk.
    """
    file_path = _resolve_project_text_file_path(path=req.path, project_id=req.project_id, root=req.root)
    file_exists = file_path.exists()
    if file_exists and not file_path.is_file():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Target path is not a file")
    if not file_exists and not req.create:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="File not found")

    current_text = ""
    if file_exists:
        try:
            current_text = file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="strict")
        except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=415, detail="File is not a UTF-8 text file") from exc
    proposed_text = str(req.content or "")
    diff_text = "".join(
        unified_diff(
            current_text.splitlines(keepends=True),
            proposed_text.splitlines(keepends=True),
            fromfile=_relative_to_workspace(file_path) if file_exists else f"a/{req.path}",
            tofile=_relative_to_workspace(file_path) if file_exists else f"b/{req.path}",
            lineterm="",
        )
    )
    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "path": _relative_to_workspace(file_path) if file_exists else str(req.path).strip(),
        "exists": file_exists,
        "create": bool(req.create and not file_exists),
        "changed": current_text != proposed_text,
        "diff": diff_text,
    }

    """
    src_path = _resolve_project_text_file_path(path=req.path, project_id=req.project_id, root=req.root)

    if not dest_clean:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Missing new_path")

            "new_path": _relative_to_workspace(dest_path),

    if dest_path.exists():

    dest_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    old_rel = _relative_to_workspace(src_path)
    src_path.replace(dest_path)
    return {

async def move_project_path(req: MovePathRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    What it does:
    - Moves or renames a file/directory inside the active/registered project root.

    Why it exists:
    - Supports folder moves/renames and file relocations from the guarded Files workspace.
    """
    src_path = _resolve_project_path(path=req.path, project_id=req.project_id, root=req.root)
    if not src_path.exists():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Path not found")

    dest_clean = str(req.new_path or "").strip()
    if not dest_clean:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Missing new_path")
    dest_path = _resolve_project_path(path=dest_clean, project_id=req.project_id, root=req.root)
    if dest_path == src_path:
        return {
            "status": "ok",
            "moved": False,
            "path": _relative_to_workspace(src_path),
            "new_path": _relative_to_workspace(dest_path),
            "is_dir": src_path.is_dir(),
        }
    if dest_path.exists():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Target path already exists")
    if src_path.is_dir():
        try:
            src_resolved = src_path.resolve()
            dest_resolved = dest_path.resolve(strict=False)
        except Exception as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Invalid move target: {exc}") from exc
        if dest_resolved == src_resolved or src_resolved in dest_resolved.parents:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Cannot move a directory into itself")

    dest_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    old_rel = _relative_to_workspace(src_path)
    shutil.move(str(src_path), str(dest_path))
    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "moved": True,
        "path": old_rel,
        "new_path": _relative_to_workspace(dest_path),
        "is_dir": dest_path.is_dir(),
        "updated_at_ms": int(time.time() * 1000),
    }

def validate_repo_url(repo_url: str) -> str:
    u = (repo_url or "").strip()
    if not u:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="repo_url is required")

    p = urlparse(u)
    if (p.scheme or "").lower() != "https":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Only HTTPS repo URLs are allowed")

    host = (p.netloc or "").lower()
    if host not in ALLOWED_HOSTS:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"Only repos from {', '.join(sorted(ALLOWED_HOSTS))} are allowed",
        )

    parts = [x for x in (p.path or "").split("/") if x]
    if len(parts) < 2:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Repo URL must look like https://host/user/repo")

@router.post("/register-root")
async def register_root(payload: RegisterRootRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    What it does:
    - Registers an existing local directory as a canonical project root.

    Why it exists:
    - Allow workspace-native projects to use the same `/files/*` tooling without upload/clone.

    Called from ->
    - Files panel local-root registration action
    - manual ops/runtime setup flows

    Calls ->
    - workspace/upload root guards
    - canonical project registry + upload-memory tracker

    Failure/guard behavior:
    - Denies paths outside allowed workspace roots.
    """
    raw = Path(payload.path)
    target = raw if raw.is_absolute() else (PROJECT_ROOT / raw)
    target = target.resolve()

    try:
        if _is_under_upload_root(target):
            target = ensure_under_upload_root(target)
        else:
            target = _ensure_under_project_root(target)
    except HTTPException:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Path outside allowed workspace roots")

    if not target.exists() or not target.is_dir():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Directory not found")

    project_id = str((payload.project_id or "").strip() or target.name)
    project = register_project(project_id, target, source="workspace", status="uploaded")
    remember_last_upload(target, source="register-root")
    auto_ingest = await _queue_auto_ingest(str(project.get("project_id") or project_id))
    project = get_project(str(project.get("project_id") or project_id)) or project
    manifest = load_project_manifest(project.get("manifest_path") or project.get("root_path") or "")
    ready_project = _annotate_project_readiness(project, manifest)
    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "project_id": str(project.get("project_id") or project_id),
        "path": str(target),
        "project": ready_project,
        "ready_state": ready_project.get("ready_state"),
        "auto_ingest": auto_ingest,
        "hint": (
            "Auto-ingest queued."
            if str((auto_ingest or {}).get("status") or "").strip().lower() == "queued"

def _merge_reference_prompt(prompt: str, ocr_text: str, lang: str) -> str:
    base = str(prompt or "").strip()
    extracted = str(ocr_text or "").strip()
    if not extracted:
        return base
    if len(extracted) > 1200:
        extracted = extracted[:1197].rstrip() + "..."
    marker = "[Contexto OCR de imagen de referencia]" if str(lang or "en").lower().startswith("es") else "[Reference image OCR context]"
    if not base:
        return f"{marker}\n{extracted}".strip()
    return f"{base}\n\n{marker}\n{extracted}".strip()


def _configured_checkpoint() -> str:
    raw = (os.getenv("AEGIS_IMAGE_CKPT", DEFAULT_IMAGE_CKPT) or "").strip()
    return raw or DEFAULT_IMAGE_CKPT


def _resolve_endpoint_and_base() -> tuple[str, str]:
    return split_prompt_url(os.getenv("AEGIS_IMAGE_ENDPOINT", GEN_URL))


def _normalize_checkpoint_values(raw: Any) -> list[str]:
    return normalize_checkpoint_values(raw)


def _extract_checkpoint_choices(payload: Any) -> list[str]:
    return extract_checkpoint_choices(payload)


def _fetch_backend_checkpoints(base_url: str) -> list[str]:
    if not base_url:
        return []
    info_url = f"{base_url.rstrip('/')}/object_info/CheckpointLoaderSimple"
    resp = requests.get(info_url, timeout=min(max(GEN_TIMEOUT, 1.0), 4.0))
    resp.raise_for_status()
    payload = resp.json() if resp.content else {}
    return _extract_checkpoint_choices(payload)


def _resolve_checkpoint(base_url: str) -> tuple[str, str, list[str], Optional[str]]:
    configured = _configured_checkpoint()
    try:
        available = _fetch_backend_checkpoints(base_url)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return configured, configured, [], str(exc)

    if not available:
        return configured, configured, [], None

    if configured in available:
        return configured, configured, available, None

def _render_placeholder(prompt: str, width: int, height: int, seed: Optional[int]) -> Path:
    """Create deterministic local placeholder output when backend is unavailable."""
    fname = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}.png"
    path = IMAGES_DIR / fname
    if Image is None:
        path = path.with_suffix(".txt")
        path.write_text(f"[placeholder image]\nprompt: {prompt}", encoding="utf-8")
        return path
    img = Image.new("RGB", (width, height), color=(18, 24, 38))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    txt = (prompt or "(empty)")[:240]
    try:
        font = ImageFont.load_default()
    except Exception:
        font = None
    draw.text((10, 10), txt, fill=(120, 225, 255), font=font, spacing=4)
    draw.text((10, height - 30), f"seed:{seed or 'rnd'}", fill=(180, 180, 180), font=font)
    img.save(path)
    return path

def _call_local_sd(req: ImageRequest, checkpoint_name: Optional[str] = None) -> tuple[Path, bool, Optional[str]]:
    """
    Llama a ComfyUI (API /prompt) con un grafo mínimo text2img y recupera
    la primera imagen generada vía /history/<prompt_id> + /view.
    Si algo falla, regresa un placeholder.
    """
    endpoint, base = _resolve_endpoint_and_base()
    seed = req.seed if req.seed is not None else int(time.time() * 1000) % 1_000_000
    checkpoint = (checkpoint_name or _configured_checkpoint()).strip() or DEFAULT_IMAGE_CKPT

    prompt_graph = {
        "client_id": "aegis",
        "prompt": {
            "0": {  # checkpoint
                "class_type": "CheckpointLoaderSimple",
                "inputs": {"ckpt_name": checkpoint},
            },
            "1": {  # positive
                "class_type": "CLIPTextEncode",
                "inputs": {"text": req.prompt, "clip": ["0", 1]},
            },
            "2": {  # negative
                "class_type": "CLIPTextEncode",
                "inputs": {"text": req.negative_prompt or "", "clip": ["0", 1]},
            },
            "3": {  # latent
                "class_type": "EmptyLatentImage",
                "inputs": {"width": req.width, "height": req.height, "batch_size": 1},
            },
            "4": {  # sampler
                "class_type": "KSampler",
                "inputs": {
                    "seed": seed,
                    "steps": req.steps,
                    "cfg": req.cfg,
                    "sampler_name": "euler",
                    "scheduler": "normal",
                    "denoise": 1.0,
                    "model": ["0", 0],
                    "positive": ["1", 0],
                    "negative": ["2", 0],
                    "latent_image": ["3", 0],
                },
            },
            "5": {  # decode
                "class_type": "VAEDecode",
                "inputs": {"samples": ["4", 0], "vae": ["0", 2]},
            },
            "6": {  # save
                "class_type": "SaveImage",
                "inputs": {"images": ["5", 0], "filename_prefix": "aegis"},
            },
        },
    }

    try:
        resp = requests.post(endpoint, json=prompt_graph, timeout=GEN_TIMEOUT)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        response_payload = resp.json() if resp.content else {}
        prompt_id = response_payload.get("prompt_id")
        if not prompt_id:
            # Some backends return a structured error payload.
            backend_error = response_payload.get("error") or response_payload.get("detail")
            raise RuntimeError(f"No prompt_id returned by ComfyUI ({backend_error or 'unknown error'})")

        history_url = f"{base}/history/{prompt_id}"
        deadline = time.time() + GEN_TIMEOUT
        images_meta = None
        while time.time() < deadline:
            h = requests.get(history_url, timeout=10)
            h.raise_for_status()
            hist = h.json()
            # history structure: { prompt_id: { outputs: { "6": { "images": [...] }}}}
            entry = hist.get(prompt_id) or {}
            outputs = entry.get("outputs") or {}
            save_node = outputs.get("6") or {}
            imgs = save_node.get("images")
            if imgs:
                images_meta = imgs
                break
            time.sleep(0.5)

        if not images_meta:
            raise RuntimeError("No images in history")

        img_info = images_meta[0]
        filename = img_info.get("filename")
        subfolder = img_info.get("subfolder") or ""
        img_type = img_info.get("type") or "output"
        if not filename:
            raise RuntimeError("Missing filename from history")

        view_url = f"{base}/view?filename={filename}&subfolder={subfolder}&type={img_type}"
        img_resp = requests.get(view_url, timeout=GEN_TIMEOUT)
        img_resp.raise_for_status()

        fname = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}.png"
        path = IMAGES_DIR / fname
        path.write_bytes(img_resp.content)
        return path, True, None
    except Exception as exc:
        err = str(exc)
        logger.warning("Image backend call failed, using placeholder fallback: %s", err)
        return _render_placeholder(req.prompt, req.width, req.height, req.seed), False, err

def runtime_image_status() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Return canonical image capability state consumed by `/system/readyz`."""
    endpoint, base = _resolve_endpoint_and_base()
    recent_rows: list[dict] = []
    last_error = ""
    if LOG_FILE.exists():
        try:
            for line in reversed(LOG_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").splitlines()):
                if len(recent_rows) >= 10:
                    break
                try:
                    item = json.loads(line)
                except Exception:
                    continue
                if isinstance(item, dict):
                    recent_rows.append(item)
        except Exception:
            recent_rows = []

    backend_successes = sum(1 for row in recent_rows if bool(row.get("backend_ok")))
    fallback_count = sum(1 for row in recent_rows if bool(row.get("fallback_used")))
    if recent_rows:
        last_error = str(recent_rows[0].get("backend_error") or "").strip()

    reachable, probe_status, probe_error = _probe_backend(base or endpoint)
    selected_ckpt, configured_ckpt, available_ckpts, ckpt_error = _resolve_checkpoint(base)
    fallback_only = bool(recent_rows) and backend_successes == 0 and fallback_count > 0
    transient_fallbacks = bool(recent_rows) and reachable and backend_successes > 0 and fallback_count > 0
    status = "ready"
    if not reachable and fallback_only:
        status = "fallback-only"
    elif not reachable:
        status = "degraded"
    elif fallback_only:
        status = "degraded"

    return {
        "status": status,
        "endpoint": endpoint,
        "backend_base_url": base,
        "provider": (os.getenv("AEGIS_IMAGE_PROVIDER") or GEN_PROVIDER).strip() or GEN_PROVIDER,
        "timeout_seconds": GEN_TIMEOUT,
        "images_dir": str(IMAGES_DIR),
        "images_dir_exists": IMAGES_DIR.exists(),
        "backend_reachable": reachable,
        "backend_probe_status": probe_status,
        "backend_probe_error": (probe_error or "")[:400] or None,
        "recent_log_rows": len(recent_rows),
        "recent_backend_successes": backend_successes,
        "recent_fallbacks": fallback_count,
        "fallback_only": fallback_only,
        "transient_fallbacks": transient_fallbacks,
        "last_backend_error": last_error[:400] or None,
        "configured_checkpoint": configured_ckpt,
        "selected_checkpoint": selected_ckpt,
        "available_checkpoints": available_ckpts,
        "checkpoint_fallback_used": bool(available_ckpts) and selected_ckpt != configured_ckpt,
        "checkpoint_resolver_error": (ckpt_error or "")[:400] or None,
    }

    if req.width > 1024 or req.height > 1024:

async def recent_images(limit: int = 10):
    if not LOG_FILE.exists():
        return []
    rows = []
    try:
        lines = LOG_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
        for line in reversed(lines):
            if len(rows) >= limit:
                break
            try:
                item = json.loads(line)
            except Exception:
                continue
            rel = item.get("path")
            if isinstance(rel, str) and rel:
                abs_path = PROJECT_ROOT / rel
                if not abs_path.exists():
                    continue
            rows.append(item)
    except Exception:
        return []
    return rows

import time

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException

@router.get("/health")
def data_health(db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict:
    """
    Health check del módulo de datos/DB. Ejecuta un SELECT 1 para validar conexión.
    """
    started = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        db.execute(text("SELECT 1"))
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"DB unreachable: {exc}") from exc
    elapsed_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, 2)
    return {"status": "ok", "db": "up", "latency_ms": elapsed_ms}

def _decode_jwt_token(token: str, required_scope: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[dict]:
    """
    Best-effort JWT decode. Returns payload or None if invalid/missing.
    Raises 403 if token is valid but lacks required scope.
    """
    if not token or not JWT_SECRET or jwt is None:
        return None
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(
          token,
          JWT_SECRET,
          algorithms=[JWT_ALG],
          options={"verify_aud": False},
          leeway=JWT_LEEWAY,
        )
    except Exception:
        return None

    scopes = _normalize_scopes(payload.get("scopes") or payload.get("scope"))
    if required_scope and required_scope not in scopes:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: missing scope")
    # exp check is handled by jwt.decode; if expired, decode raises.
    return payload

def _require_key(
    request: Request,
    x_api_key: Optional[str],
    authorization: Optional[str],
    *,
    allowed_envs: tuple[str, ...],
    required_scope: Optional[str] = None,
    misconfig_detail: str = "Server auth misconfigured: set AEGIS_API_KEY or set AEGIS_AUTH_MODE=off",
) -> None:
    """
    API key guard.

    Env:
      - AEGIS_AUTH_MODE = on | off | local
      - AEGIS_API_KEY   = comma-separated keys, e.g. "devkey123,prodkey456"

    Headers supported:
      - X-API-Key: <key>
      - Authorization: Bearer <key>
      - aegis_access_token cookie (HttpOnly)
    """
    mode = AUTH_MODE

    # 1) Auth disabled completely
    if mode == "off":
        return

    # 2) Load allowed keys
    allowed = _load_keys_from_env(*allowed_envs)

    # 3) In local mode, allow localhost without a key (dev convenience)
    if mode == "local" and _is_local_request(request):
        return

    # 4) If auth is ON but there are no static keys and no JWT secret, fail closed.
    #    If JWT secret exists, allow JWT-only auth mode.
    if mode == "on" and not allowed and not JWT_SECRET:
        if _is_local_request(request):
            return
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail=misconfig_detail,
        )

    # 5) Otherwise, require a valid key/token
    api_key = _extract_api_key(x_api_key)
    bearer_token = _extract_bearer_token(authorization)
    cookie_token = _extract_cookie_token(request, ACCESS_COOKIE_NAME)

    # Accept raw API key
    if allowed and ((api_key and api_key in allowed) or (bearer_token and bearer_token in allowed)):

    """
    API key guard.

    Env:
      - AEGIS_AUTH_MODE = on | off | local
      - AEGIS_API_KEY   = comma-separated keys, e.g. "devkey123,prodkey456"

    Headers supported:
      - X-API-Key: <key>
      - Authorization: Bearer <key>
      - aegis_access_token cookie (HttpOnly)
    """
    mode = AUTH_MODE

    # 1) Auth disabled completely
    if mode == "off":
        return

    # 2) Load allowed keys
    allowed = _load_keys_from_env(*allowed_envs)

    # 3) In local mode, allow localhost without a key (dev convenience)
    if mode == "local" and _is_local_request(request):
        return

    # 4) If auth is ON but there are no static keys and no JWT secret, fail closed.
    #    If JWT secret exists, allow JWT-only auth mode.
    if mode == "on" and not allowed and not JWT_SECRET:
        if _is_local_request(request):
            return
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail=misconfig_detail,
        )

    # 5) Otherwise, require a valid key/token
    api_key = _extract_api_key(x_api_key)
    bearer_token = _extract_bearer_token(authorization)
    cookie_token = _extract_cookie_token(request, ACCESS_COOKIE_NAME)

    # Accept raw API key
    if allowed and ((api_key and api_key in allowed) or (bearer_token and bearer_token in allowed)):
        return

    # Accept cookie-bound JWT issued by /auth/token or /auth/refresh.
    payload = _decode_jwt_token(cookie_token, required_scope=required_scope)
    if payload:
        return

    # Accept JWT with scope (Authorization bearer token preferred).
    payload = _decode_jwt_token(bearer_token, required_scope=required_scope)
    if payload:
        return

    # Compatibility: allow JWT passed via X-API-Key.

from __future__ import annotations

"""
Aggregate API router composition.

Why this module exists:
- Build the canonical HTTP surface from feature routers.
- Keep env-driven enable/disable logic centralized.
- Always mount legacy `/tools/*` as deterministic 410 shim.
"""

import importlib
import logging
import os

from fastapi import APIRouter
from app.api.router_status import record_router_status

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

router = APIRouter()

def _env_flag(name: str, default: str = "1") -> bool:
    """Parse feature flags from env using AEGIS boolean conventions."""
    return (os.getenv(name, default) or default).strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}


def _include_router(module_path: str, label: str) -> None:
    """Best-effort include for optional routers; logs and skips on import failures."""
    try:
        mod = importlib.import_module(module_path)
        sub_router = getattr(mod, "router", None)
        if sub_router is None:
            logger.warning("Skipping router '%s': %s has no attribute 'router'.", label, module_path)
            record_router_status(label, enabled=True, mounted=False, detail="missing-router-attribute")
            return
        router.include_router(sub_router)
        record_router_status(label, enabled=True, mounted=True, detail="ok")
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        logger.warning(
            "Skipping router '%s' due to import error (%s): %s",
            label,
            module_path,
            str(exc)[:200],
        )
        record_router_status(label, enabled=True, mounted=False, detail=f"import-error:{str(exc)[:200]}")


_ROUTER_SPECS = [
    ("AEGIS_ENABLE_CHAT_API", "1", "app.api.chat", "chat"),
    ("AEGIS_ENABLE_CRYPTO_API", "1", "app.api.crypto", "crypto"),
    ("AEGIS_ENABLE_DATA_API", "1", "app.api.data", "data"),
    ("AEGIS_ENABLE_NOTIFICATIONS_API", "1", "app.api.notifications", "notifications"),
    ("AEGIS_ENABLE_SYSTEM_API", "1", "app.api.system", "system"),
    ("AEGIS_ENABLE_ADMIN_API", "1", "app.core.admin", "admin"),
    ("AEGIS_ENABLE_AUTH_API", "1", "app.api.auth", "auth"),
    ("AEGIS_ENABLE_IMAGE_API", "1", "app.api.image", "image"),
]

for flag, default, module_path, label in _ROUTER_SPECS:
    if _env_flag(flag, default=default):
        _include_router(module_path, label)
    else:
        logger.info("Router '%s' disabled via %s=0", label, flag)
        record_router_status(label, enabled=False, mounted=False, detail=f"{flag}=0")

# Legacy tools router stays mounted so `/tools/*` returns a deterministic 410 Gone.
_include_router("app.api.toolssupport", "toolssupport")

ENABLE_META_API = _env_flag("AEGIS_ENABLE_META_API", default="0")

if ENABLE_META_API:
    _include_router("app.core.meta", "meta")
else:
    record_router_status("meta", enabled=False, mounted=False, detail="AEGIS_ENABLE_META_API=0")


@router.get("/health")
async def health() -> dict:
    """Tiny aggregate health endpoint for router composition sanity."""
    return {"status": "ok"}

def _runtime_profile() -> str:

class LLMProviderUpdateRequest(BaseModel):
    provider: str


def _normalize_llm_provider(provider: str) -> str:
    value = str(provider or '').strip().lower()
    if value == 'cloud':
        return 'groq'
    if value in {'local', 'groq', 'auto'}:
        return value
    raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail='provider must be one of: local, cloud, groq, auto')


def _llm_provider_payload(capabilities: Dict[str, Any] | None = None, *, updated: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    caps = capabilities or collect_runtime_capabilities()
    llm_config = _resources_snapshot(caps).get('llm_config') or {}
    configured = str(llm_config.get('provider') or '')
    effective = str(llm_config.get('effective_provider') or '')
    model = str(llm_config.get('model') or '')
    remote_ready = bool(llm_config.get('remote_ready'))
    options = [
        {
            'id': 'local',
            'provider': 'local',
            'label': 'Local',
            'description': 'Local GGUF model. Best when you want offline execution and local-only fallback.',
        },
        {
            'id': 'cloud',
            'provider': 'groq',
            'label': 'Cloud',
            'description': 'Groq remote model. Best for faster general chat and stronger reasoning when configured.',
        },
    ]
    return {
        'ok': True,
        'updated': bool(updated),
        'configured_provider': configured,
        'effective_provider': effective,
        'model': model,
        'remote_ready': remote_ready,
        'options': options,
    }


def _resources_snapshot(capabilities: Dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Collect runtime resource telemetry used by system endpoints/UI."""
    caps = capabilities or {}
    llm = dict(caps.get("llm") or {})

    cpu_count = os.cpu_count() or 0
    try:
        load1, load5, load15 = os.getloadavg()

async def system_snapshot() -> Dict[str, Any]:

    What it does:

    Why it exists:
    - Centralize runtime truth in one endpoint instead of scattered checks.

    Called from ->
    - Status/session panel in UI
    - Operational and debugging checks

    Calls ->
    - capabilities_service (runtime probes)
    - runtime_metrics + validation_state
    - crypto snapshot helpers (predictions/PnL)
    """
    probe = (os.getenv("AEGIS_READYZ_PROBE_WEB", "0") or "0").strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}
    probe_query = (os.getenv("AEGIS_READYZ_WEB_QUERY") or "python fastapi").strip() or "python fastapi"
    capabilities = collect_runtime_capabilities(
        probe_web=probe,
        probe_web_query=probe_query,
        probe_web_results=1,

    summary = summarize_runtime_capabilities(capabilities)
    jobs = [job_manager.serialize_job(j) for j in job_manager.list_jobs(limit=5)]
    preds = crypto_prediction_log.pair_predictions_with_outcomes(limit=10)
    stats = crypto_prediction_log.recent_stats(limit=200)
    pnl = _pnl_snapshot()
    crypto_state = build_crypto_state_snapshot(limit=10, trade_limit=50, leaderboard_limit=6)
    health = health_state.snapshot()
    metrics = runtime_metrics.snapshot()
    metrics_alerts = _runtime_metrics_alerts(metrics)
    durable = durable_memory_snapshot()
    llm_config = _resources_snapshot(capabilities)["llm_config"]
    comp = build_comp_snapshot(
        None,

def _query_default_value(value: Any) -> Any:
    if hasattr(value, "default") and value.__class__.__module__.startswith("fastapi"):
        default = getattr(value, "default", None)
        return None if default is Ellipsis else default
    return value


def _optional_query_int(value: Any) -> Optional[int]:
    raw = _query_default_value(value)
    if raw in {None, ""}:
        return None
    return int(raw)


def _optional_query_text(value: Any) -> Optional[str]:
    raw = _query_default_value(value)
    text = str(raw or "").strip()

def _env_float(name: str, default: float) -> float:
    raw = str(os.getenv(name) or "").strip()
    if not raw:
        return float(default)
    try:
        return float(raw)
    except Exception:
        return float(default)

def _execution_profile(
    *,
    symbol_pair: str,
    side: str,
    quantity: float,
    mid_price: float,
    execution_mode: str,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Build a deterministic, demo-friendly execution profile.

    The goal is to make the simulated path feel closer to a real market:
    spread, slippage and market impact grow with notional size and less liquid
    symbols, while staying fully deterministic and safe.
    """
    base_asset = _base_symbol_from_pair(symbol_pair)
    mode = str(execution_mode or "simulated").strip().lower()
    if mode not in {"simulated", "testnet", "live"}:
        mode = "simulated"

    notional = max(0.0, float(quantity) * float(mid_price))
    liquidity_bucket = _liquidity_bucket_for_notional(notional)
    base_spread_bps = (
        4.0
        if base_asset in {"BTC", "ETH"}
        else 7.0
        if base_asset in {"BNB", "SOL", "XRP", "ADA", "DOGE", "LINK", "AVAX", "MATIC", "TRX"}
        else 11.0
    )
    mode_spread_bias = {"simulated": 4.0, "testnet": 2.0, "live": 1.0}[mode]
    bucket_impact = {
        "micro": 1.5,
        "small": 3.0,
        "medium": 6.0,
        "large": 12.0,
        "whale": 20.0,
    }[liquidity_bucket]
    size_impact = min(28.0, math.log10(max(notional, 1.0) + 1.0) * 2.4)
    spread_bps = round(base_spread_bps + mode_spread_bias, 2)
    impact_bps = round(bucket_impact + size_impact, 2)
    slippage_bps = round(spread_bps / 2.0 + impact_bps, 2)
    signed_slippage_bps = slippage_bps if side.upper() == "BUY" else -slippage_bps
    fill_price = round(float(mid_price) * (1.0 + signed_slippage_bps / 10000.0), 2)
    execution_note = (
        f"{liquidity_bucket} liquidity • STP/ECN-style fill • "
        f"spread {spread_bps:.1f}bps • slippage {slippage_bps:.1f}bps • "
        f"impact {impact_bps:.1f}bps"
    )
    return {
        "mid_price": round(float(mid_price), 2),
        "fill_price": fill_price,
        "spread_bps": spread_bps,
        "slippage_bps": slippage_bps,
        "impact_bps": impact_bps,
        "liquidity_bucket": liquidity_bucket,
        "notional": round(notional, 2),
        "execution_note": execution_note,
        "signed_slippage_bps": signed_slippage_bps,
    }

def _evaluate_trade_risk_gate(
    *,
    symbol_pair: str,
    side: str,
    quantity: float,
    current_price: Optional[float],
    latest_prediction: Optional[Dict[str, Any]],
    risk: Optional[Dict[str, Any]],
    position_snapshot: Optional[Dict[str, Any]],
    policy: Optional[Dict[str, float]] = None,
    enforce_book_checks: bool = True,
    enforce_signal_gate: bool = True,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    policy = dict(policy or {})
    decision = str((risk or {}).get("decision") or (latest_prediction or {}).get("action_decision") or (latest_prediction or {}).get("decision") or "HOLD").strip().upper() or "HOLD"
    signal_tradeable = bool((risk or {}).get("tradeable")) if risk is not None else decision in {"BUY", "SELL"}
    side_norm = str(side or "").strip().upper()
    qty = max(0.0, float(quantity or 0.0))
    current_px = max(0.0, float(_optional_float(current_price) or 0.0))
    position = float((position_snapshot or {}).get("position") or 0.0)
    avg_price = _optional_float((position_snapshot or {}).get("avg_price"))
    exposure_basis = current_px if current_px > 0 else max(0.0, avg_price or 0.0)
    current_exposure_quote = max(0.0, abs(position) * exposure_basis)
    order_notional = _optional_float((risk or {}).get("order_notional")) or (qty * exposure_basis if exposure_basis > 0 else 0.0)
    order_size_pct = _optional_float((risk or {}).get("order_size_pct")) or 0.0
    visible_liquidity_notional = _optional_float((risk or {}).get("visible_liquidity_notional")) or 0.0
    sign = 1.0 if side_norm == "BUY" else -1.0
    post_position = position + sign * qty
    post_exposure_quote = max(0.0, abs(post_position) * exposure_basis)
    risk_reducing = bool(position and abs(post_position) + 1e-12 < abs(position))
    latest_present = latest_prediction is not None
    operator_guidance = _prediction_operator_guidance(latest_prediction)
    calibration_controls = dict(_trade_calibration_controls(operator_guidance) or {}) or None
    operator_guidance_status = _operator_guidance_status(operator_guidance)
    operator_guidance_reason = "not_available"
    operator_guidance_ok = True
    if operator_guidance_status:
        if _should_calibration_abstain(operator_guidance) and not risk_reducing:
            operator_guidance_ok = False
            operator_guidance_reason = "calibration_abstain"
        elif operator_guidance_status == "downgrade":
            operator_guidance_reason = "calibration_downgrade"
        else:
            operator_guidance_reason = f"calibration_{operator_guidance_status}"

    calibration_max_order_size_pct = _optional_float(
        (calibration_controls or {}).get("max_order_size_pct") if isinstance(calibration_controls, dict) else None
    )
    calibration_max_order_notional: Optional[float] = None
    calibration_max_quantity: Optional[float] = None
    calibration_reduction_pct: Optional[float] = None
    calibration_basis: Optional[str] = None
    if calibration_max_order_size_pct is not None and calibration_max_order_size_pct > 0:
        if visible_liquidity_notional > 0:
            calibration_max_order_notional = visible_liquidity_notional * (calibration_max_order_size_pct / 100.0)
            calibration_basis = "visible_liquidity_notional"
        elif order_size_pct > 0 and order_notional > 0:
            calibration_max_order_notional = order_notional * (calibration_max_order_size_pct / order_size_pct)
            calibration_basis = "order_size_pct"
        if calibration_max_order_notional is not None and order_notional > 0 and qty > 0:
            sizing_ratio = max(0.0, min(1.0, calibration_max_order_notional / order_notional))
            calibration_max_quantity = qty * sizing_ratio
            calibration_reduction_pct = max(0.0, 1.0 - sizing_ratio)
        if isinstance(calibration_controls, dict):
            calibration_controls["max_order_notional"] = round(calibration_max_order_notional, 2) if calibration_max_order_notional is not None else None
            calibration_controls["max_quantity"] = round(calibration_max_quantity, 8) if calibration_max_quantity is not None else None
            calibration_controls["recommended_reduction_pct"] = round(calibration_reduction_pct, 6) if calibration_reduction_pct is not None else None
            calibration_controls["sizing_basis"] = calibration_basis
    signal_ok = True
    signal_reason = "no_prediction"
    if latest_present:
        if risk_reducing:
            signal_ok = True
            signal_reason = "risk_reducing_exit"
        elif decision == "HOLD":
            signal_ok = False
            signal_reason = "signal_hold"
        elif decision != side_norm:
            signal_ok = False
            signal_reason = "signal_mismatch"
        else:
            signal_reason = "signal_aligned"

    checks: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {
        "signal_alignment": {
            "ok": signal_ok,
            "value": decision if latest_present else None,
            "reason": signal_reason,
        },
        "risk_reducing": {
            "ok": risk_reducing,
            "value": risk_reducing,
        },
        "position_quote": {
            "ok": True,
            "value": round(current_exposure_quote, 2),
        },
        "post_position_quote": {
            "ok": True,
            "value": round(post_exposure_quote, 2),
        },
        "operator_guidance": {
            "ok": operator_guidance_ok,
            "value": operator_guidance_status or None,
            "reason": operator_guidance_reason,
            "action": (calibration_controls or {}).get("action") if isinstance(calibration_controls, dict) else None,
            "reasons": (calibration_controls or {}).get("reasons") if isinstance(calibration_controls, dict) else [],
        },

def _build_trade_preview(
    *,
    order: TradeRequest,
    horizon_minutes: Optional[int] = None,
    regime: Optional[str] = None,
    use_order_book: bool = True,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if order.quantity <= 0:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="quantity must be > 0")

    symbol_pair = _normalize_binance_pair(order.symbol)
    if not symbol_pair:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Missing symbol")

    requested_mode = order.execution_mode or ("testnet" if order.test else None) or os.getenv("BINANCE_EXECUTION_MODE", "simulated")
    exec_snapshot = _crypto_execution_snapshot(requested_mode=requested_mode)
    execution_mode = exec_snapshot["mode"]
    api_key = (os.getenv("BINANCE_API_KEY") or "").strip()
    api_secret = (os.getenv("BINANCE_API_SECRET") or "").strip()
    live_trading_enabled = (os.getenv("BINANCE_LIVE_TRADING", "0") or "0").strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}
    if execution_mode == "live" and not (api_key and api_secret and live_trading_enabled):
        execution_mode = "simulated"
    if execution_mode == "testnet" and not (api_key and api_secret):
        execution_mode = "simulated"

    price_live = _binance_spot_price(symbol_pair)
    mid_price = float(price_live if price_live is not None else (100 + (hash(symbol_pair) % 500)))
    execution_profile = _execution_profile(
        symbol_pair=symbol_pair,
        side=order.side,
        quantity=order.quantity,
        mid_price=mid_price,
        execution_mode=execution_mode,
    )
    preview_trade = {
        "symbol": symbol_pair,
        "side": order.side,
        "quantity": order.quantity,
        "price": execution_profile.get("fill_price"),
        "mid_price": execution_profile.get("mid_price"),
        "fill_price": execution_profile.get("fill_price"),
        "spread_bps": execution_profile.get("spread_bps"),
        "slippage_bps": execution_profile.get("slippage_bps"),
        "impact_bps": execution_profile.get("impact_bps"),
        "liquidity_bucket": execution_profile.get("liquidity_bucket"),
        "notional": execution_profile.get("notional"),
        "execution_note": execution_profile.get("execution_note"),
        "execution_mode": execution_mode,
        "status": "SIMULATED",
    }

    scope_snapshot = build_crypto_state_snapshot(
        symbol=symbol_pair,
        horizon_minutes=horizon_minutes,
        regime=regime,
        limit=5,
        trade_limit=20,
        price_lookup=_binance_spot_price,
        order_book_lookup=(lambda sym: _binance_order_book(sym, limit=10)) if use_order_book else None,
        execution_snapshot=exec_snapshot,
    )
    latest_prediction = scope_snapshot.get("latest_prediction") if isinstance(scope_snapshot, dict) else None
    risk = _risk_snapshot(
        latest_prediction=latest_prediction if isinstance(latest_prediction, dict) else None,
        latest_trade=preview_trade,
        current_price=mid_price,
        execution_snapshot=exec_snapshot,
        trade_side=order.side,
        order_book_snapshot=(scope_snapshot or {}).get("order_book") if isinstance(scope_snapshot, dict) else None,
    )

    entry_price = _optional_float((risk or {}).get("entry_price")) or float(execution_profile.get("fill_price"))
    predicted_price = _optional_float((risk or {}).get("predicted_price"))
    target_price = _optional_float((risk or {}).get("target_price"))
    stop_price = _optional_float((risk or {}).get("stop_price"))
    qty = float(order.quantity)
    position_snapshot = _position_snapshot_from_pnl(
        symbol_pair=symbol_pair,
        current_price=entry_price,
        pnl=(scope_snapshot or {}).get("pnl") if isinstance(scope_snapshot, dict) else None,
        trades_count=len((scope_snapshot or {}).get("trades") or []) if isinstance(scope_snapshot, dict) else 0,
    )
    risk_gate = _evaluate_trade_risk_gate(
        symbol_pair=symbol_pair,
        side=order.side,
        quantity=qty,
        current_price=entry_price,
        latest_prediction=latest_prediction if isinstance(latest_prediction, dict) else None,
        risk=risk,
        position_snapshot=position_snapshot,
        policy=_crypto_risk_policy(order),
        enforce_book_checks=use_order_book,
        enforce_signal_gate=False,
    )

    expected_gain_quote = None
    expected_loss_quote = None
    if predicted_price is not None and entry_price > 0:
        if order.side == "BUY":
            expected_gain_quote = max(0.0, (predicted_price - entry_price) * qty)
        else:
            expected_gain_quote = max(0.0, (entry_price - predicted_price) * qty)
    if stop_price is not None and entry_price > 0:
        if order.side == "BUY":
            expected_loss_quote = max(0.0, (entry_price - stop_price) * qty)
        else:
            expected_loss_quote = max(0.0, (stop_price - entry_price) * qty)

    latest_prediction_ref = scope_snapshot.get("latest_prediction_ref") if isinstance(scope_snapshot, dict) else None
    return {
        "symbol": symbol_pair,
        "side": order.side,
        "quantity": order.quantity,
        "price": execution_profile.get("fill_price"),
        "mid_price": execution_profile.get("mid_price"),
        "fill_price": execution_profile.get("fill_price"),
        "spread_bps": execution_profile.get("spread_bps"),
        "slippage_bps": execution_profile.get("slippage_bps"),
        "impact_bps": execution_profile.get("impact_bps"),
        "liquidity_bucket": execution_profile.get("liquidity_bucket"),
        "notional": execution_profile.get("notional"),
        "execution_note": execution_profile.get("execution_note"),
        "execution_mode": execution_mode,
        "requested_mode": exec_snapshot.get("mode") if isinstance(exec_snapshot, dict) else None,
        "horizon_minutes": horizon_minutes,
        "regime": regime,
        "current_price": mid_price,
        "predicted_price": predicted_price,
        "signal_decision": str((latest_prediction or {}).get("action_decision") or (latest_prediction or {}).get("decision") or "HOLD").strip().upper() or "HOLD",
        "signal_probability_up": _optional_float((latest_prediction or {}).get("probability_up")),
        "entry_price": entry_price,
        "target_price": target_price,
        "stop_price": stop_price,
        "expected_gain_quote": round(expected_gain_quote, 2) if expected_gain_quote is not None else None,
        "expected_loss_quote": round(expected_loss_quote, 2) if expected_loss_quote is not None else None,
        "expected_pnl_pct": _optional_float((risk or {}).get("expected_pnl_pct")),
        "risk_reward": _optional_float((risk or {}).get("risk_reward")),
        "projected_move_pct": _optional_float((risk or {}).get("projected_move_pct")),
        "execution_drag_pct": _optional_float((risk or {}).get("execution_drag_pct")),
        "confidence": _optional_float((risk or {}).get("confidence")),
        "confidence_bucket": str((risk or {}).get("confidence_bucket") or "").strip() or None,
        "order_notional": _optional_float((risk or {}).get("order_notional")),
        "visible_liquidity_notional": _optional_float((risk or {}).get("visible_liquidity_notional")),
        "side_liquidity_notional": _optional_float((risk or {}).get("side_liquidity_notional")),
        "order_size_pct": _optional_float((risk or {}).get("order_size_pct")),
        "book_consumption_pct": _optional_float((risk or {}).get("book_consumption_pct")),
        "participation_pct": _optional_float((risk or {}).get("participation_pct")),

def _crypto_policy_snapshot(
    *,
    symbol: str,
    horizon_minutes: int,
    regime: Optional[str],
    prediction_engine: str,
    model_used: str,
    model_decision: str,
    action_decision: str,
    p_up: float,
    buy_threshold: float,
    sell_threshold: float,
    credibility: Optional[Dict[str, Any]],
    operator_guidance: Optional[Dict[str, Any]],
    consensus_metrics: Optional[Dict[str, Any]],
    threshold_rec: Optional[Dict[str, Any]],
    require_trained: bool,
    execution_margin: Optional[float] = None,
    consensus_requirements: Optional[Dict[str, float]] = None,
    execution_gate_reason: Optional[str] = None,
    adaptive_policy: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    confidence = max(0.0, min(1.0, max(p_up, 1.0 - p_up)))
    if confidence >= 0.8:
        confidence_bucket = "high"
    elif confidence >= 0.62:
        confidence_bucket = "medium"
    else:
        confidence_bucket = "low"

    operator_status = _operator_guidance_status(operator_guidance)
    if execution_margin is None:
        execution_margin = _effective_execution_margin(credibility, operator_guidance)
    if consensus_requirements is None:
        consensus_requirements = _effective_consensus_requirements(credibility, operator_guidance)

    route_mode = "trained" if prediction_engine == "trained" else "demo"
    route_reason = "trained_model_available" if prediction_engine == "trained" else "demo_fallback"
    if require_trained and prediction_engine != "trained":
        route_reason = "trained_required_unavailable"
    elif isinstance(credibility, dict) and bool(credibility.get("should_abstain")):
        route_reason = "credibility_abstain"
    elif _should_calibration_abstain(operator_guidance):
        route_reason = "calibration_abstain"
    elif execution_gate_reason:
        route_reason = execution_gate_reason
    elif action_decision in {"BUY", "SELL"} and threshold_rec:
        route_reason = "threshold_edge_passed"
    elif action_decision == "HOLD" and model_decision in {"BUY", "SELL"}:
        route_reason = "calibration_downgrade" if operator_status == "downgrade" else str((credibility or {}).get("status") or "gated")

    return {
        "symbol": symbol,
        "horizon_minutes": horizon_minutes,
        "regime": regime,
        "route_mode": route_mode,
        "route_reason": route_reason,
        "model_used": model_used,
        "model_decision": model_decision,
        "action_decision": action_decision,
        "actionable": action_decision in {"BUY", "SELL"},
        "confidence": confidence,
        "confidence_bucket": confidence_bucket,
        "thresholds": {
            "buy": buy_threshold,
            "sell": sell_threshold,
            "threshold_strategy": threshold_rec,
        },
        "credibility": credibility,
        "operator_guidance": operator_guidance,
        "should_abstain": _effective_should_abstain(credibility, operator_guidance),
        "consensus": consensus_metrics,
        "gates": {
            "execution_margin": execution_margin,
            "calibration_margin": _calibration_margin_for_operator_guidance(operator_guidance),
            "required_support_ratio": (consensus_requirements or {}).get("min_support_ratio"),
            "required_max_spread": (consensus_requirements or {}).get("max_spread"),
        },
        "policy_profile": _crypto_policy_profile(),
        "adaptive_policy": adaptive_policy,
    }

def _adaptive_crypto_threshold_strategy(
    *,
    symbol: str,
    horizon_minutes: int,
    regime: Optional[str],
    limit: int,
    engine: Optional[str] = "trained",
    fee_bps: float = 10.0,
    slippage_bps: float = 5.0,
    min_trades: int = CRYPTO_THRESHOLD_MIN_TRADES,
    include_preview: bool = False,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    recommendation = optimize_thresholds(
        limit=limit,
        symbol=symbol,
        engine=engine,
        horizon_minutes=horizon_minutes,
        regime=regime,
        fee_bps=fee_bps,
        slippage_bps=slippage_bps,
        min_trades=min_trades,
    )
    leaderboard_preview: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    champion: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    champion_scope = "none"
    strategy_source = "exact_scope" if recommendation is not None else "defaults"
    fallback_used = recommendation is None

    if include_preview or recommendation is None:
        leaderboard_preview = scope_leaderboard(
            limit=limit,
            engine=engine,
            fee_bps=fee_bps,
            slippage_bps=slippage_bps,
            min_trades=min_trades,
            top_n=3,
        )
        if recommendation is None and leaderboard_preview:
            champion, champion_scope = _best_crypto_leaderboard_candidate(
                leaderboard_preview,
                symbol=symbol,
                horizon_minutes=horizon_minutes,
                regime=regime,
            )
            if champion is not None:
                recommendation = dict(champion)
                strategy_source = f"leaderboard:{champion_scope}"
                fallback_used = True

    if recommendation is None:
        recommendation = _crypto_default_threshold_strategy()

    return {
        "selected_strategy": recommendation,
        "strategy_source": strategy_source,
        "fallback_used": fallback_used,
        "champion": champion,
        "champion_scope": champion_scope,
        "leaderboard_preview": leaderboard_preview,
        "performance": (
            _adaptive_crypto_performance_snapshot(
                symbol=symbol,
                horizon_minutes=horizon_minutes,
                regime=regime,
                engine=engine,
                limit=limit,
                fee_bps=fee_bps,
                slippage_bps=slippage_bps,
            )
            if include_preview
            else None
        ),
    }

def _binance_spot_price(symbol: str) -> Optional[float]:
    pair = _normalize_binance_pair(symbol)
    if not pair:
        return None
    now = time.time()
    if PRICE_CACHE_TTL > 0:
        with _price_lock:
            cached = _price_cache.get(pair)
        if cached and now - cached[1] <= PRICE_CACHE_TTL:
            return cached[0]
    price_val: Optional[float] = None
    source = None
    try:
        resp = requests.get(
            f"{_binance_base_url()}/api/v3/ticker/price",
            params={"symbol": pair},
            timeout=6,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        data = resp.json()
        price_str = data.get("price") or data.get("lastPrice")
        price_val = float(price_str) if price_str is not None else None
        source = "binance"
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        logger.warning("Binance price fetch failed for %s: %s", pair, exc)

    if price_val is None:
        price_val = _coingecko_spot_price(pair.replace("USDT", ""))
        if price_val is not None:
            source = "coingecko"

    if price_val is None and PRICE_CACHE_TTL > 0:
        with _price_lock:
            cached = _price_cache.get(pair)
        if cached:
            _price_source[pair] = "cache"
            return cached[0]

    if price_val is not None and PRICE_CACHE_TTL > 0:
        with _price_lock:
            _price_cache[pair] = (price_val, now)
        if source:
            _price_source[pair] = source
    return price_val

def _parse_levels(levels: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        parsed: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        for row in list(levels or [])[:depth_limit]:
            try:
                price = float(row[0])
                qty = float(row[1])
            except Exception:
                continue
            parsed.append(
                {
                    "price": round(price, 2),
                    "qty": round(qty, 8),
                    "notional": round(price * qty, 2),
                }
            )
        return parsed

    bids = _parse_levels(raw.get("bids")) if raw else []
    asks = _parse_levels(raw.get("asks")) if raw else []
    if not bids or not asks:
        source = "synthetic"
        mid = float(_binance_spot_price(sym) or (100 + (hash(sym) % 500)))
        base_asset = _base_symbol_from_pair(sym)
        base_spread_bps = (
            4.5
            if base_asset in {"BTC", "ETH"}
            else 7.5
            if base_asset in {"BNB", "SOL", "XRP", "ADA", "DOGE", "LINK", "AVAX", "MATIC", "TRX"}
            else 11.5
        )
        rng = random.Random(hash(("depth", sym)))
        spread_bps = round(max(2.0, base_spread_bps + rng.uniform(-0.7, 1.6)), 2)
        best_bid = round(mid * (1.0 - (spread_bps / 2.0) / 10000.0), 2)
        best_ask = round(mid * (1.0 + (spread_bps / 2.0) / 10000.0), 2)
        total_quote = 0.0
        if base_asset in {"BTC", "ETH"}:
            total_quote = 10000.0
        elif base_asset in {"BNB", "SOL", "XRP", "ADA", "DOGE", "LINK", "AVAX", "MATIC", "TRX"}:
            total_quote = 6000.0
        else:
            total_quote = 3000.0

        bids = []
        asks = []
        for idx in range(depth_limit):
            decay = 0.88 ** idx
            bid_level_price = round(mid * (1.0 - ((spread_bps / 2.0) + idx * max(0.9, spread_bps * 0.28)) / 10000.0), 2)
            ask_level_price = round(mid * (1.0 + ((spread_bps / 2.0) + idx * max(0.9, spread_bps * 0.28)) / 10000.0), 2)
            bid_quote = total_quote * decay * rng.uniform(0.75, 1.2)
            ask_quote = total_quote * decay * rng.uniform(0.75, 1.2)
            bid_qty = round(max(0.0000001, bid_quote / max(bid_level_price, 1e-8)), 8)
            ask_qty = round(max(0.0000001, ask_quote / max(ask_level_price, 1e-8)), 8)
            bids.append({"price": bid_level_price, "qty": bid_qty, "notional": round(bid_level_price * bid_qty, 2)})
            asks.append({"price": ask_level_price, "qty": ask_qty, "notional": round(ask_level_price * ask_qty, 2)})
    else:
        best_bid = bids[0]["price"]
        best_ask = asks[0]["price"]
        mid = round((best_bid + best_ask) / 2.0, 2)
        spread_bps = round(((best_ask - best_bid) / mid) * 10000.0 if mid else 0.0, 2)

    bid_qty = round(sum(float(level["qty"]) for level in bids), 8)
    ask_qty = round(sum(float(level["qty"]) for level in asks), 8)
    bid_notional = round(sum(float(level["notional"]) for level in bids), 2)
    ask_notional = round(sum(float(level["notional"]) for level in asks), 2)
    imbalance = 0.5
    total_notional = bid_notional + ask_notional
    if total_notional > 0:
        imbalance = round(bid_notional / total_notional, 4)

    liquidity_bucket = _liquidity_bucket_for_notional(max(bid_notional, ask_notional, total_notional / 2.0))
    return {
        "symbol": sym,
        "source": source,
        "levels": depth_limit,
        "mid_price": round(float(mid), 2),
        "best_bid": round(float(best_bid), 2),
        "best_ask": round(float(best_ask), 2),
        "spread": round(float(best_ask - best_bid), 2),
        "spread_bps": round(float(spread_bps), 2),
        "imbalance": imbalance,
        "bid_qty": bid_qty,
        "ask_qty": ask_qty,
        "bid_notional": bid_notional,
        "ask_notional": ask_notional,
        "liquidity_bucket": liquidity_bucket,
        "bids": bids[:depth_limit],
        "asks": asks[:depth_limit],
        "note": (
            f"{source} order book • spread {spread_bps:.1f}bps • "
            f"imbalance {imbalance * 100:.1f}% bid side"
        ),
    }

def _binance_signed_request(
    *,
    method: str,
    path: str,
    params: Dict[str, Any],
    api_key: str,
    api_secret: str,
    base_url: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    base = base_url or _binance_base_url()
    query = urlencode(params)
    signature = hmac.new(api_secret.encode(), query.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    url = f"{base}{path}?{query}&signature={signature}"
    headers = {"X-MBX-APIKEY": api_key}

    try:
        resp = requests.request(method, url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.json() if resp.text else {}
    except requests.HTTPError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=resp.status_code, detail=resp.text) from exc
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail=f"Binance request failed: {exc}") from exc

def _build_feature_window_frame(pd, symbol_pair: str, candles: List[OhlcvItem], interval_minutes: int) -> Any:
    if not candles:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    steps_24h = max(1, int(round(1440 / max(interval_minutes, 1))))
    closes = [float(item.close) for item in candles]
    highs = [float(item.high) for item in candles]
    lows = [float(item.low) for item in candles]
    vols = [float(item.volume) for item in candles]
    for idx, item in enumerate(candles):
        lo = max(0, idx - steps_24h + 1)
        window_closes = closes[lo : idx + 1]
        window_highs = highs[lo : idx + 1]
        window_lows = lows[lo : idx + 1]
        window_vols = vols[lo : idx + 1]
        ref_idx = idx - steps_24h
        change_24h = 0.0
        if ref_idx >= 0 and closes[ref_idx] > 0:
            change_24h = ((item.close / closes[ref_idx]) - 1.0) * 100.0
        rows.append(
            {
                "symbol": _base_symbol_from_pair(symbol_pair).lower(),
                "binance_symbol": symbol_pair,
                "timestamp": int(item.ts),
                "open": float(item.open),
                "high": float(item.high),
                "low": float(item.low),
                "close": float(item.close),
                "current_price": float(item.close),
                "high_24h": max(window_highs) if window_highs else float(item.high),
                "low_24h": min(window_lows) if window_lows else float(item.low),
                "total_volume": float(sum(window_vols)),
                "change_24h": float(change_24h),
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

def _estimate_predicted_price(
    *,
    current: float,
    probability_up: float,
    df_enriched,
    horizon_minutes: int,
    interval_minutes: int,
) -> float:
    horizon_steps = max(1, int(round(horizon_minutes / max(interval_minutes, 1))))
    row = df_enriched.iloc[-1] if len(df_enriched) else {}
    rolling_vol = abs(float(row.get("rolling_vol_14") or 0.0))
    atr = abs(float(row.get("atr_14") or 0.0))
    atr_pct = (atr / current) if current > 0 else 0.0
    base_move = max(rolling_vol, atr_pct, 0.0025)
    scaled_move = min(0.08, max(0.003, base_move * math.sqrt(max(horizon_steps, 1))))
    drift = (float(probability_up) - 0.5) * 2.0 * scaled_move
    return round(current * (1.0 + drift), 2)

def _predict_with_trained_models(
    symbol_pair: str,
    horizon_minutes: int,
    requested_model: str,
    current_price: Optional[float],
) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    if not CRYPTO_USE_TRAINED_MODELS:
        return None
    pd = _get_pandas()
    meta_module = _get_meta_module()
    if pd is None or meta_module is None:
        return None

    model_hint = None if requested_model == "ensemble" else requested_model
    trained = resolve_trained_model(symbol_pair, horizon_minutes, model_hint)
    if trained is None:
        # Horizon-agnostic fallback for canonical model filenames (rf_model/xgb_model/etc.).
        trained = resolve_trained_model(symbol_pair, 15, model_hint) if horizon_minutes != 15 else None
    if trained is None:
        return None

    try:
        artifact_sha256 = _artifact_sha256(trained.artifact_path)
        interval_minutes = int(trained.interval_minutes or 0) or {
            "1m": 1,
            "5m": 5,
            "15m": 15,
            "1h": 60,
            "4h": 240,
            "1d": 1440,
        }.get(_interval_for_horizon(horizon_minutes), 1)
        interval = _interval_for_horizon(horizon_minutes)
        limit = max(80, int(round((horizon_minutes / max(interval_minutes, 1)) * 12)))
        candles = _binance_ohlcv_window(symbol_pair, interval=interval, limit=min(limit, 500))
        if not candles:
            return None
        bundle = _trained_bundle_for_model(meta_module, trained)
        if bundle is None:
            return None
        df_raw = _build_feature_window_frame(pd, symbol_pair, candles, interval_minutes)
        enricher = meta_module.SetaFeatureEnricher()
        df_enriched = enricher.enrich_features(df_raw)
        df_enriched = meta_module.ensure_price_direction(
            df_enriched,
            price_col="current_price",
            label_col="price_direction",
        )
        probs_info = _bundle_probabilities(pd, bundle, df_enriched)
        idx = len(df_enriched) - 1
        per_model = {
            "rf": float(probs_info["rf_probs"][idx]),
            "dl": float(probs_info["dl_probs"][idx]),
            "xgb": float(probs_info["xgb_probs"][idx]),
            "cat": float(probs_info["cat_probs"][idx]),
            "seta": float(probs_info["seta_probs"][idx]),
        }
        if requested_model in per_model:
            model_used = requested_model
            p_up = per_model[requested_model]
        else:
            model_used = "ensemble"
            p_up = float(probs_info["combined"][idx])

        p_up = max(0.05, min(0.95, float(p_up)))
        live_price = current_price if isinstance(current_price, (int, float)) else None
        current = float(live_price or df_raw.iloc[-1]["current_price"] or 0.0)
        predicted = _estimate_predicted_price(
            current=current,
            probability_up=p_up,
            df_enriched=df_enriched,
            horizon_minutes=horizon_minutes,
            interval_minutes=interval_minutes,
        )
        decision: Literal["BUY", "SELL", "HOLD"]
        if p_up > 0.63:
            decision = "BUY"
        elif p_up < 0.37:
            decision = "SELL"
        else:
            decision = "HOLD"

        return {
            "model_used": model_used,
            "probability_up": p_up,
            "predicted_price": predicted,
            "decision": decision,
            "current_price": current,
            "trained_horizon_minutes": trained.horizon_minutes,
            "trained_model_type": trained.model_type,
            "trained_artifact": trained.artifact_path,
            "trained_artifact_sha256": artifact_sha256,
            "dataset_hash": trained.dataset_hash,
            "trained_at": trained.trained_at,
            "validation_mode": trained.validation_mode,
            "interval_minutes": interval_minutes,
            "regime": _current_market_regime(df_enriched),
            "per_model_probs": per_model,
        }
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        logger.warning("trained-model prediction unavailable for %s: %s", symbol_pair, exc)
        return None

def predict(req: PredictRequest) -> PredictResponse:
    """
    What it does:
    - Produces a crypto prediction payload with optional news adjustment/logging.

    Why it exists:
    - Single API entrypoint for model selection, telemetry, and downstream stats.

    Called from ->
    - Crypto mode UI and programmatic clients
    - Evaluation flows that read prediction/outcome logs

    Calls ->
    - market price resolvers (Binance/CoinGecko fallback)
    - news fetch + sentiment scoring
    - prediction/outcome log services

    Failure/guard behavior:
    - Fails with HTTP 400 on invalid model/symbol inputs.
    - Degrades to deterministic demo values when live price is unavailable.
    """
    sym = _normalize_binance_pair(req.symbol)
    if not sym:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Missing symbol")

    requested_model = (req.model or "ensemble").lower().strip()
    if requested_model not in {"rf", "xgb", "cat", "dl", "seta", "ensemble"}:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Unsupported model")

    require_trained = bool(req.require_trained or CRYPTO_REQUIRE_TRAINED_MODELS)
    live_price = _binance_spot_price(sym)
    price_source = _price_source.get(sym, "demo" if live_price is None else "binance")
    trained_payload = _predict_with_trained_models(sym, req.horizon_minutes, requested_model, live_price)
    prediction_engine = "trained" if trained_payload else "demo"
    threshold_rec: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    adaptive_policy: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    if require_trained and not trained_payload:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=503,
            detail=(
                "trained prediction unavailable for the requested symbol/horizon/model; "
                "demo fallback disabled"
            ),
        )

    if trained_payload:
        current = round(float(trained_payload["current_price"]), 2)
        p_up = max(0.05, min(0.95, float(trained_payload["probability_up"])))
        p_base = p_up
        predicted = round(float(trained_payload["predicted_price"]), 2)
        regime = trained_payload.get("regime")
        model_used = str(trained_payload.get("model_used") or requested_model)
        adaptive_policy = _adaptive_crypto_threshold_strategy(
            symbol=sym,
            horizon_minutes=req.horizon_minutes,
            regime=regime,
            limit=CRYPTO_THRESHOLD_LOOKBACK,

def _capture_outcome() -> None:
            try:

                delta_pct = (live - current) / current if current else 0.0
