    infra = any(name.lower() in {"dockerfile", "docker-compose.yml", "docker-compose.yaml", "nginx.conf"} for name in config_files) or has_any(".github/workflows", "terraform", "prometheus", "nginx")
    serverless = has_any("lambda", "serverless", "template.yaml", "template.yml", "api-gateway")
    ci = has_any(".github/workflows", ".gitlab-ci", "azure-pipelines", "jenkins")
    monitoring = has_any("prometheus", "grafana", "monitoring", "otel", "telemetry")
    ai_rag = has_any("embedding", "retrieval", "faiss", "rag", "llm", "vector")
    image = has_any("image", "comfyui", "diffusion", "stable-diffusion")
    crypto = has_any("crypto", "ohlcv", "trade", "binance", "prediction")
    security = auth or has_any("csp", "helmet", "secure", "oauth", "jwt")

    layers: List[str] = []
    for name, enabled in (
        ("backend", backend),
        ("frontend", frontend),
        ("auth", auth),
        ("database", database),
        ("tests", tests),
        ("infra", infra),
        ("serverless", serverless),
        ("ci", ci),
        ("monitoring", monitoring),
        ("ai_rag", ai_rag),
        ("image", image),
        ("crypto", crypto),
        ("security", security),
    ):
        if enabled:
            layers.append(name)

    return {
        "layers": layers,
        "top_dirs": [{"name": name, "count": count} for name, count in top_dirs.most_common(10)],
        "backend": backend,
        "frontend": frontend,
        "auth": auth,

        "crypto": crypto,
        "security": security,

        "key_files": key_files[:12],
    }

def _join_route_path(prefix: str, route_path: str) -> str:
    prefix_clean = str(prefix or "").strip()
    route_clean = str(route_path or "").strip()
    if not prefix_clean:
        return route_clean or "/"
    if not route_clean:
        return prefix_clean if prefix_clean.startswith("/") else f"/{prefix_clean}"
    left = prefix_clean.rstrip("/")
    right = route_clean if route_clean.startswith("/") else f"/{route_clean}"
    joined = f"{left}{right}" if left else right
    return joined or "/"

def scan_file_routes(path: Path, *, rel_path: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    ext = path.suffix.lower()
    if ext not in {".py", ".js", ".jsx", ".ts", ".tsx"}:
        return []
    try:
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
    except Exception:
        return []
    if not text.strip():
        return []

    rel = rel_path or path.name
    language = language_for_path(path)
    rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    seen: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()

    if ext == ".py":
        lines = text.splitlines()
        idx = 0
        while idx < len(lines):
            stripped = lines[idx].lstrip()
            if not stripped.startswith("@"):
                idx += 1
                continue
            buffer = [lines[idx]]
            depth = lines[idx].count("(") - lines[idx].count(")")
            idx += 1
            while idx < len(lines) and depth > 0:
                buffer.append(lines[idx])
                depth += lines[idx].count("(") - lines[idx].count(")")
                idx += 1
            decorator_text = "\n".join(buffer)
            match = PY_ROUTE_DECORATOR_PATTERN.search(decorator_text)
            if not match:
                continue
            route_match = ROUTE_STRING_PATTERN.search(decorator_text)
            if not route_match:
                continue
            handler_name = ""
            look_ahead = idx
            while look_ahead < len(lines):
                candidate = lines[look_ahead].strip()
                if not candidate or candidate.startswith("@"):
                    look_ahead += 1
                    continue
                handler_match = re.match(r"^(?:async\s+)?def\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\(", candidate)
                if handler_match:
                    handler_name = str(handler_match.group(1) or "").strip()
                break
            method_name = str(match.group(2) or "").strip().lower()
            router_ref = str(match.group(1) or "").strip()
            route_path = str(route_match.group(1) or "").strip()
            methods: List[str]
            if method_name in ROUTE_METHODS:
                methods = [method_name.upper()]
            else:
                methods_match = ROUTE_METHODS_PATTERN.search(decorator_text)
                methods = _extract_route_methods((methods_match.group(1) or methods_match.group(2) or "") if methods_match else "")
                if not methods:
                    methods = ["ANY"]
            for method in methods:
                key = (rel, method, route_path)
                if key in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(key)
                rows.append(
                    {
                        "path": rel,
                        "method": method,
                        "route": route_path,
                        "resolved_route": route_path,
                        "router_ref": router_ref,
                        "handler": handler_name,
                        "language": language,
                    }
                )
        return rows

    for match in JS_ROUTE_PATTERN.finditer(text):
        method = str(match.group(1) or "").strip().upper()
        route_path = str(match.group(3) or "").strip()
        key = (rel, method, route_path)
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        rows.append(
            {
                "path": rel,
                "method": method,
                "route": route_path,
                "resolved_route": route_path,
                "router_ref": "",
                "handler": "",
                "language": language,
            }
        )
    return rows

def _normalize_symbol_body(body: str, symbol: str) -> str:
    text = str(body or "")
    if not text.strip():
        return ""
    text = re.sub(r'"""[\s\S]*?"""', " DOC ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"'''[\s\S]*?'''", " DOC ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", " DOC ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"#.*", "", text)
    text = re.sub(r"//.*", "", text)
    text = re.sub(r'"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"', " STR ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"'(?:\\.|[^'\\])*'", " STR ", text)
    if symbol:
        text = re.sub(rf"\b{re.escape(symbol)}\b", " SYM ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?\b", " NUM ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text

def _rename_safety_summary(
    state: Dict[str, Any],
    *,
    symbol: str,
    changed_paths: List[str],
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    definitions = list(state["symbol_definitions"].get(symbol, []))
    refs = list(state["symbol_reference_files"].get(symbol, []))
    unresolved = state["unresolved_imports"]
    ref_count = sum(int(item.get("count") or 0) for item in refs)
    score = 100
    warnings: List[str] = []
    if len(definitions) > 1:
        score -= 35
        warnings.append("multiple-definitions")
    if ref_count > 30:
        score -= 20
        warnings.append("high-reference-count")
    elif ref_count > 10:
        score -= 10
        warnings.append("moderate-reference-count")
    unresolved_hits = sum(int(unresolved.get(path, 0)) for path in changed_paths)
    if unresolved_hits > 0:
        score -= 15
        warnings.append("touched-files-have-unresolved-imports")
    if not changed_paths:
        score -= 50
        warnings.append("no-safe-text-edits-detected")

    score = max(0, min(100, score))
    if score >= 80:
        level = "high"
    elif score >= 55:
        level = "medium"
    else:
        level = "low"
    return {
        "level": level,
        "score": score,
        "warnings": warnings,
        "definition_count": len(definitions),
        "reference_count": ref_count,
        "changed_path_count": len(changed_paths),
    }

    root: Path,

    manifest: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    limit: int = 8,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    state = _build_relation_state(root, manifest)
    files = list(state["files"])
    adjacency = state["adjacency"]
    reverse = state["reverse"]
    inbound = state["inbound"]
    outbound = state["outbound"]
    unresolved_imports = state["unresolved_imports"]
    shared_symbol_clusters = list(state["shared_symbol_clusters"])

    refactor_candidates = list(state["refactor_candidates"])
    env_var_hotspots = list(state["env_var_hotspots"])
    duplicate_logic_clusters = list(state["duplicate_logic_clusters"])
    symbol_call_hotspots = list(state["symbol_call_hotspots"])
    public_api_symbols = list(state["public_api_symbols"])
    isolated_symbol_candidates = list(state["isolated_symbol_candidates"])
    route_rows = list(state["routes"])
    route_hotspots = list(state["route_hotspots"])
    runtime_surfaces = list(state["runtime_surfaces"])
    runtime_surface_hotspots = list(state["runtime_surface_hotspots"])
    mutual_edges = list(state["mutual_edges"])

    hotspots = [
        {
            "path": rel,
            "inbound_refs": int(inbound.get(rel, 0)),
            "outbound_refs": int(outbound.get(rel, 0)),
            "imported_by": sorted(reverse.get(rel, set()))[:6],
            "imports_to": sorted(adjacency.get(rel, set()))[:6],
        }
        for rel in files
        if inbound.get(rel, 0) > 0 or outbound.get(rel, 0) > 0
    ]
    hotspots.sort(key=lambda item: (-int(item["inbound_refs"]), -int(item["outbound_refs"]), str(item["path"])))

    outbound_hotspots = sorted(
        hotspots,
        key=lambda item: (-int(item["outbound_refs"]), -int(item["inbound_refs"]), str(item["path"])),
    )
    unresolved_rows = [
        {"path": rel, "count": int(count)}
        for rel, count in unresolved_imports.most_common(max(1, limit))
    ]

    return {
        "files_scanned": len(files),
        "internal_edge_count": len(state["edges"]),
        "files_with_links": sum(1 for rel in files if inbound.get(rel, 0) or outbound.get(rel, 0)),
        "hotspots": hotspots[: max(1, limit)],
        "outbound_hotspots": outbound_hotspots[: max(1, limit)],
        "mutual_edges": mutual_edges[: max(1, limit)],
        "shared_symbol_clusters": shared_symbol_clusters[: max(1, limit)],
        "symbol_hotspots": symbol_hotspots[: max(1, limit)],
        "symbol_call_hotspots": symbol_call_hotspots[: max(1, limit)],
        "public_api_symbols": public_api_symbols[: max(1, limit)],
        "isolated_symbol_candidates": isolated_symbol_candidates[: max(1, limit)],
        "route_count": len(route_rows),
        "routes": route_rows[: max(1, limit * 2)],
        "route_hotspots": route_hotspots[: max(1, limit)],
        "runtime_surface_count": len(runtime_surfaces),
        "runtime_surfaces": runtime_surfaces[: max(1, limit)],
        "runtime_surface_hotspots": runtime_surface_hotspots[: max(1, limit)],
        "refactor_candidates": refactor_candidates[: max(1, limit)],
        "env_var_hotspots": env_var_hotspots[: max(1, limit)],
        "duplicate_logic_clusters": duplicate_logic_clusters[: max(1, limit)],
        "unresolved_imports": unresolved_rows,
    }

def build_symbol_rename_plan(
    root: Path,
    *,
    manifest: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    symbol: str,
    new_symbol: str,
    limit: int = 20,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    source_symbol = str(symbol or "").strip()
    target_symbol = str(new_symbol or "").strip()
    if not VALID_IDENTIFIER_PATTERN.match(source_symbol):
        raise ValueError("invalid-source-symbol")
    if not VALID_IDENTIFIER_PATTERN.match(target_symbol):
        raise ValueError("invalid-target-symbol")
    if source_symbol == target_symbol:
        raise ValueError("symbol-unchanged")

    impact = build_project_impact_report(root, manifest=manifest, q=source_symbol, limit=limit)
    state = _build_relation_state(root, manifest)
    candidate_paths: List[str] = []
    for item in impact.get("defined_in") or []:
        path = str((item or {}).get("path") or "").strip()
        if path and path not in candidate_paths:
            candidate_paths.append(path)
    for item in impact.get("referenced_by_files") or []:
        path = str((item or {}).get("path") or "").strip()
        if path and path not in candidate_paths:
            candidate_paths.append(path)
    for item in impact.get("matched_files") or []:
        path = str(item or "").strip()
        if path and path not in candidate_paths:
            candidate_paths.append(path)

    operations: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    changed_paths: List[str] = []
    pattern = re.compile(rf"\b{re.escape(source_symbol)}\b")
    for rel in candidate_paths[: max(1, limit)]:
        file_path = root / rel
        try:
            text = file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="strict")
        except Exception:
            continue
        updated = pattern.sub(target_symbol, text)
        if updated == text:
            continue
        operations.append(
            {
                "op": "write",
                "path": rel,
                "content": updated,
                "create": False,
            }
        )
        changed_paths.append(rel)

    symbol_refs = state["symbol_reference_files"].get(source_symbol, [])
    symbol_defs = state["symbol_definitions"].get(source_symbol, [])
    rename_safety = _rename_safety_summary(state, symbol=source_symbol, changed_paths=changed_paths)
    return {
        "symbol": source_symbol,
        "new_symbol": target_symbol,
        "operation_count": len(operations),
        "changed_paths": changed_paths,
        "operations": operations,
        "definition_count": len(symbol_defs),
        "reference_count": sum(int(item.get("count") or 0) for item in symbol_refs),
        "defined_in": symbol_defs[: max(1, limit)],
        "referenced_by_files": symbol_refs[: max(1, limit)],
        "rename_safety": rename_safety,
        "review_required": True,
    }

"""
Project introspection utilities.

Why this module exists:
- Provide deterministic file/symbol/architecture extraction for project tools.
- Support agent evidence retrieval without relying on LLM inference.
"""

import ast
import os
import re
import hashlib
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, List, Optional, Tuple

CODE_EXTS = {
    ".py",
    ".js",
    ".ts",
    ".tsx",
    ".jsx",
    ".go",
    ".rs",
    ".java",
    ".kt",
    ".php",

LANG_BY_EXT = {
    ".py": "python",
    ".js": "javascript",
    ".jsx": "javascript",
    ".ts": "typescript",
    ".tsx": "typescript",
    ".go": "go",
    ".rs": "rust",
    ".java": "java",
    ".kt": "kotlin",
    ".php": "php",
    ".swift": "swift",
    ".dart": "dart",
    ".sh": "shell",
}

CODE_SYMBOL_PATTERNS: tuple[re.Pattern[str], ...] = (
    re.compile(r"^\s*(?:async\s+)?def\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\(", re.MULTILINE),
    re.compile(r"^\s*class\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\b", re.MULTILINE),
    re.compile(r"^\s*(?:export\s+)?(?:async\s+)?function\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*\(", re.MULTILINE),
    re.compile(r"^\s*(?:export\s+)?class\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\b", re.MULTILINE),
    re.compile(r"^\s*(?:const|let|var)\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*=\s*(?:async\s*)?\(", re.MULTILINE),
    re.compile(r"^\s*func\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\(", re.MULTILINE),
    re.compile(r"^\s*fn\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\(", re.MULTILINE),
    re.compile(r"^\s*(?:public|private|protected|internal|open|final|suspend|inline|\s)*\s*fun\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\(", re.MULTILINE),
    re.compile(r"^\s*(?:public|private|protected|internal|open|final|\s)*\s*class\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\b", re.MULTILINE),
)

PY_IMPORT_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^\s*import\s+([A-Za-z_][\w.,\s]*)", re.MULTILINE)
PY_FROM_IMPORT_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^\s*from\s+([.\w]+)\s+import\s+([^\n#]+)", re.MULTILINE)
JS_IMPORT_PATTERNS: tuple[re.Pattern[str], ...] = (
    re.compile(r"""^\s*import(?:[\s\w{},*$]+?\s+from\s+)?['"]([^'"]+)['"]""", re.MULTILINE),
    re.compile(r"""^\s*export\s+.*?\s+from\s+['"]([^'"]+)['"]""", re.MULTILINE),
    re.compile(r"""require\(\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]\s*\)""", re.MULTILINE),
)
ROUTE_METHODS = {"get", "post", "put", "delete", "patch", "options", "head", "all", "websocket"}
PY_ROUTE_DECORATOR_PATTERN = re.compile(r"""@([A-Za-z_][\w.]*)\.(get|post|put|delete|patch|options|head|all|websocket|route|api_route)\s*\(""")
ROUTE_STRING_PATTERN = re.compile(r"""['"](/[^'"]*)['"]""")
ROUTE_METHODS_PATTERN = re.compile(r"""methods\s*=\s*\[([^\]]+)\]|methods\s*=\s*\(([^\)]+)\)""", re.IGNORECASE)
JS_ROUTE_PATTERN = re.compile(r"""\b(?:router|app)\.(get|post|put|delete|patch|options|head|all)\(\s*(['"`])([^'"`]+)\2""")
IDENTIFIER_PATTERN = re.compile(r"\b[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\b")
VALID_IDENTIFIER_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$")
PY_ENV_PATTERNS: tuple[re.Pattern[str], ...] = (

def collect_symbol_boundaries(text: str, max_symbols: int = MAX_SYMBOLS_PER_FILE) -> List[Tuple[Optional[str], int, int]]:
    """Extract lightweight symbol boundaries for chunk metadata and lookups."""
    matches: List[Tuple[Optional[str], int, int]] = []
    seen: set[Tuple[Optional[str], int]] = set()
    for pattern in CODE_SYMBOL_PATTERNS:
        for match in pattern.finditer(text):
            symbol = match.group(1).strip() if match.groups() else None
            line_start = text.count("\n", 0, match.start()) + 1
            key = (symbol, line_start)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            matches.append((symbol, line_start, match.start()))
    matches.sort(key=lambda item: item[1])
    return matches[:max_symbols]

def _rename_safety_summary(
    state: Dict[str, Any],
    *,
    symbol: str,
    changed_paths: List[str],
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    definitions = list(state["symbol_definitions"].get(symbol, []))
    refs = list(state["symbol_reference_files"].get(symbol, []))
    unresolved = state["unresolved_imports"]
    ref_count = sum(int(item.get("count") or 0) for item in refs)
    score = 100
    warnings: List[str] = []
    if len(definitions) > 1:
        score -= 35
        warnings.append("multiple-definitions")
    if ref_count > 30:
        score -= 20
        warnings.append("high-reference-count")
    elif ref_count > 10:
        score -= 10
        warnings.append("moderate-reference-count")
    unresolved_hits = sum(int(unresolved.get(path, 0)) for path in changed_paths)
    if unresolved_hits > 0:
        score -= 15
        warnings.append("touched-files-have-unresolved-imports")
    if not changed_paths:
        score -= 50
        warnings.append("no-safe-text-edits-detected")

    score = max(0, min(100, score))
    if score >= 80:
        level = "high"
    elif score >= 55:
        level = "medium"
    else:
        level = "low"
    return {
        "level": level,
        "score": score,
        "warnings": warnings,
        "definition_count": len(definitions),
        "reference_count": ref_count,
        "changed_path_count": len(changed_paths),
    }

"""
Shared HTTP client helpers with optional proxy-pool fallback.

Why this module exists:
- Keep proxy-aware GET request behavior consistent across services.
- Avoid duplicate `_http_get` implementations drifting over time.
"""

import logging
from typing import Any

import requests

from app.services.search_state import ProxyUnavailableError
from app.utils.runtime_helpers import proxies_enabled as _proxies_enabled

try:
    from app.services import proxy_pool
except Exception:  # pragma: no cover
    proxy_pool = None

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def http_get(url: str, **kwargs: Any) -> requests.Response:
    """
    Perform GET with proxy pool when enabled, otherwise direct requests.
    """
    if proxy_pool and _proxies_enabled(proxy_pool):
        try:
            with proxy_pool.proxy_session() as (session, _):
                return session.get(url, **kwargs)
        except ProxyUnavailableError:
            logger.debug("Proxy unavailable; falling back to direct request for %s", url)
    return requests.get(url, **kwargs)

    """
    Ensure the provider still has quota in every window defined by `limits`.
    Each limit tuple is (window_seconds, max_calls).

                conn.execute(
                    """
                    INSERT INTO provider_usage(provider, window_seconds, window_start, call_count, error_count, cooldown_until)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, 0, 0, 0)
                    """,

def provider_snapshot(providers: Sequence[str]) -> list[dict]:
    items = [str(provider).strip() for provider in providers if str(provider).strip()]
    if not items:
        return []
    placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in items)
    now = _now()
    grouped: dict[str, list[dict]] = {name: [] for name in items}
    with _lock, _conn() as conn:
        rows = conn.execute(
            f"""
            SELECT provider, window_seconds, window_start, call_count, error_count, cooldown_until
            FROM provider_usage
            WHERE provider IN ({placeholders})
            ORDER BY provider ASC, window_seconds ASC
            """,
            tuple(items),
        ).fetchall()
    for provider, window_seconds, window_start, call_count, error_count, cooldown_until in rows:
        grouped.setdefault(provider, []).append(
            {
                "window_seconds": int(window_seconds or 0),
                "window_start": float(window_start or 0.0),
                "call_count": int(call_count or 0),
                "error_count": int(error_count or 0),
                "cooldown_until": float(cooldown_until or 0.0),
                "cooling_down": bool(cooldown_until and float(cooldown_until) > now),
            }
        )

    snapshot: list[dict] = []
    for provider in items:
        windows = grouped.get(provider) or []
        cooldown_until = max((float(item.get("cooldown_until") or 0.0) for item in windows), default=0.0)
        snapshot.append(
            {
                "provider": provider,
                "status": "cooldown" if cooldown_until > now else "ready",
                "cooldown_until": cooldown_until,
                "cooling_down": cooldown_until > now,
                "windows": windows,
            }
        )
    return snapshot

def provider_snapshot(providers: Sequence[str]) -> list[dict]:
    items = [str(provider).strip() for provider in providers if str(provider).strip()]
    if not items:
        return []
    placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in items)
    now = _now()
    grouped: dict[str, list[dict]] = {name: [] for name in items}
    with _lock, _conn() as conn:
        rows = conn.execute(
            f"""
            SELECT provider, window_seconds, window_start, call_count, error_count, cooldown_until
            FROM provider_usage
            WHERE provider IN ({placeholders})
            ORDER BY provider ASC, window_seconds ASC
            """,
            tuple(items),
        ).fetchall()
    for provider, window_seconds, window_start, call_count, error_count, cooldown_until in rows:
        grouped.setdefault(provider, []).append(
            {
                "window_seconds": int(window_seconds or 0),
                "window_start": float(window_start or 0.0),
                "call_count": int(call_count or 0),
                "error_count": int(error_count or 0),
                "cooldown_until": float(cooldown_until or 0.0),
                "cooling_down": bool(cooldown_until and float(cooldown_until) > now),
            }
        )

    snapshot: list[dict] = []
    for provider in items:
        windows = grouped.get(provider) or []
        cooldown_until = max((float(item.get("cooldown_until") or 0.0) for item in windows), default=0.0)
        snapshot.append(
            {
                "provider": provider,
                "status": "cooldown" if cooldown_until > now else "ready",
                "cooldown_until": cooldown_until,
                "cooling_down": cooldown_until > now,
                "windows": windows,
            }
        )
    return snapshot

from __future__ import annotations

"""
Crypto trade execution log store.

Why this module exists:
- Persist simulated/live trade records for PnL and audit endpoints.
"""

import json
import os
import threading
import time
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional

from app.services.jsonl_log_utils import ensure_log_dir, iter_recent_lines

LOG_DIR = Path(os.getenv("CRYPTO_PRED_LOG_DIR", "logs"))
TRADE_FILE = LOG_DIR / "trades.jsonl"
_lock = threading.Lock()


def log_trade(entry: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """
    Append a trade to jsonl log.
    Expected keys: symbol, side (BUY/SELL), quantity, price, test (bool).
    """
    ensure_log_dir(LOG_DIR)
    entry = dict(entry)
    entry.setdefault("id", f"trade_{int(time.time() * 1e6)}")
    entry.setdefault("ts", int(time.time()))
    with _lock:
        with TRADE_FILE.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(entry, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    return str(entry["id"])


def list_trades(limit: int = 50, symbol: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    ensure_log_dir(LOG_DIR)
    if not TRADE_FILE.exists():
        return []
    out: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    sym = symbol.upper() if symbol else None
    for line in iter_recent_lines(TRADE_FILE):
        try:
            item = json.loads(line)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if sym and (item.get("symbol") or "").upper() != sym:
            continue
        out.append(item)
        if len(out) >= limit:
            break
    out.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("ts") or 0, reverse=True)
    return out


def _compute_pnl_for_symbol(trades: List[Dict[str, Any]], current_price: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Simple mark-to-market:
      position = sum(signed qty)  (BUY=+qty, SELL=-qty)
      cost = sum(qty_signed * price)
      unrealized = current_price * position - cost
    """
    if not trades:
        return {"position": 0.0, "avg_price": None, "unrealized": 0.0, "count": 0}

    qty_signed = 0.0
    cost = 0.0
    for t in trades:
        qty = float(t.get("quantity") or 0.0)
        price = float(t.get("price") or 0.0)
        side = (t.get("side") or "").upper()
        sign = 1.0 if side == "BUY" else -1.0
        qty_signed += sign * qty
        cost += sign * qty * price

    avg_price = (cost / qty_signed) if qty_signed else None
    unrealized = current_price * qty_signed - cost
    return {"position": qty_signed, "avg_price": avg_price, "unrealized": unrealized, "count": len(trades)}


def compute_pnl(trades: List[Dict[str, Any]], price_lookup: Callable[[str], Optional[float]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Compute P&L by symbol (mark-to-market) and totals.
    price_lookup(symbol: str) -> float | None
    """
    by_symbol = defaultdict(list)
    for t in trades:
        sym = (t.get("symbol") or "").upper()
        if sym:
            by_symbol[sym].append(t)

    results: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    total_unrealized = 0.0
    for sym, ts in by_symbol.items():
        cp = price_lookup(sym)
        if cp is None:
            cp = float(ts[-1].get("price") or 0.0)
        pnl_info = _compute_pnl_for_symbol(ts, float(cp))
        pnl_info["current_price"] = float(cp)
        results[sym] = pnl_info
        total_unrealized += float(pnl_info.get("unrealized") or 0.0)

    return {"per_symbol": results, "total_unrealized": total_unrealized}


def clear_trades() -> None:
    ensure_log_dir(LOG_DIR)
    with _lock:
        if TRADE_FILE.exists():
            TRADE_FILE.unlink()

def _load_model() -> Any:
    global _model, EMBEDDING_DIM
    if _model is not None:
        return _model

    with _model_lock:
        if _model is not None:
            return _model

        if DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME.strip().lower() == "hash":
            EMBEDDING_DIM = FALLBACK_DIM
            _model = "hash"
            _set_status("hash")
            logger.info("Using hashing-only embeddings (AEGIS_EMBED_MODEL=hash).")
            return _model

        if SentenceTransformer is None:
            logger.warning(
                "sentence-transformers not available; using hashing fallback embeddings."
            )
            EMBEDDING_DIM = FALLBACK_DIM
            _model = "hash"
            _set_status("hash", "sentence-transformers not available")
            return _model

        try:
            model = None
            model_kwargs = {}
            if EMBED_CACHE_DIR:
                model_kwargs["cache_folder"] = EMBED_CACHE_DIR
            if EMBED_LOCAL_ONLY:
                model_kwargs["local_files_only"] = True
            if EMBED_DEVICE:
                model_kwargs["device"] = EMBED_DEVICE
            if EMBED_LOAD_TIMEOUT and EMBED_LOAD_TIMEOUT > 0:
                model = _load_sentence_transformer_with_timeout(
                    DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME,
                    EMBED_LOAD_TIMEOUT,
                    model_kwargs,
                )
                if model is None:
                    EMBEDDING_DIM = FALLBACK_DIM
                    _model = "hash"
                    _set_status("hash", "embedding model load timed out")
                    logger.warning(
                        "Embedding model load timed out; using hashing fallback (dim=%s).",
                        EMBEDDING_DIM,
                    )
                    return _model
            else:
                model = SentenceTransformer(DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME, **model_kwargs)
            EMBEDDING_DIM = int(model.get_sentence_embedding_dimension())
            _model = model
            _set_status("model")
            logger.info(
                "Loaded embedding model %s (dim=%s)",
                DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME,
                EMBEDDING_DIM,
            )
            return model
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            logger.exception(
                "Failed to load %s; using hashing fallback embedding. %s",
                DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME,
                exc,
            )
            EMBEDDING_DIM = FALLBACK_DIM
            _model = "hash"
            _set_status("hash", str(exc))
            return _model

def _load_sentence_transformer_with_timeout(
    model_name: str,
    timeout_s: float,
    model_kwargs: Optional[dict] = None,
) -> Optional[Any]:
    result = call_with_timeout(
        lambda: SentenceTransformer(model_name, **(model_kwargs or {})),
        timeout_s=timeout_s,
        thread_name="embed-model-load",
        daemon=True,
    )
    if not result.completed:
        logger.warning("Embedding model load timed out after %.1fs.", timeout_s)
        return None
    if result.error is not None:
        raise result.error  # type: ignore[misc]
    return result.value

def embed_texts(texts: Iterable[str]) -> List[List[float]]:
    texts_list = [t or "" for t in texts]
    if not texts_list:
        return []

    model = _load_model()
    if isinstance(model, str) and model == "hash":
        dim = EMBEDDING_DIM or FALLBACK_DIM
        _set_status("hash", _LAST_EMBED_ERROR)
        return [_normalize(_hash_embed(t, dim)) for t in texts_list]

    try:
        embeddings = _encode_with_timeout(
            model,
            texts_list,
            EMBED_ENCODE_TIMEOUT,
        )
        if embeddings is None:
            logger.warning("Embedding encode timed out; using hashing fallback.")
            dim = EMBEDDING_DIM or FALLBACK_DIM
            _set_status("hash", "embedding encode timed out")
            return [_normalize(_hash_embed(t, dim)) for t in texts_list]
        _set_status("model")
        return [list(map(float, vec)) for vec in embeddings]
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        logger.exception("sentence-transformers encode failed; falling back to hashing. %s", exc)
        dim = EMBEDDING_DIM or FALLBACK_DIM
        _set_status("hash", str(exc))
        return [_normalize(_hash_embed(t, dim)) for t in texts_list]

from __future__ import annotations

"""
Embedding helpers for retrieval/service layers.

Why this module exists:
- Provide a single embedding backend abstraction (model or hash fallback).
- Keep embedding readiness and timeout behavior deterministic.
"""

import logging
import os
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Iterable, List, Optional, Sequence, Union
from app.utils.ml_helpers import hash_embed as _hash_embed
from app.utils.threading_helpers import call_with_timeout

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

FAST_MODE = os.getenv("AEGIS_FAST_MODE", "").strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}

try:  # pragma: no cover
    from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer  # type: ignore
except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
    SentenceTransformer = None  # type: ignore


_EMBED_MODEL_RAW = os.getenv("AEGIS_EMBED_MODEL", "").strip()
DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME = _EMBED_MODEL_RAW or (
    "hash" if FAST_MODE else "sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2"
)

from __future__ import annotations

"""
Canonical project registry store.

Why this module exists:
- Keep project_id -> root/manifest/status mapping deterministic.
- Centralize project registration/update/delete semantics for `/files/*`.
"""

import json
import os
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, TypedDict
from app.utils.runtime_helpers import now_ts as _now_ts

UPLOAD_ROOT = Path(os.getenv("FILES_UPLOAD_ROOT", "data/uploads")).resolve()
STORE_FILE = UPLOAD_ROOT / ".aegis_projects.json"


class ProjectRecord(TypedDict, total=False):
    project_id: str
    root_path: str
    source: str
    status: str
    manifest_path: Optional[str]
    index_namespace: str
    created_at: int
    updated_at: int
    last_ingest_at: Optional[int]
    chunk_count: int
    metadata: Dict[str, Any]


_lock = threading.RLock()

def _load_store() -> Dict[str, ProjectRecord]:
    """Load project registry from disk; return empty store on parse errors."""
    try:
        if STORE_FILE.exists():
            raw = json.loads(STORE_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if isinstance(raw, dict):
                return {
                    str(project_id): _normalize_record(project_id, record)
                    for project_id, record in raw.items()
                    if isinstance(record, dict)
                }
    except Exception:
        pass
    return {}


def _save_store(store: Dict[str, ProjectRecord]) -> None:
    """Atomically persist project registry to disk."""
    try:
        STORE_FILE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        tmp = STORE_FILE.with_suffix(STORE_FILE.suffix + ".tmp")
        tmp.write_text(json.dumps(store, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        tmp.replace(STORE_FILE)
    except Exception:
        pass


def _normalize_record(project_id: str, raw: Dict[str, Any]) -> ProjectRecord:
    now = _now_ts()
    record: ProjectRecord = {
        "project_id": str(project_id),

        "source": str(raw.get("source") or "local"),

        "last_ingest_at": int(raw.get("last_ingest_at")) if raw.get("last_ingest_at") else None,
        "chunk_count": int(raw.get("chunk_count") or 0),
        "metadata": raw.get("metadata") if isinstance(raw.get("metadata"), dict) else {},
    }
    return record

def get_project_by_path(path: Path | str) -> Optional[ProjectRecord]:
    try:

    with _lock:
        for record in _load_store().values():

def summarize_runtime_capabilities(capabilities: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Collapse capability blocks into canonical `ready/status/checks` summary."""
    emb = dict(capabilities.get("embeddings") or {})
    retrieval = dict(capabilities.get("retrieval") or {})
    llm = dict(capabilities.get("llm") or {})
    web = dict(capabilities.get("web_search") or {})
    image = dict(capabilities.get("image") or {})
    clamav = dict(capabilities.get("clamav") or {})
    project_tools = dict(capabilities.get("project_tools") or {})
    browser_runtime = dict(capabilities.get("browser_runtime") or {})
    strict_profile = (os.getenv("AEGIS_RUNTIME_PROFILE", "standard") or "standard").strip().lower() == "strict"
    product_track = product_track_default()
    full_track = product_track == "full"

    emb_ok = emb.get("status") != "error"
    retrieval_ok = retrieval.get("status") != "error"
    llm_ok = bool(llm.get("available")) and bool(llm.get("model_exists") or llm.get("loaded") or llm.get("remote_ready"))
    image_storage_ok = bool(image.get("images_dir_exists"))
    image_backend_ok = image.get("status") == "ready"
    web_ok = web.get("status") == "ready"
    clamav_ok = str(clamav.get("status") or "") in {"ready", "degraded", "missing"}
    project_tools_ok = bool(project_tools.get("available", True)) and project_tools.get("status") != "error"
    browser_runtime_ok = str(browser_runtime.get("status") or "") == "ready"

    core_ready = emb_ok and retrieval_ok and llm_ok and image_storage_ok and clamav_ok and project_tools_ok
    if strict_profile:
        # Product-track contract:
        # core+strict  -> image/backend and browser are non-blocking
        # full+strict  -> image/backend and browser are blocking
        core_ready = core_ready and web_ok
        if full_track:
            core_ready = core_ready and image_backend_ok and browser_runtime_ok

    degraded_reasons: List[str] = []
    if image.get("status") == "fallback-only":
        degraded_reasons.append("image:fallback-only")
    elif image.get("status") in {"degraded", "error"}:
        degraded_reasons.append(f"image:{image.get('status')}")
    include_web_degraded = bool(web.get("probe_enabled")) or (
        (os.getenv("AEGIS_READYZ_INCLUDE_WEB_DEGRADED", "0") or "0").strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}
    )
    if include_web_degraded and web.get("status") in {"degraded", "error", "cooldown"}:
        degraded_reasons.append(f"web:{web.get('status')}")
    if clamav.get("status") == "missing":
        degraded_reasons.append("clamav:missing")
    if strict_profile and full_track and not browser_runtime_ok:
        degraded_reasons.append(f"browser:{browser_runtime.get('status') or 'missing'}")
    if strict_profile and full_track and not image_backend_ok:
        degraded_reasons.append(f"image:{image.get('status') or 'not-ready'}")
    if strict_profile and not web_ok:
        degraded_reasons.append(f"web:{web.get('status') or 'not-ready'}")

    if degraded_reasons:
        degraded_reasons = list(dict.fromkeys(str(item) for item in degraded_reasons if str(item).strip()))

    status = "ready" if core_ready else "error"
    if core_ready and degraded_reasons:
        status = "fallback-only" if degraded_reasons == ["image:fallback-only"] else "degraded"

    levels = {
        "embeddings": str(emb.get("status") or "unknown"),
        "retrieval": str(retrieval.get("status") or "unknown"),
        "llm": "ready" if llm_ok else str(llm.get("status") or "error"),
        "web_search": str(web.get("status") or "unknown"),
        "image": str(image.get("status") or "unknown"),
        "clamav": str(clamav.get("status") or "unknown"),
        "project_tools": str(project_tools.get("status") or "unknown"),
        "browser_runtime": str(browser_runtime.get("status") or "unknown"),
    }

    return {
        "ready": core_ready,
        "status": status,
        "checks": {
            "embeddings": emb_ok,
            "retrieval": retrieval_ok,
            "llm": llm_ok,
            "image_storage": image_storage_ok,
            "image_backend": image_backend_ok,
            "web_search": web_ok,
            "clamav": clamav_ok,
            "project_tools": project_tools_ok,
            "browser_runtime": browser_runtime_ok,
        },
        "levels": levels,
        "degraded_reasons": degraded_reasons,
        "runtime_profile": "strict" if strict_profile else "standard",
        "product_track": product_track,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

"""
Prompt/log secret redaction helpers.

Why this module exists:
- Reduce accidental secret leakage to models/logs.
- Apply lightweight, deterministic masking before external hops.
"""

import os
import re

_ENABLED = (os.getenv("AEGIS_REDACT_SECRETS", "1") or "1").strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}


_PATTERNS: list[tuple[re.Pattern[str], str]] = [
    # OpenAI-style keys
    (re.compile(r"\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}\b"), "sk-***REDACTED***"),
    # HuggingFace tokens
    (re.compile(r"\bhf_[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}\b"), "hf_***REDACTED***"),
    # AWS access keys (common prefix)
    (re.compile(r"\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b"), "AKIA***REDACTED***"),
    # Generic bearer tokens
    (re.compile(r"(?i)\bBearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]{16,}\b"), "Bearer ***REDACTED***"),
    # Common env-style assignments
    (re.compile(r"(?i)\b(api[_-]?key|token|secret)\s*[:=]\s*['\"]?([A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]{12,})['\"]?"), r"\1=***REDACTED***"),
]


def redact_secrets(text: str) -> str:
    """
    Best-effort secret redaction for prompts/logs.

    This is intentionally conservative and pattern-based. It won't catch every secret,
    but it prevents the most common accidental leak vectors (API keys/tokens) from
    being forwarded to external providers or stored in long-lived logs.
    """
    if not _ENABLED:
        return text
    if not text:
        return text
    out = text
    for pattern, replacement in _PATTERNS:
        out = pattern.sub(replacement, out)
    return out

def build_project_manifest(
    root: Path,
    project_id: str,
    *,
    chunk_count: int = 0,
    chunked_files: int = 0,
    skipped: Optional[Dict[str, int]] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Build deterministic manifest snapshot from a project root directory."""
    file_tree: List[str] = []
    ext_counter: Counter[str] = Counter()
    total_bytes = 0
    total_files = 0
    total_dirs = 0

    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
        dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames if d not in {".git", "__pycache__", "node_modules", ".venv", "venv"}]
        total_dirs += len(dirnames)
        for filename in filenames:
            if filename in _INTERNAL_FILES:
                continue
            path = Path(dirpath) / filename
            try:
                rel = str(path.relative_to(root))
                st = path.stat()
            except Exception:
                continue
            total_files += 1
            total_bytes += int(st.st_size)
            ext_counter[path.suffix.lower() or "(no_ext)"] += 1
            if len(file_tree) < MAX_MANIFEST_FILES:
                file_tree.append(rel)

    languages = Counter()
    for ext, count in ext_counter.items():
        lang = _LANG_BY_EXT.get(ext)
        if lang:
            languages[lang] += count

    frameworks = _detect_frameworks(file_tree, root)
    entrypoints = _detect_entrypoints(file_tree)
    package_files = [path for path in file_tree if Path(path).name in _PACKAGE_FILES]
    config_files = [path for path in file_tree if Path(path).name in _CONFIG_FILES or Path(path).name.lower() in {name.lower() for name in _CONFIG_FILES}]
    readme_summary = _summarize_readme(root)
    key_files = _key_files(file_tree)

    manifest = {
        "project_id": project_id,
        "root_path": str(root),
        "generated_at": int(os.path.getmtime(root)),
        "stats": {
            "files": total_files,
            "dirs": total_dirs,
            "bytes": total_bytes,
            "chunk_count": int(chunk_count),
            "chunked_files": int(chunked_files),
            "skipped": skipped or {},
        },
        "file_tree": file_tree,
        "languages": [{"name": name, "count": count} for name, count in languages.most_common(12)],
        "frameworks": frameworks,
        "entrypoints": entrypoints,
        "package_files": package_files,
        "config_files": config_files,
        "key_files": key_files,
        "readme_summary": readme_summary,
    }
    manifest["architecture"] = build_architecture_profile(manifest)
    return manifest

def save_project_manifest(
    root: Path,
    project_id: str,
    *,
    chunk_count: int = 0,
    chunked_files: int = 0,
    skipped: Optional[Dict[str, int]] = None,
    target: Optional[Path] = None,
) -> Path:
    """Persist manifest JSON under project root (or custom target)."""
    manifest = build_project_manifest(
        root,
        project_id,
        chunk_count=chunk_count,
        chunked_files=chunked_files,
        skipped=skipped,
    )
    out = target or (root / MANIFEST_FILENAME)
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return out

    chunked_files: int = 0,
    skipped: Optional[Dict[str, int]] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Build deterministic manifest snapshot from a project root directory."""
    file_tree: List[str] = []
    ext_counter: Counter[str] = Counter()
    total_bytes = 0
    total_files = 0
    total_dirs = 0

    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
        dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames if d not in {".git", "__pycache__", "node_modules", ".venv", "venv"}]
        total_dirs += len(dirnames)
        for filename in filenames:
            if filename in _INTERNAL_FILES:
                continue
            path = Path(dirpath) / filename
            try:
                rel = str(path.relative_to(root))
                st = path.stat()
            except Exception:
                continue
            total_files += 1
            total_bytes += int(st.st_size)
            ext_counter[path.suffix.lower() or "(no_ext)"] += 1
            if len(file_tree) < MAX_MANIFEST_FILES:
                file_tree.append(rel)

    languages = Counter()
    for ext, count in ext_counter.items():
        lang = _LANG_BY_EXT.get(ext)
        if lang:

    entrypoints = _detect_entrypoints(file_tree)

def _load_robots(domain: str) -> RobotFileParser | None:
    domain = (domain or "").lower()
    if not domain:
        return None

    cached = search_state.get_cached_robots(domain)
    parser = RobotFileParser()
    if cached is not None:
        parser.parse((cached or "").splitlines())
        parser.modified()
        return parser

    robots_url = f"https://{domain}/robots.txt"
    try:
        resp = http_get(
            robots_url,
            timeout=4,
            headers={"User-Agent": USER_AGENT},
        )
        if resp.status_code < 400 and resp.text:
            text = resp.text
            search_state.set_cached_robots(domain, text, ROBOTS_TTL_SECONDS)
            parser.parse(text.splitlines())
            parser.modified()
            return parser
        search_state.set_cached_robots(domain, "", ROBOTS_TTL_SECONDS)
        return None
    except Exception:
        search_state.set_cached_robots(domain, "", ROBOTS_TTL_SECONDS)
        return None


def _robots_allows(url: str) -> bool:
    domain = _domain_from_url(url)
    parser = _load_robots(domain)
    if parser is None:
        return True
    try:
        return parser.can_fetch(USER_AGENT, url)
    except Exception:
        return True

def _risk_snapshot(
    *,
    latest_prediction: Dict[str, Any] | None,
    latest_trade: Dict[str, Any] | None,
    current_price: Optional[float],
    trade_side: Optional[str] = None,
    execution_snapshot: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    order_book_snapshot: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any] | None:
    if not isinstance(latest_prediction, dict):
        return None

    entry_price = (
        _optional_float((latest_trade or {}).get("fill_price"))
        or _optional_float((latest_trade or {}).get("price"))
        or _optional_float(latest_prediction.get("current_price"))
        or _optional_float(current_price)
    )
    predicted_price = _optional_float(latest_prediction.get("predicted_price"))
    if entry_price is None or entry_price <= 0 or predicted_price is None or predicted_price <= 0:
        return None

    decision = str(
        trade_side
        or (latest_trade or {}).get("side")
        or latest_prediction.get("action_decision")
        or latest_prediction.get("decision")
        or "HOLD"
    ).strip().upper()
    probability = _optional_float(latest_prediction.get("probability_up"))
    confidence = None
    if probability is not None:
        confidence = max(probability, 1.0 - probability)

    raw_move_pct = (predicted_price - entry_price) / entry_price
    projected_move_pct = abs(raw_move_pct)
    projected_direction = "up" if raw_move_pct > 0 else "down" if raw_move_pct < 0 else "flat"
    tradeable = decision in {"BUY", "SELL"}

    execution_drag_bps = 0.0
    if isinstance(latest_trade, dict):
        for key in ("spread_bps", "slippage_bps", "impact_bps"):
            val = _optional_float(latest_trade.get(key))
            if val is not None:
                execution_drag_bps += max(0.0, val)
    if execution_drag_bps <= 0.0:
        mode = str((execution_snapshot or {}).get("mode") or "simulated").strip().lower()
        execution_drag_bps = {
            "simulated": 12.0,
            "testnet": 8.0,
            "live": 5.0,
        }.get(mode, 10.0)
    execution_drag_pct = execution_drag_bps / 10000.0

    order_notional = _optional_float((latest_trade or {}).get("notional"))
    if order_notional is None or order_notional <= 0:
        qty = _optional_float((latest_trade or {}).get("quantity")) or 0.0
        if qty > 0 and entry_price > 0:
            order_notional = qty * entry_price
    bid_notional = _optional_float((order_book_snapshot or {}).get("bid_notional"))
    ask_notional = _optional_float((order_book_snapshot or {}).get("ask_notional"))
    if bid_notional is None:
        bid_notional = 0.0
    if ask_notional is None:
        ask_notional = 0.0
    visible_liquidity_notional = max(0.0, bid_notional + ask_notional)
    side_liquidity_notional = ask_notional if decision == "BUY" else bid_notional if decision == "SELL" else visible_liquidity_notional / 2.0
    if side_liquidity_notional <= 0:
        side_liquidity_notional = max(visible_liquidity_notional, order_notional or 0.0, 1.0)
    order_notional = max(0.0, float(order_notional or 0.0))
    order_size_pct = (order_notional / visible_liquidity_notional * 100.0) if visible_liquidity_notional > 0 else 0.0
    book_consumption_pct = (order_notional / side_liquidity_notional * 100.0) if side_liquidity_notional > 0 else 0.0
    participation_pct = (order_notional / (order_notional + side_liquidity_notional) * 100.0) if (order_notional + side_liquidity_notional) > 0 else 0.0
    others_pct = max(0.0, 100.0 - participation_pct)
    remaining_liquidity = max(0.0, side_liquidity_notional - order_notional)

    spread_bps = _optional_float((latest_trade or {}).get("spread_bps")) or _optional_float((order_book_snapshot or {}).get("spread_bps")) or 0.0
    imbalance = _optional_float((order_book_snapshot or {}).get("imbalance"))
    imbalance_penalty = abs((imbalance or 0.5) - 0.5) * 20.0
    impact_score = min(100.0, max(0.0, (min(order_size_pct, 100.0) * 0.55) + (min(execution_drag_bps, 60.0) * 0.5) + (min(spread_bps, 60.0) * 0.25) + imbalance_penalty))

    favorable_move_pct = projected_move_pct
    if decision == "BUY" and raw_move_pct < 0:
        favorable_move_pct = 0.0
    elif decision == "SELL" and raw_move_pct > 0:
        favorable_move_pct = 0.0
    elif decision == "HOLD":
        favorable_move_pct = projected_move_pct

    confidence_multiplier = 0.75
    if confidence is not None:
        if confidence >= 0.7:
            confidence_multiplier = 0.55
        elif confidence >= 0.6:
            confidence_multiplier = 0.7
        else:
            confidence_multiplier = 0.9

    stop_loss_pct = None
    if tradeable:
        stop_loss_pct = max(0.004, favorable_move_pct * confidence_multiplier, execution_drag_pct * 1.5 + 0.0015)

    net_edge_pct = favorable_move_pct - execution_drag_pct
    take_profit_pct = favorable_move_pct if tradeable else None
    expected_pnl_pct = net_edge_pct if tradeable else None
    max_loss_pct = (stop_loss_pct + execution_drag_pct) if stop_loss_pct is not None else None
    net_expected_profit_after_costs_quote = (
        round(order_notional * expected_pnl_pct, 2)
        if tradeable and expected_pnl_pct is not None and order_notional > 0
        else None
    )
    execution_cost_quote = round(order_notional * execution_drag_pct, 2) if order_notional > 0 else None

    if decision == "BUY":
        target_price = predicted_price if predicted_price >= entry_price else entry_price * (1.0 + projected_move_pct)
        stop_price = entry_price * (1.0 - stop_loss_pct) if stop_loss_pct is not None else None
    elif decision == "SELL":
        target_price = predicted_price if predicted_price <= entry_price else entry_price * (1.0 - projected_move_pct)
        stop_price = entry_price * (1.0 + stop_loss_pct) if stop_loss_pct is not None else None
    else:
        target_price = predicted_price
        stop_price = None

    risk_reward = None
    if tradeable and stop_loss_pct not in {None, 0}:
        try:
            risk_reward = (take_profit_pct or 0.0) / float(stop_loss_pct)
        except Exception:
            risk_reward = None

    return {
        "decision": decision,
        "tradeable": tradeable,
        "entry_price": round(entry_price, 2),
        "target_price": round(float(target_price), 2) if target_price is not None else None,
        "stop_price": round(float(stop_price), 2) if stop_price is not None else None,
        "predicted_price": round(predicted_price, 2),
        "current_price": round(_optional_float(current_price) or entry_price, 2),
        "raw_move_pct": round(raw_move_pct, 6),
        "projected_move_pct": round(projected_move_pct, 6),
        "projected_direction": projected_direction,
        "favorable_move_pct": round(favorable_move_pct, 6),
        "execution_drag_bps": round(execution_drag_bps, 2),
        "execution_drag_pct": round(execution_drag_pct, 6),
        "net_edge_pct": round(net_edge_pct, 6),
        "take_profit_pct": round(take_profit_pct, 6) if take_profit_pct is not None else None,
        "stop_loss_pct": round(stop_loss_pct, 6) if stop_loss_pct is not None else None,
        "expected_pnl_pct": round(expected_pnl_pct, 6) if expected_pnl_pct is not None else None,
        "net_expected_profit_after_costs_pct": round(expected_pnl_pct, 6) if expected_pnl_pct is not None else None,
        "net_expected_profit_after_costs_quote": net_expected_profit_after_costs_quote,
        "execution_cost_quote": execution_cost_quote,
        "max_loss_pct": round(max_loss_pct, 6) if max_loss_pct is not None else None,
        "risk_reward": round(risk_reward, 2) if risk_reward is not None else None,
        "probability_up": probability,
        "confidence": confidence,
        "confidence_bucket": _confidence_bucket(probability),
        "execution_mode": str((latest_trade or {}).get("execution_mode") or (execution_snapshot or {}).get("mode") or "simulated").strip().lower(),
        "liquidity_bucket": (latest_trade or {}).get("liquidity_bucket"),
        "order_notional": round(order_notional, 2),
        "visible_liquidity_notional": round(visible_liquidity_notional, 2),
        "side_liquidity_notional": round(side_liquidity_notional, 2),
        "order_size_pct": round(order_size_pct, 4),
        "book_consumption_pct": round(book_consumption_pct, 4),
        "participation_pct": round(participation_pct, 4),
        "others_pct": round(others_pct, 4),
        "remaining_liquidity": round(remaining_liquidity, 2),
        "pre_trade_price": round(_optional_float(current_price) or entry_price, 2),
        "post_trade_estimate": round(entry_price, 2),
        "impact_score": round(impact_score, 2),
        "spread_bps": round(spread_bps, 2),
        "imbalance": round(imbalance, 4) if imbalance is not None else None,
        "latest_trade_ref": _trade_ref(latest_trade),
    }

def build_crypto_state_snapshot(
    *,
    symbol: Optional[str] = None,
    engine: Optional[str] = None,
    horizon_minutes: Optional[int] = None,
    regime: Optional[str] = None,
    limit: int = 20,
    trade_limit: int = 100,
    leaderboard_limit: int = 10,
    price_lookup: Optional[Callable[[str], Optional[float]]] = None,
    order_book_lookup: Optional[Callable[[str], Optional[Dict[str, Any]]]] = None,
    execution_snapshot: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Build a unified crypto snapshot from the durable logs.

    The snapshot keeps the chart / prediction / trade / stats surfaces aligned on
    the same scope (symbol + horizon + regime).
    """
    scope = _normalize_scope(
        symbol=symbol,
        engine=engine,
        horizon_minutes=horizon_minutes,
        regime=regime,
    )
    engine_filter = scope["engine"]
    stats_limit = max(1, int(limit))
    trade_limit = max(1, int(trade_limit))
    leaderboard_limit = max(1, int(leaderboard_limit))
    price_lookup = price_lookup or (lambda _sym: None)

    predictions = pair_predictions_with_outcomes(
        limit=stats_limit,
        symbol=scope["symbol"],
        engine=engine_filter,
        horizon_minutes=scope["horizon_minutes"],
        regime=scope["regime"],
    )
    outcomes = list_outcomes(
        limit=max(stats_limit * 2, trade_limit),
        symbol=scope["symbol"],
        engine=engine_filter,
        horizon_minutes=scope["horizon_minutes"],
        regime=scope["regime"],
    )
    stats = recent_stats(
        limit=stats_limit,
        symbol=scope["symbol"],
        engine=engine_filter,
        horizon_minutes=scope["horizon_minutes"],
        regime=scope["regime"],
    )
    engine_for_policy = engine_filter or "trained"
    thresholds = optimize_thresholds(
        limit=max(stats_limit * 10, 200),
        symbol=scope["symbol"],
        engine=engine_for_policy,
        horizon_minutes=scope["horizon_minutes"],
        regime=scope["regime"],
        min_trades=8,
    )
    credibility = assess_scope_credibility(
        limit=max(stats_limit * 10, 200),
        symbol=scope["symbol"],
        engine=engine_for_policy,
        horizon_minutes=scope["horizon_minutes"],
        regime=scope["regime"],
        min_trades=8,
    )
    leaderboard = scope_leaderboard(
        limit=max(leaderboard_limit * 20, 100),
        engine=engine_for_policy,
        top_n=leaderboard_limit,
    )
    trades = list_trades(limit=trade_limit, symbol=scope["symbol"])
    pnl = compute_pnl(trades, price_lookup)
    exec_snapshot = execution_snapshot or _execution_snapshot()

    current_price = None
    if scope["symbol"]:
        try:
            current_price = price_lookup(scope["symbol"])
        except Exception:
            current_price = None

    order_book = None
    if scope["symbol"] and callable(order_book_lookup):
        try:
            order_book = order_book_lookup(scope["symbol"])
        except Exception:
            order_book = None

    latest_prediction = predictions[0] if predictions else None
    latest_trade = trades[0] if trades else None
    if isinstance(latest_prediction, dict) and latest_prediction.get("outcome"):
        latest_outcome = latest_prediction.get("outcome")
    else:
        latest_outcome = outcomes[0] if outcomes else None
    risk = _risk_snapshot(
        latest_prediction=latest_prediction,
        latest_trade=latest_trade,
        current_price=current_price,
        execution_snapshot=exec_snapshot,
        order_book_snapshot=order_book,
    )

    summary = {
        "predictions_count": len(predictions),
        "outcomes_count": len(outcomes),
        "trades_count": len(trades),
        "has_order_book": bool(order_book),
        "has_price": current_price is not None,
        "has_prediction": bool(latest_prediction),
        "has_outcome": bool(latest_outcome),
        "has_risk": bool(risk),
        "engine": engine_filter or "all",
    }

    return {
        "scope": scope,
        "summary": summary,
        "current_price": current_price,
        "execution": exec_snapshot,
        "latest_prediction": latest_prediction,
        "latest_prediction_ref": _prediction_ref(latest_prediction, source="history"),
        "latest_outcome": latest_outcome,
        "latest_outcome_ref": _prediction_ref(latest_outcome, source="history"),
        "latest_trade": latest_trade,
        "latest_trade_ref": _trade_ref(latest_trade),
        "order_book": order_book,
        "risk": risk,
        "predictions": predictions,
        "outcomes": outcomes,
        "stats": stats,
        "thresholds": thresholds,
        "credibility": credibility,
        "leaderboard": leaderboard,
        "trades": trades,
        "pnl": pnl,
        "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    }

def reconcile_due_predictions(
    *,
    price_lookup: Callable[[str], Optional[float]],
    limit: int = 400,
    now_ts: Optional[int] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Reconcile overdue predictions against the current price.

    This is durable in the sense that it scans the stored logs on each run, so
    a process restart does not lose pending outcomes.
    """
    if price_lookup is None:
        raise ValueError("price_lookup is required")

    scan_limit = max(1, int(limit))
    preds = list_predictions(limit=scan_limit)
    outs = list_outcomes(limit=max(scan_limit * 4, 200))
    already = {str(o.get("log_id") or "").strip() for o in outs if str(o.get("log_id") or "").strip()}
    now_value = int(now_ts if now_ts is not None else time.time())

    evaluated = 0
    missing_price = 0
    skipped = 0
    updated_ids: List[str] = []

    for p in preds:
        pid = str(p.get("id") or "").strip()
        if not pid or pid in already:
            continue

        horizon = _optional_int(p.get("horizon_minutes"))
        ts = _optional_int(p.get("ts"))
        if horizon is None or horizon <= 0 or ts is None or ts <= 0:
            skipped += 1
            continue
        if now_value - ts < horizon * 60:
            skipped += 1
            continue

        sym = str(p.get("symbol") or "").strip().upper()
        if not sym:
            skipped += 1
            continue

        live = price_lookup(sym)
        if live is None or float(live) <= 0:
            missing_price += 1
            continue

        current = float(p.get("current_price") or live)
        delta_pct = (float(live) - current) / current if current else 0.0
        decision = str(p.get("decision") or p.get("action_decision") or "HOLD").strip().upper()
        hit = None
        if decision == "BUY":
            hit = float(live) > current
        elif decision == "SELL":
            hit = float(live) < current
        elif decision == "HOLD":
            hit = abs(delta_pct) < 0.01

        log_outcome(
            {
                "log_id": pid,
                "symbol": sym,
                "horizon_minutes": horizon,
                "decision": decision,
                "model_decision": p.get("model_decision") or p.get("decision"),
                "action_decision": p.get("action_decision") or p.get("decision"),
                "probability_up": p.get("probability_up"),
                "probability_base": p.get("probability_base"),
                "model": p.get("model"),
                "predicted_price": p.get("predicted_price") or current,
                "actual_price": float(live),
                "delta_pct": delta_pct,
                "hit": hit,
                "price_source": p.get("price_source"),
                "engine": p.get("engine"),
                "news_sentiment": p.get("news_sentiment"),
                "n_news_used": p.get("n_news_used"),
                "regime": p.get("regime"),
                "buy_threshold": p.get("buy_threshold"),
                "sell_threshold": p.get("sell_threshold"),
                "threshold_strategy": p.get("threshold_strategy"),
                "credibility": p.get("credibility"),
                "execution_margin": p.get("execution_margin"),
                "threshold_edge": p.get("threshold_edge"),
                "execution_gate_reason": p.get("execution_gate_reason"),
                "consensus": p.get("consensus"),
                "ts": int(time.time()),
            }
        )
        evaluated += 1
        updated_ids.append(pid)
        already.add(pid)

def _confidence_bucket(probability: Optional[float]) -> Optional[str]:
    if probability is None:
        return None
    confidence = max(probability, 1.0 - probability)
    if confidence >= 0.8:
        return "high"
    if confidence >= 0.62:
        return "medium"
    return "low"

    api_key = (os.getenv("BINANCE_API_KEY") or "").strip()
    api_secret = (os.getenv("BINANCE_API_SECRET") or "").strip()

        "live_enabled": mode == "live" and live_trading_enabled,

    *,
    price_lookup: Callable[[str], Optional[float]],
    interval_seconds: Optional[float] = None,
    limit: int = 400,
) -> bool:
    """
    Start a daemon reconciler thread.

    The loop is optional and disabled unless the caller explicitly starts it.
    """
    global _RECONCILER_THREAD
    if price_lookup is None:
        return False
    interval = float(interval_seconds if interval_seconds is not None else os.getenv("AEGIS_CRYPTO_RECONCILER_INTERVAL", "30") or 30)
    if interval <= 0:
        return False

    with _RECONCILER_LOCK:
        if _RECONCILER_THREAD and _RECONCILER_THREAD.is_alive():
            return False
        _RECONCILER_STOP.clear()

        def _runner() -> None:
            while not _RECONCILER_STOP.wait(interval):
                try:
                    reconcile_due_predictions(price_lookup=price_lookup, limit=limit)

"""
Validation flow state persistence.

Why this module exists:
- Persist startup/verify gate step statuses across process lifetime.
- Feed `/system/snapshot` and `/system/readyz` with last validation evidence.
"""

import json
import os
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List
from app.utils.runtime_helpers import now_ms as _now_ms

_lock = threading.Lock()
STATE_FILE = Path(os.getenv("AEGIS_VALIDATION_STATE_FILE", "data/validation_state.json"))

def _read_state() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        raw = json.loads(STATE_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if isinstance(raw, dict):
            return raw
    except Exception:
        pass
    return {"last_updated_ms": 0, "flows": {}}


def _write_state(state: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    try:
        STATE_FILE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        tmp = STATE_FILE.with_suffix(".tmp")
        tmp.write_text(json.dumps(state, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        tmp.replace(STATE_FILE)
    except Exception:
        pass


def start_flow(flow: str, steps: List[str]) -> None:
    """Start a named validation flow with pending step map."""
    now = _now_ms()
    with _lock:
        state = _read_state()
        flows = dict(state.get("flows") or {})
        flows[flow] = {
            "status": "running",
            "detail": "",
            "started_at_ms": now,
            "finished_at_ms": None,
            "updated_at_ms": now,
            "steps": {
                step: {
                    "status": "pending",
                    "detail": "",
                    "updated_at_ms": now,
                }
                for step in steps
            },
        }
        state["flows"] = flows
        state["last_updated_ms"] = now
        _write_state(state)


def mark_step(flow: str, step: str, status: str, detail: str = "", meta: Dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> None:
    """Update one step status inside a running validation flow."""
    now = _now_ms()
    with _lock:
        state = _read_state()
        flows = dict(state.get("flows") or {})
        flow_state = dict(flows.get(flow) or {})
        steps = dict(flow_state.get("steps") or {})
        payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "status": status,
            "detail": detail,
            "updated_at_ms": now,
        }
        if meta:
            payload["meta"] = dict(meta)
        steps[step] = payload
        flow_state["steps"] = steps
        flow_state["updated_at_ms"] = now
        if flow_state.get("status") != "failed":
            flow_state["status"] = "running"
        flows[flow] = flow_state
        state["flows"] = flows
        state["last_updated_ms"] = now
        _write_state(state)


def finish_flow(flow: str, status: str, detail: str = "") -> None:
    """Finalize flow status and completion timestamps."""
    now = _now_ms()
    with _lock:
        state = _read_state()
        flows = dict(state.get("flows") or {})
        flow_state = dict(flows.get(flow) or {})
        flow_state["status"] = status
        flow_state["detail"] = detail
        flow_state["finished_at_ms"] = now
        flow_state["updated_at_ms"] = now
        flows[flow] = flow_state
        state["flows"] = flows
        state["last_updated_ms"] = now
        _write_state(state)


def snapshot() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    with _lock:
        return _read_state()

def _trim_text(value: Any, max_chars: int = MAX_TEXT) -> str:
    text = "" if value is None else str(value)
    if len(text) <= max_chars:
        return text
    return text[: max_chars - 3] + "..."


def _sanitize_payload(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Bound payload size to keep turn traces compact and safe."""
    out: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    for key, value in (payload or {}).items():
        if isinstance(value, str):
            out[key] = _trim_text(value)
        elif isinstance(value, list):
            out[key] = [(_trim_text(item) if isinstance(item, str) else item) for item in value[:20]]
        elif isinstance(value, dict):
            nested: Dict[str, Any] = {}
            for nested_key, nested_value in list(value.items())[:20]:
                if isinstance(nested_value, str):
                    nested[nested_key] = _trim_text(nested_value)
                else:

            out[key] = nested
        else:

    return out

    except Exception:

    if not isinstance(payload, list):

    return [row for row in payload if isinstance(row, dict)]

from __future__ import annotations

"""
Canonical input normalization helpers used before routing/planning.

Why this module exists:
- Keep prompt normalization in one place so mode/tool routing stays consistent.
- Normalize common contractions/typos across EN/ES variants before heuristics run.
"""

import re
from urllib.parse import urlparse

_SMART_APOSTROPHES = str.maketrans(
    {
        "\u2018": "'",
        "\u2019": "'",
        "\u2032": "'",
        "\u0060": "'",
        "\u00b4": "'",
    }
)

_WHITESPACE_RE = re.compile(r"\s+")
_CONTROL_CHAR_RE = re.compile(r"[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x7f]")

_ROUTING_REWRITES: tuple[tuple[re.Pattern[str], str], ...] = (
    (re.compile(r"\bwhere(?:'s|s)\b", flags=re.IGNORECASE), "where is"),
    (re.compile(r"\bwhere\s+s\b", flags=re.IGNORECASE), "where is"),
    (re.compile(r"\bwhat(?:'s|s)\b", flags=re.IGNORECASE), "what is"),
    (re.compile(r"\bwhat\s+s\b", flags=re.IGNORECASE), "what is"),
    (re.compile(r"\bwho(?:'s|s)\b", flags=re.IGNORECASE), "who is"),
    (re.compile(r"\bwho\s+s\b", flags=re.IGNORECASE), "who is"),
    (re.compile(r"\bhow(?:'s|s)\b", flags=re.IGNORECASE), "how is"),
    (re.compile(r"\bhow\s+s\b", flags=re.IGNORECASE), "how is"),
    (re.compile(r"\bdonde(?:'s|s)\b", flags=re.IGNORECASE), "donde es"),
    (re.compile(r"\bdonde\s+s\b", flags=re.IGNORECASE), "donde es"),
)

_MODE_PREFIX_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(web|url|crypto|project|image|local)\s*:\s*(.*)$", re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL)
_DOMAIN_LIKE_RE = re.compile(
    r"^(?:https?://)?(?:localhost|[\w.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}|\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3})(?::\d{2,5})?(?:/[^\s]*)?$",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)


def strip_attachment_context(text: str) -> str:
    raw = str(text or "")
    for marker in ("[Attachment context ", "[Contexto de adjunto "):
        idx = raw.find(marker)
        if idx >= 0:
            trimmed = raw[:idx].strip()
            return trimmed or raw.strip()
    return raw.strip()


def normalize_user_input(text: str) -> str:
    value = str(text or "")
    value = value.translate(_SMART_APOSTROPHES)
    value = value.replace("\u00a0", " ")
    value = _CONTROL_CHAR_RE.sub(" ", value)
    value = _WHITESPACE_RE.sub(" ", value).strip()
    return value


def normalize_for_routing(text: str) -> str:
    value = normalize_user_input(strip_attachment_context(text)).lower()
    for pattern, replacement in _ROUTING_REWRITES:
        value = pattern.sub(replacement, value)
    value = _WHITESPACE_RE.sub(" ", value).strip()
    return value


def split_mode_prefix(text: str) -> tuple[str | None, str]:
    value = normalize_user_input(text)
    match = _MODE_PREFIX_RE.match(value)
    if not match:
        return None, value
    mode = str(match.group(1) or "").strip().lower() or None
    payload = normalize_user_input(str(match.group(2) or ""))
    return mode, payload


def looks_like_url_candidate(text: str) -> bool:
    value = normalize_user_input(text)
    if not value:
        return False
    token = value.split()[0]
    if not token:
        return False
    if not _DOMAIN_LIKE_RE.match(token):
        return False

    if token.lower().startswith(("http://", "https://")):
        try:
            parsed = urlparse(token)
            return bool(parsed.netloc)
        except Exception:
            return False
    return True

from __future__ import annotations

"""
OCR service for AEGIS.

Responsibilities:
  - Extract text from image bytes (screenshots, photos, scans).
  - Optionally extract text from PDF files by rendering pages to images.

Why this module exists:
  - Provide deterministic OCR utilities for image/reference workflows.
"""

import io
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Optional

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

try:  # pragma: no cover
    from PIL import Image  # type: ignore
except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
    Image = None  # type: ignore[assignment]

try:  # pragma: no cover
    import pytesseract  # type: ignore
except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
    pytesseract = None  # type: ignore[assignment]

try:  # pragma: no cover
    from pdf2image import convert_from_bytes  # type: ignore
except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
    convert_from_bytes = None  # type: ignore[assignment]


class OcrError(RuntimeError):
    """Generic error for OCR-related failures."""


def _ensure_image_backend() -> None:
    if Image is None or pytesseract is None:
        raise OcrError(
            "OCR backend not available. Install Pillow and pytesseract, e.g.: "
            "`pip install pillow pytesseract` and configure Tesseract."
        )


def _ensure_pdf_backend() -> None:
    if convert_from_bytes is None:
        raise OcrError(
            "PDF OCR requires `pdf2image` and a Poppler installation. "
            "Install via `pip install pdf2image` and make sure `pdftoppm` is available."
        )
    _ensure_image_backend()


def _normalize_lang_hint(lang: str | None) -> str:
    lang = (lang or "spa+eng").strip()
    return lang or "spa+eng"


def ocr_image_bytes(image_bytes: bytes, lang: str = "spa+eng") -> str:
    _ensure_image_backend()
    if not image_bytes:
        return ""

    lang_hint = _normalize_lang_hint(lang)
    img = None
    try:
        with io.BytesIO(image_bytes) as buf:
            with Image.open(buf) as opened:  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                img = opened.convert("RGB")
        text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img, lang=lang_hint)  # type: ignore[call-arg]
        return (text or "").strip()
    except OcrError:
        raise
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        logger.exception("ocr_image_bytes failed: %s", exc)
        raise OcrError(f"OCR failed on image bytes: {exc}") from exc
    finally:
        if img is not None:
            img.close()


def ocr_file(path: str | Path, lang: str = "spa+eng") -> str:
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.exists():
        raise OcrError(f"OCR file not found: {p}")

    suffix = p.suffix.lower()
    lang_hint = _normalize_lang_hint(lang)

    if suffix == ".pdf":
        pdf_bytes = p.read_bytes()
        return ocr_pdf_bytes(pdf_bytes, lang=lang_hint)

    _ensure_image_backend()
    img = None
    try:
        with Image.open(p) as opened:  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            img = opened.convert("RGB")
        text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img, lang=lang_hint)  # type: ignore[call-arg]
        return (text or "").strip()
    except OcrError:
        raise
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        logger.exception("ocr_file failed for %s: %s", p, exc)
        raise OcrError(f"OCR failed for file {p}: {exc}") from exc
    finally:
        if img is not None:
            img.close()


def ocr_pdf_bytes(
    pdf_bytes: bytes,
    lang: str = "spa+eng",
    max_pages: Optional[int] = 5,
